597.source_en: <dead>	...are you ok? I'm sorry I wasn't able to help, I feel so helpless sometimes...	</dead>
597.translation_tr: <dead>	...iyi misin? Yardim edemedigim icin uzgunum, bazen cok caresiz hissediyorum...	</dead>

598.source_en: <dead>	My poor master, I wish I could help more...	</dead>
598.translation_tr: <dead>	Zavalli efendim, keske daha cok yardim edebilsem...	</dead>

599.source_en: <stand>	Do I look more like a Condor or a Peco Peco to you?	</stand>
599.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence daha cok Condor'a mi Peco Peco'ya mi benziyorum?	</stand>

600.source_en: <stand>	You want to cuddle with me? Yay, please cuddle me!	</stand>
600.translation_tr: <stand>	Benimle sarilmak mi istiyorsun? Yasasin, saril bana!	</stand>

601.source_en: <connect>	*Tweet**Tweet* YaY! My master has returned, all hail.	</connect>
601.translation_tr: <connect>	*Cik cik**Cik cik* Yasasin! Efendim geri dondu, cok yasa.	</connect>

602.source_en: <connect>	Aw... and here I thought you had forgotten about me. I'm glad you're back.	</connect>
602.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah... beni unuttun sanmistim. Geri donmene sevindim.	</connect>

603.source_en: <levelup>	Well now, that didn't take long did it? Good job!	</levelup>
603.translation_tr: <levelup>	Eh, pek uzun surmedi degil mi? Iyi is!	</levelup>

604.source_en: <levelup>	You are invincible! ... just like me.	</levelup>

607.source_en: <feeding>	Ok, no more. My gentile little stomach can't take any more of it! !	</feeding>
607.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tamam, yeter. Hassas kucuk midem daha fazlasini kaldiramaz!!	</feeding>

608.source_en: <feeding>	Are you trying to fatten me up for some reason?	</feeding>
608.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni bir nedenle sismanlatmaya mi calisiyorsun?	</feeding>

609.source_en: <feeding>	I'm going to call the animal abuse center if you don't stop feeding me so much!	</feeding>
609.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni bu kadar beslemeyi birakmazsan hayvan haklarini arayacagim!	</feeding>

610.source_en: <hunting>	Mind if I do some exercise while you hunt?	</hunting>
610.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sen avlanirken biraz egzersiz yapsam olur mu?	</hunting>

611.source_en: <hunting>	I would help you but I can't move, because I'm SO FAT!	</hunting>
611.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana yardim ederdim ama hareket edemiyorum, cunku COK SISMANIM!	</hunting>

612.source_en: <danger>	If you hadn't fed me so much, maybe you'd be able to heal yourself.	</danger>
612.translation_tr: <danger>	Beni bu kadar beslemeseydin belki kendini iyilestirebilirdin.	</danger>

613.source_en: <danger>	You don't look too good... well, neither do I, but I'm just overfed, you're nearly dead.	</danger>
613.translation_tr: <danger>	Pek iyi gorunmuyorsun... gerci ben de degilim ama ben sadece fazla yedim, sen neredeyse olusun.	</danger>

614.source_en: <dead>	Want me to go look for a yaggdrasil leaf?	</dead>
614.translation_tr: <dead>	Senin icin Yggdrasil Leaf aramaya gideyim mi?	</dead>

616.source_en: <stand>	Ugh, please... carry me, I'm so full I don't want to move!	</stand>
616.translation_tr: <stand>	Off, lutfen... beni tasi, cok tokum, hareket etmek istemiyorum!	</stand>

617.source_en: <stand>	My tum-tum hurts, don't you care?.	</stand>

618.source_en: <connect>	Alright! Let's get this party started!	</connect>

619.source_en: <connect>	Man, I still stuffed from that last meal you gave me! Let's go work it off!	</connect>
619.translation_tr: <connect>	Dostum, son verdigin yemekten hala tikabasa doluyum! Hadi eritmeye gidelim!	</connect>

620.source_en: <levelup>	SWEET! When do I level dude!	</levelup>
620.translation_tr: <levelup>	HARIKA! Ben ne zaman level atlayacagim dostum!	</levelup>

621.source_en: <levelup>	DUDE, you got a level! SWEET~!	</levelup>

626.source_en: <feeding>	Bzz Bzz, me izz still hungry bzz	</feeding>
626.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bzz Bzz, ben hala acim bzz	</feeding>

629.source_en: <hunting>	Bzz Bzz, can I have thoze on zzze ground? Pleaaaaazzz?	</hunting>
629.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bzz Bzz, yerdekileri alabilir miyim? Lutfeeeen?	</hunting>

630.source_en: <hunting>	I shall beat your enemy to death with my wingz!! Bzz oopzz?	</hunting>
630.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dusmanini kanatlarimla dovup oldurecegim!! Bzz eyvah?	</hunting>

632.source_en: <danger>	Quickzz! Uzze these Redzz I have!!	</danger>

633.source_en: <danger>	Bzz,You are in Great Danger. Bzz	</danger>

634.source_en: <danger>	Bzz, I need food... you need health...	</danger>
634.translation_tr: <danger>	Bzz, benim yemege ihtiyacim var... senin HP'ye...	</danger>

635.source_en: <dead>	Don't lay downzzz now, I'm still hungryyzzzz!!!!	</dead>

636.source_en: <dead>	Don't worry...I promise not to eat your rotting flesh...mzzzmmz... that doesn't sound half bad.	</dead>
636.translation_tr: <dead>	Endiselenme... curuyen etini yemeyecegime soz veriyorum... mzzzmmz... aslinda fena gelmedi.	</dead>

637.source_en: <dead>	Bzz... looks like you got to close to the flame.	</dead>
637.translation_tr: <dead>	Bzz... gorunuse gore atese fazla yaklastin.	</dead>

638.source_en: <stand>	Fead me pweaaaaazzz? Youzzz do not being buzy	</stand>
638.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni besle lutfeeeenzzz? Su an mesgul degilsinzz	</stand>

639.source_en: <stand>	Letz play bzz around! *bzz bzz bzz* That's fun...zzzz	</stand>
639.translation_tr: <stand>	Hadi bzz oynayalim! *bzz bzz bzz* Bu eglenceli...zzzz	</stand>

640.source_en: <stand>	Do you think I can have some loot for food? I am a zzscavenger...	</stand>
640.translation_tr: <stand>	Yemek icin biraz ganimet alabilir miyim? Ben bir lezzet avcisiyimzz...	</stand>

643.source_en: <connect>	Hello! *Bzz* I think forgot to feedzz me...	</connect>

645.source_en: <levelup>	I'll celebrate for you as soon as I get soeme foodszzz.	</levelup>
645.translation_tr: <levelup>	Biraz yemek alir almaz senin icin kutlayacagimzzz.	</levelup>

650.source_en: <feeding>	You are zzo kind to mezzz.	</feeding>

651.source_en: <hunting>	Bzz I'll fly in itzz face zzo it dizztractzz it, make zzure you kill it fazzt! Bzz	</hunting>
651.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bzz yuzune ucarimzz, dikkati dagilirzz, sen cabuk oldurzz! Bzz	</hunting>

652.source_en: <hunting>	Waaaazzz!! Itzz looking at me funnyzz, kill it!	</hunting>
652.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vaaaayzz!! Bana tuhaf bakiyorzz, oldur onu!	</hunting>

653.source_en: <hunting>	Ah, you are zzo zzkilled... and the creaturezz you feed me zzo goodzz...	</hunting>
653.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ah, cok yeteneklisinzz... ve bana yedirdigin yaratiklar cok guzellzz...	</hunting>

654.source_en: <hunting>	Heyzzz, can I zzearchzz their bodiezz when you kill zzem?	</hunting>
654.translation_tr: <hunting>	Heyzzz, onlar oldugunde cesetlerini arayabilir miyimzz?	</hunting>

659.source_en: <stand>	Bzz, goodzz thing I can flyzz, when I'm zznot hungryzz.	</stand>
659.translation_tr: <stand>	Bzz, ac olmadigimda ucabilmem iyi bir seyzz.	</stand>

660.source_en: <stand>	I zzure love food? *cough* can'tzz you take a hintz?	</stand>
660.translation_tr: <stand>	Yemegi cok seviyorumzz *oksurur* imayi anlamiyor musunzz?	</stand>

663.source_en: <connect>	Zzo youzzzz gonna feed me nowzz that yourzz herezz?	</connect>

664.source_en: <connect>	It'zz time to zzfeed mezz!... I mean, welcomezz back...yeah, that'zz it!	</connect>
664.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni besleme zamanizz!... yani, hos geldinzz... evet, oydu!	</connect>

665.source_en: <levelup>	Goodzz job, letzz got for anotherzz	</levelup>
665.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi iszz, hadi bir tane daha yapalimzz	</levelup>

666.source_en: <levelup>	Now thatzz you're ztronger, maybezz you can now buyzz zzome food for a zzertain zzomeone?	</levelup>
666.translation_tr: <levelup>	Simdi daha guclusunzz, belki belirli birinezz biraz yemek alabilirsinzz?	</levelup>

671.source_en: <feeding>	I lovezz the way you tazzste... I meanzz YOU! I lovezz you? *bzzing happily*	</feeding>
671.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tadinizz seviyorumzz... yani SENI! Seni seviyorumzz? *mutlu bzz*	</feeding>

674.source_en: <hunting>	Thizz izz fun? Hey! A monsterzz! Doezz it have zzome foodzz with itzz?	</hunting>
674.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu eglenceli miizz? Hey! Bir canavarzz! Yaninda yemek var mizz?	</hunting>

677.source_en: <danger>	Look out! *bzz around your head* You will be all right with me by your side!	</danger>
677.translation_tr: <danger>	Dikkat! *basinin etrafinda bzz* Yaninda ben varken iyi olacaksin!	</danger>

679.source_en: <dead>	Don't be lazzy, getzz up and finishzz you battlezz...	</dead>
679.translation_tr: <dead>	Tembel olma, kalkzz ve savasini bitirzz...	</dead>

680.source_en: <dead>	WHY!!!!!! *buzzing mixed with weeping* We were sooo happy together! Your food and me!	</dead>
680.translation_tr: <dead>	NEDEN!!!!!! *aglamaya karisan bzz* Birlikte cok mutluyduk! Yemeklerin ve ben!	</dead>

682.source_en: <stand>	I wishzzz I could zzee the mazzter ChonChon. I readzz about it in a bookzzz	</stand>
682.translation_tr: <stand>	Keske usta ChonChon'u gorebilsemzz. Bir kitapta okudumzz	</stand>

686.source_en: <connect>	Let'z party! I am in a PARTY moodz!!	</connect>

688.source_en: <levelup>	Ooooozzoozzzz!!!! I love you!*cries with joy*	</levelup>

693.source_en: <feeding>	Too muchzz food will makezz me fat, pleazze no more...	</feeding>
693.translation_tr: <feeding>	Cok yemekzz beni sisman yapar, lutfen daha fazla verme...	</feeding>

694.source_en: <hunting>	Canzz we call it a dayzz? I'm boardzz	</hunting>

695.source_en: <hunting>	Ooohzz... I am full, can we take rezzt?	</hunting>

697.source_en: <danger>	I will zzave you! zzbut, I'm zzo heavy, Izz can barely movezz I'm zzo full.	</danger>
697.translation_tr: <danger>	Seni kurtaracagimzz! ama cok agirzzim, zar zor hareket ediyorumzz, cok tokum.	</danger>

698.source_en: <danger>	Hey, no fairzz, you went to zzleep without mezz	</danger>

699.source_en: <dead>	You diedzz, now I willzz neverzz get to zzing the victoy theme	</dead>
699.translation_tr: <dead>	Oldunzz, simdi zafer temasini asla soyleyemeyecegimzz	</dead>

700.source_en: <dead>	*bzz sob sob Bzz* Don't worry, I can manage for now without your foodzz	</dead>
700.translation_tr: <dead>	*bzz hickirik Bzz* Endiselenme, simdilik yemeksiz idare ederimzz	</dead>

701.source_en: <stand>	Do you thinkzz I'll becomezz a great ChonChonzzz?	</stand>
701.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence buyuk bir ChonChon olur muyumzz?	</stand>

702.source_en: <stand>	Letzz go danczzing! Come onzz, I'll be your danczzee partner!	</stand>
702.translation_tr: <stand>	Hadi danszz edelim! Gelzz, dans partnerin olayim!	</stand>

706.source_en: <levelup>	Yeah! Andzz I don't even needzz your money for foodzz now.	</levelup>
706.translation_tr: <levelup>	Evetzz! Artik yemek icin paraniza bile ihtiyacim yokzz.	</levelup>

709.source_en: <feeding>	Iz feelzz like I only livezz for one dayzz	</feeding>

710.source_en: <feeding>	Too muchzz foodzz... pleazze... you're going to killzz.. me....	</feeding>
710.translation_tr: <feeding>	Cok fazlazz yemek... lutfen... beni oldureceksinzz....	</feeding>

711.source_en: <hunting>	We can zztop huntingzzz whenever, I dontzz mindzz	</hunting>
711.translation_tr: <hunting>	Istedigin zaman avlanmayi birakabilirizzz, sorun degilzz	</hunting>

712.source_en: <hunting>	Zzlow down, my little wingzz can't carryzz my fat little body anzzy more.	</hunting>
712.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yavaszzla, kucuk kanatlarim sisman bedenimi artik tasiyamiyorzz.	</hunting>

714.source_en: <danger>	Run! I will catzzch up to you, when I catzzch my breath?	</danger>

715.source_en: <dead>	Your flesh will rotzz if you lie therezz..	</dead>

716.source_en: <dead>	I'm zzo fat, I can'zzt even get a Priezzt for you now?	</dead>
716.translation_tr: <dead>	O kadar sismanimzz ki sana Priest bile getiremiyorumzz?	</dead>

717.source_en: <stand>	Can zzI ride on your zzshoulder?	</stand>

718.source_en: <stand>	I think wezz could bozzth lozze zzome weight	</stand>
718.translation_tr: <stand>	Bence ikimizzz de biraz kilo verebilirizz	</stand>

720.source_en: <connect>	You alwayzz know whenzz to make an enterenzze.	</connect>
720.translation_tr: <connect>	Ne zaman giris yapacagini hep biliyorsunzz.	</connect>

721.source_en: <levelup>	Yeaaszzz good job! Oh, I needzz a rezzst.	</levelup>
721.translation_tr: <levelup>	Evetzzz iyi is! Ah, dinlenmemzz lazim.	</levelup>

731.source_en: <danger>	Hey, feed me after you heal yourself..!	</danger>
731.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, kendini iyilestirdikten sonra beni besle..!	</danger>

732.source_en: <danger>	If you're gonna die, can you at least feed me?	</danger>
732.translation_tr: <danger>	Oleceksen en azindan beni besler misin?	</danger>

733.source_en: <dead>	Are you in pain? Because you are one to me!! Why didn't you feed me?	</dead>
733.translation_tr: <dead>	Acin mi var? Cunku sen benim icin bir acisin!! Neden beni beslemedin?	</dead>

734.source_en: <dead>	I hope you don't mind me nibbling on your dead flesh, you didn't feed me!	</dead>
734.translation_tr: <dead>	Olu etini kemirmeme kizmazsin umarim, beni beslemedin!	</dead>

736.source_en: <stand>	I'm so hungry, can I please get something to eat?	</stand>
736.translation_tr: <stand>	Cok acim, lutfen yiyecek bir sey alabilir miyim?	</stand>

739.source_en: <levelup>	Alright, you celebrate! I'll eat those items!	</levelup>
739.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tamam, sen kutla! Ben o esyalari yerim!	</levelup>

743.source_en: <feeding>	Mmmmm! Could I have some more please?	</feeding>
743.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmmmm! Biraz daha alabilir miyim lutfen?	</feeding>

746.source_en: <hunting>	What's the buzz? Okay, that was lame. I'll think of something better.	</hunting>
746.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu vizzilti da ne? Tamam, kotu sakaydi. Daha iyisini bulurum.	</hunting>

747.source_en: <danger>	Looks like you're in pain, are you?.	</danger>

748.source_en: <danger>	Hey hey hey! Can I get dibs on your corpse if you die?	</danger>
748.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey hey hey! Olursen cesedini ilk ben alabilir miyim?	</danger>

752.source_en: <stand>	Would you get mad at me if I ate your flesh if you died? Just curious...	</stand>
752.translation_tr: <stand>	Olursen etini yesem kizarsin mi? Sadece merak ettim...	</stand>

753.source_en: <connect>	Hey, welcome back *hug* can we eat?	</connect>
753.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, hos geldin *sarilir* yemek yiyebilir miyiz?	</connect>

754.source_en: <connect>	Where have you been? Trying to abandon me eh? Well, since you're back, you should feed me.	</connect>
754.translation_tr: <connect>	Neredeydin? Beni terk etmeye mi calisiyordun? Madem dondun, beni beslemelisin.	</connect>

755.source_en: <levelup>	Party Time! Let's get some chow!	</levelup>

756.source_en: <levelup>	Oh wow! You're getting pretty strong!	</levelup>

760.source_en: <feeding>	Oh wow! You're getting good at this feeding thing!	</feeding>

761.source_en: <hunting>	Wow, is that a rare item?	</hunting>
761.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay, bu nadir bir esya mi?	</hunting>

762.source_en: <hunting>	Oh wow! You're getting pretty strong!	</hunting>

763.source_en: <danger>	Hey, you don't look so good...	</danger>

764.source_en: <danger>	Where'd all that strength go I saw earlier?	</danger>
764.translation_tr: <danger>	Az once gordugum tum o guc nereye gitti?	</danger>

765.source_en: <dead>	Sleeping? Here? In the middle of nowhere?	</dead>
765.translation_tr: <dead>	Uyuyor musun? Burada mi? Hicligin ortasinda?	</dead>

766.source_en: <dead>	It's pretty tempting not to eat you...	</dead>

768.translation_tr: <stand>	Pekiii... simdi ne var? Bir yere gidiyor muyuz?	</stand>

769.source_en: <stand>	Haha, you stand while I get to just fly.	</stand>
769.translation_tr: <stand>	Haha, sen ayakta dur, ben ucarim.	</stand>

771.source_en: <connect>	Oh great you're back, now we can take on some baddies together.	</connect>
771.translation_tr: <connect>	Harika, geri geldin, simdi kotulerle birlikte kapisabiliriz.	</connect>

772.source_en: <levelup>	Rockin, now let's head over and take out Bapho.	</levelup>

776.source_en: <feeding>	Alright alright, I'm full, no more please.	</feeding>
776.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tamam tamam, doydum, lutfen daha fazla verme.	</feeding>

779.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, when you're ready we can go after Bapho.	</hunting>
779.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, hazir oldugunda Bapho'nun pesine dusebiliriz.	</hunting>

780.source_en: <danger>	Woah, hey, lets slow down for a while...	</danger>

781.source_en: <danger>	Be careful buddy, you might get seriously hurt!	</danger>

782.source_en: <dead>	Hmm, told you to slow down...	</dead>

783.source_en: <dead>	Well, see what happens when you try takin' on hard monsters?	</dead>
783.translation_tr: <dead>	Gordun mu, zor canavarlara dalinca ne oluyor?	</dead>

786.source_en: <stand>	You... act... an awful... lot... like... a robot...hmm...	</stand>
786.translation_tr: <stand>	Sen... baya... bir... robot... gibi... davraniyorsun... hmm...	</stand>

787.source_en: <connect>	Hey, glad you're back. Come chill with me.	</connect>
787.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, donmene sevindim. Gel biraz takilalim.	</connect>

788.source_en: <connect>	Well well, look who's back. Have a nice break?	</connect>
788.translation_tr: <connect>	Vay vay, kim donmus. Guzel mola miydi?	</connect>

789.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, not bad. I'll race you to the next level!	</levelup>
789.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, fena degil. Siradaki levele kadar yarisalim!	</levelup>

790.source_en: <levelup>	Cool, think we can take Bapho yet?	</levelup>
790.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzel, sence Bapho'yu artik indirebilir miyiz?	</levelup>

793.source_en: <feeding>	No more! Please! I beg you!	</feeding>

794.source_en: <feeding>	You know, I don't do to well when I'm overfed.	</feeding>
794.translation_tr: <feeding>	Biliyorsun, fazla beslendigimde pek iyi olmuyorum.	</feeding>

795.source_en: <feeding>	I'm gonna burst if you keep feeding me like this...	</feeding>
795.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni boyle beslemeye devam edersen patlayacagim...	</feeding>

797.source_en: <hunting>	You can do it! Go Go Go! More EXP!	</hunting>
797.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yapabilirsin! Hadi Hadi Hadi! Daha fazla EXP!	</hunting>

798.source_en: <danger>	Heal yourself!! Get out of there! RUUUUUN!!	</danger>

799.source_en: <danger>	Don't fight anymore for me, I don't like it when you die...except for your delicious corpse...I mean...be careful!	</danger>
799.translation_tr: <danger>	Benim icin daha fazla savasma, oldugunde sevmiyorum... lezzetli cesedin haric... yani... dikkat et!	</danger>

801.source_en: <dead>	Ouch! Be more careful next time!	</dead>
801.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah! Bir dahaki sefere daha dikkatli ol!	</dead>

802.source_en: <stand>	I'm going to lay on the ground... ahhhhhhhhh...	</stand>

803.source_en: <stand>	So this guy walks into a bar... oh you've heard this one before? Ah ok never mind.	</stand>
803.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir adam bara girer... ah, bunu daha once duydun mu? Tamam, bos ver.	</stand>

804.source_en: <stand>	I'm feeling kinda dizzy, would you mind holding me?	</stand>
804.translation_tr: <stand>	Biraz basim donuyor, beni tutar misin?	</stand>

805.source_en: <connect>	You're awake! Please don't run off too fast, let me digest what I last ate first.	</connect>
805.translation_tr: <connect>	Uyandin! Lutfen cok hizli kosma, once son yedigimi sindireyim.	</connect>

806.source_en: <connect>	Hey, lets go! I want to see Baphomet die by your hand!	</connect>
806.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, hadi gidelim! Baphomet'in senin elinden oldugunu gormek istiyorum!	</connect>

807.source_en: <levelup>	Hurray, now we get to rest, right?	</levelup>

808.source_en: <levelup>	We kick butt, I think we're up for Bapho now, what do you think?	</levelup>
808.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harikayiz, artik Bapho'ya haziriz bence, ne dersin?	</levelup>

813.source_en: <feeding>	What is this you just fed me?... fine, I'll eat it... but I won't like it... so hungry...	</feeding>
813.translation_tr: <feeding>	Az once bana ne yedirdin?... tamam, yiyecegim... ama sevmeyecegim... cok acim...	</feeding>

814.source_en: <feeding>	Why do you wait so long to feed me?	</feeding>
814.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni beslemek icin neden bu kadar bekliyorsun?	</feeding>

815.source_en: <feeding>	Hey look at that, you get to live another day... I won't eat you now.	</feeding>
815.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey bak, bir gun daha yasayacaksin... simdilik seni yemeyecegim.	</feeding>

816.source_en: <hunting>	Will it still give you experience if I eat it?	</hunting>
816.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ben yersem yine de sana EXP verir mi?	</hunting>

817.source_en: <hunting>	I'm quick, I'm cunning.... I'm ... hungry...	</hunting>

818.source_en: <hunting>	You know, I think some food is required here, I've bee patient.	</hunting>
818.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biliyorsun, burada biraz yemek gerekiyor, sabirliydim.	</hunting>

819.source_en: <danger>	I'm placing my bet on the monster, you don't look too good.	</danger>
819.translation_tr: <danger>	Bahsimi canavara koyuyorum, pek iyi gorunmuyorsun.	</danger>

820.source_en: <danger>	Haha, if you had fed me, maybe I would have helped but now look at you!	</danger>
820.translation_tr: <danger>	Haha, beni besleseydin belki yardim ederdim ama simdi haline bak!	</danger>

821.source_en: <dead>	Your body looks tasty, you don't mind if I take a bite...	</dead>
821.translation_tr: <dead>	Bedenin lezzetli gorunuyor, biraz isirsam sorun olmaz...	</dead>

822.source_en: <dead>	Seems I have to get my own food...	</dead>
822.translation_tr: <dead>	Gorunuse gore yemegimi kendim bulmam gerekecek...	</dead>

823.source_en: <dead>	Well, I guess that makes two of us since you forgot to feed me...	</dead>
823.translation_tr: <dead>	Beni beslemeyi unuttuguna gore ikimiz de ayni durumdayiz sanirim...	</dead>

824.source_en: <stand>	I know you got some goodies for me, feed me!	</stand>
824.translation_tr: <stand>	Benim icin guzel seylerin var, beni besle!	</stand>

826.source_en: <connect>	Hey, you're back great! Let's go hunt me some food!	</connect>
826.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, geri geldin harika! Hadi bana yemek avlayalim!	</connect>

827.source_en: <connect>	I bid you a gracious welcome and wish that you give me food... now.	</connect>
827.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni nazikce karsiliyorum ve bana yemek vermeni diliyorum... simdi.	</connect>

828.source_en: <levelup>	... leveled? Eh, big deal... I'm hungry.	</levelup>
828.translation_tr: <levelup>	... level mi atladin? Buyuk mesele... acim.	</levelup>

831.source_en: <feeding>	You really shouldn't wait to feed me, I get irritable.	</feeding>

832.source_en: <hunting>	Your skills are improving, but they're no where near my hunting skills.	</hunting>
832.translation_tr: <hunting>	Becerilerin gelisiyor ama benim av yeteneklerime daha cok var.	</hunting>

833.source_en: <hunting>	Kill it quickly, I'm getting hungry.	</hunting>

834.source_en: <danger>	Looks like u need my help... well, sorry but I'm a bit too hungry.	</danger>
834.translation_tr: <danger>	Yardimima ihtiyacin var gibi... uzgunum ama cok acim.	</danger>

835.source_en: <dead>	Oh sure, now you want my help? Well tough nuts. You should have fed me.	</dead>
835.translation_tr: <dead>	Tabii, simdi yardimimi istiyorsun? Sansina kus. Beni beslemeliydin.	</dead>

836.source_en: <stand>	It's about time... thought you'd never get up.	</stand>

837.source_en: <stand>	Are you getting me food? You better be...	</stand>
837.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana yemek mi aliyorsun? Umarim oyledir...	</stand>

838.source_en: <connect>	So, you're back, does this mean I get to eat?	</connect>
838.translation_tr: <connect>	Demek geri geldin, bu yemek yiyebilecegim anlamina mi geliyor?	</connect>

839.source_en: <levelup>	Way to go... now you can get me my red gems easier.	</levelup>
839.translation_tr: <levelup>	Boyle devam... simdi kirmizi gemlerimi daha kolay alabilirsin.	</levelup>

843.source_en: <hunting>	We're not a bad team, what's next?	</hunting>
843.translation_tr: <hunting>	Fena bir takim degiliz, sirada ne var?	</hunting>

844.source_en: <hunting>	Blood, kill, death, haha I love the carnage!	</hunting>
844.translation_tr: <hunting>	Kan, oldurme, olum, haha katliami seviyorum!	</hunting>

845.source_en: <danger>	Hey, look at that. Your life bar looks like my skin color... we match!	</danger>
845.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, bak. HP cubugun ten rengime benzedi... uyumluyuz!	</danger>

846.source_en: <dead>	What was that? I thought you were going to dodge left, now you're dead? Bad form!	</dead>
846.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu neydi? Sola kacacaksin sandim, simdi oldun mu? Kotu hareket!	</dead>

847.source_en: <stand>	When are we going to go hunt the hard monsters, I'm getting bored.	</stand>
847.translation_tr: <stand>	Zor canavarlari ne zaman avlayacagiz, sikilmaya basladim.	</stand>

848.source_en: <connect>	Ah, finally you return, I'm beginning to think my hunting skills are getting dull, let's head out!	</connect>
848.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah, sonunda dondun, av yeteneklerim koreliyor diye dusunmeye basladim, hadi cikiyoruz!	</connect>

849.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, you look like you could use a hand holding those red gems...	</levelup>
849.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, o kirmizi gemleri tasirken yardima ihtiyacin var gibi...	</levelup>

852.source_en: <feeding>	Ah, that was more then I wanted, I'm full.	</feeding>

853.source_en: <feeding>	Let me give you a tip, don't overfeed me or I'll puke.	</feeding>
853.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sana bir ipucu, beni fazla besleme yoksa kusarim.	</feeding>

854.source_en: <hunting>	Where's the fun in hunting this thing? It's too easy... for me at least.	</hunting>
854.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bunu avlamanin neresi eglenceli? Cok kolay... en azindan benim icin.	</hunting>

855.source_en: <danger>	Go for the headshot, go for the headshot!	</danger>

856.source_en: <danger>	So, at which point are you going to heal yourself?	</danger>

857.source_en: <dead>	You know, I was going to say something, but I don't think you'll be happy with it... so I'll just sit here and wait.	</dead>
857.translation_tr: <dead>	Bir sey soyleyecektim ama hosuna gitmez... o yuzden burada oturup bekleyecegim.	</dead>

858.source_en: <stand>	Agility up please, I need my master to keep up with me.	</stand>
858.translation_tr: <stand>	Agility Up lutfen, efendimin bana yetismesi gerekiyor.	</stand>

859.source_en: <stand>	Hey, when are we going out on our date? I thought you said you liked me.	</stand>
859.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, ne zaman bulusmaya cikiyoruz? Beni sevdigini soylemistin.	</stand>

860.source_en: <stand>	I know this great place where we can just chill and watch the stars... doesn't that sound nice?	</stand>
860.translation_tr: <stand>	Sakin sakin oturup yildizlari izleyebilecegimiz harika bir yer biliyorum... guzel olmaz mi?	</stand>

861.source_en: <connect>	Is it time for our date already?	</connect>

862.source_en: <levelup>	Well done, you're almost fit enough to go solo.	</levelup>
862.translation_tr: <levelup>	Aferin, neredeyse tek basina gidecek kadar formdasin.	</levelup>

865.source_en: <feeding>	Are you trying to kill me from overfeeding?	</feeding>
865.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni fazla besleyip oldurmeye mi calisiyorsun?	</feeding>

866.source_en: <feeding>	....Hey, I told you I don't need anymore. I am not a savage bebe!	</feeding>
866.translation_tr: <feeding>	....Hey, daha fazla istemiyorum dedim. Ben Savage Bebe degilim!	</feeding>

867.source_en: <hunting>	So, when are you going to go after Anubis?	</hunting>
867.translation_tr: <hunting>	Peki, Anubis'in pesine ne zaman gideceksin?	</hunting>

868.source_en: <danger>	I'd help if I wasn't so full...oh, I'll think about it.	</danger>
868.translation_tr: <danger>	Bu kadar tok olmasam yardim ederdim... neyse, dusunurum.	</danger>

869.source_en: <dead>	Haha, you look like my last meal, before you and I started hanging out.	</dead>
869.translation_tr: <dead>	Haha, birlikte takilmadan onceki son yemegime benziyorsun.	</dead>

870.source_en: <stand>	Time to kill, get a move on! Pick up those lazy legs!	</stand>
870.translation_tr: <stand>	Oldurme zamani, hareket et! Su tembel bacaklarini kaldir!	</stand>

871.source_en: <connect>	It is time my brothers, to rise up against "the man" and set ourselves free from our masters!.... oh hey, you're back, um, hi?	</connect>
871.translation_tr: <connect>	Kardeslerim, efendilerimize karsi ayaklanip ozgurlesme zamani!.... ah hey, geri geldin, ee, selam?	</connect>

872.source_en: <levelup>	Did you see that angel? Such a rare sight...make a wish!	</levelup>
872.translation_tr: <levelup>	O melegi gordun mu? Ne kadar nadir... bir dilek tut!	</levelup>

873.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, you know those cards with my pictures on them? Do you think they're good pictures of me?	</levelup>
873.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, uzerinde resmim olan kartlari biliyor musun? Sence iyi cikmis miyim?	</levelup>

874.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, awesome job!... what, I can't say something nice once in a while?	</levelup>
874.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, harika is!... ne, arada guzel bir sey soyleyemez miyim?	</levelup>

879.source_en: <feeding>	Just because I'm a pig doesn't mean you can starve me!	</feeding>
879.translation_tr: <feeding>	Domuz olmam beni acliktan birakabilecegin anlamina gelmez!	</feeding>

880.source_en: <feeding>	This isn't enough, do you want me to get even SMALLER?	</feeding>
880.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu yetmez, daha da KUCUK olmami mi istiyorsun?	</feeding>

881.source_en: <hunting>	If it drops something tasty.. can I have it?	</hunting>
881.translation_tr: <hunting>	Lezzetli bir sey dusururse... alabilir miyim?	</hunting>

882.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, watch it! Don't step on me!	</hunting>

884.source_en: <danger>	You're killing this because it drops my dinner, right?	</danger>
884.translation_tr: <danger>	Bunu benim aksam yemegimi dusurdugu icin olduruyorsun, degil mi?	</danger>

885.source_en: <dead>	Maybe you should have fed me before dying.	</dead>

886.source_en: <dead>	If you had fed me, I might have joined in!	</dead>
886.translation_tr: <dead>	Beni besleseydin belki ben de katilirdim!	</dead>

888.source_en: <stand>	Do you want me to be tiny forever? Give me some food!	</stand>
888.translation_tr: <stand>	Sonsuza kadar minik mi kalayim? Bana yemek ver!	</stand>

889.source_en: <connect>	So, what do you have for me to eat today?~	</connect>

890.source_en: <connect>	Phew, you almost spawned right on my head!	</connect>
890.translation_tr: <connect>	Oh, neredeyse tam kafamin ustunde spawn oldun!	</connect>

892.source_en: <levelup>	Lookin' good there, do I get a treat?	</levelup>
892.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi gorunuyorsun, bana odul var mi?	</levelup>

895.source_en: <feeding>	Oink, I'm still a bit hungry..	</feeding>

896.source_en: <feeding>	That was nice, do you have anymore?	</feeding>

898.source_en: <hunting>	I almost feel strong enough to play with you now.	</hunting>
898.translation_tr: <hunting>	Neredeyse seninle oynayacak kadar guclu hissediyorum.	</hunting>

900.source_en: <danger>	Uh oh, is there a healer around?	</danger>

901.source_en: <dead>	How can you feed me when you're dead?	</dead>

902.source_en: <dead>	I'm so sad!! Now I won't get any more food.	</dead>
902.translation_tr: <dead>	Cok uzgunum!! Artik daha fazla yemek alamayacagim.	</dead>

903.source_en: <stand>	Something to eat sounds good right about now..	</stand>
903.translation_tr: <stand>	Su anda yiyecek bir sey cok iyi olurdu..	</stand>

904.source_en: <stand>	I look kind of short standing next to you, don't I?	</stand>
904.translation_tr: <stand>	Yaninda durunca biraz kisa gorunuyorum, degil mi?	</stand>

905.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back! How about some grub?	</connect>
905.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin! Biraz yemek nasil olur?	</connect>

906.source_en: <connect>	Woohoo! I knew you would stop by today!	</connect>

907.source_en: <levelup>	Yay! Does this mean more food?	</levelup>
907.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin! Bu daha fazla yemek demek mi?	</levelup>

908.source_en: <levelup>	Wow you are getting bigger, just like me!	</levelup>

912.source_en: <feeding>	Delicious and nutritious! Tastes just like chicken!!	</feeding>
912.translation_tr: <feeding>	Lezzetli ve besleyici! Tadi tavuk gibi!!	</feeding>

913.source_en: <hunting>	*rwar* let me at 'em, I'll give'em a one-two snouting!	</hunting>

914.source_en: <hunting>	*rwar!* They don't call me savage for nothing you know!	</hunting>

915.source_en: <danger>	Err, Be careful that looks dangerous.	</danger>

917.source_en: <dead>	Why wont you get up... Are you hurt?	</dead>

918.source_en: <dead>	Why wont you open your eyes? Please open your eyes...I'm so sad...	</dead>
918.translation_tr: <dead>	Neden gozlerini acmiyorsun? Lutfen ac... cok uzgunum...	</dead>

919.source_en: <dead>	That was a cheap shot! I want a referee, where in the rules does it say that's allowed?	</dead>
919.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu hileli bir vurus! Hakem istiyorum, kurallarin neresinde buna izin var?	</dead>

920.source_en: <stand>	Whoa, watch it, I'm still down here you know. ^^	</stand>
920.translation_tr: <stand>	Vay, dikkat et, hala asagidayim biliyorsun. ^^	</stand>

921.source_en: <stand>	Let's go for a walk, it's nice out today.	</stand>
921.translation_tr: <stand>	Hadi yuruyuse cikalim, bugun hava guzel.	</stand>

922.source_en: <stand>	Look at us we are cool.	</stand>

924.source_en: <connect>	Here ye here ye, my master logeth on!!	</connect>
924.translation_tr: <connect>	Duyduk duymadik demeyin, efendim giris yapti!!	</connect>

925.source_en: <connect>	You're BACK! I would give a hug but I don't think I can reach around you...	</connect>
925.translation_tr: <connect>	GERI DONDUN! Sarilirdim ama etrafina yetisebilecegimi sanmiyorum...	</connect>

931.source_en: <danger>	Ouch, you look like you're in pain, want me to find you some apples?	</danger>
931.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah, acin var gibi, sana elma bulayim mi?	</danger>

932.source_en: <dead>	Excuse me, does anyone have a yggdrasil leaf to use on my master? Can you accept payments in cuteness?	</dead>
932.translation_tr: <dead>	Affedersiniz, efendimde kullanmak icin Yggdrasil Leaf'i olan var mi? Odeme olarak tatlilik kabul eder misiniz?	</dead>

933.source_en: <stand>	Aw, I was just getting comfortable.	</stand>

934.source_en: <stand>	Let's go play tag! You're it!	</stand>

935.source_en: <stand>	I'm so sleepy, can't we rest a little?	</stand>
935.translation_tr: <stand>	Cok uykum var, biraz dinlenemez miyiz?	</stand>

936.source_en: <connect>	You're back, yay, now we can go explore the world together!	</connect>
936.translation_tr: <connect>	Geri geldin, yasasin, simdi dunyayi birlikte kesfedebiliriz!	</connect>

937.source_en: <levelup>	I can't wait till I'm a savage, I know I'll be able to protect you then.	</levelup>
937.translation_tr: <levelup>	Savage olacagim gunu sabirsizlikla bekliyorum, o zaman seni koruyabilirim.	</levelup>

940.source_en: <feeding>	If you keep feeding me like that, I'm going to get really fat...	</feeding>
940.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni boyle beslemeye devam edersen gercekten sismanlayacagim...	</feeding>

941.source_en: <hunting>	I think I'm going to pass out, can we take a break?	</hunting>

942.source_en: <danger>	AAH!! I can't help, I'm so stuffed! Please be careful!	</danger>
942.translation_tr: <danger>	AAH!! Yardim edemiyorum, tikabasa doydum! Lutfen dikkat et!	</danger>

943.source_en: <dead>	I told you to be careful... at least I can let my food digest now...	</dead>
943.translation_tr: <dead>	Dikkat et demistim... en azindan simdi yemegimi sindirebilirim...	</dead>

944.source_en: <stand>	I need to sit down for a while.	</stand>

945.source_en: <stand>	I need to go on a diet!	</stand>

946.source_en: <stand>	I hope one day I'll grow into a big Savage! But I don't know if I want to though... they look scary.	</stand>
946.translation_tr: <stand>	Umarim bir gun buyuk bir Savage olurum! Ama isteyip istemedigimi bilmiyorum... korkunc gorunuyorlar.	</stand>

947.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back!... don't even think about feeding me.	</connect>
947.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin!... beni beslemeyi aklindan bile gecirme.	</connect>

953.source_en: <feeding>	I was starting to like the taste of sand...	</feeding>

954.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you very, very much. I was starving.	</feeding>
954.translation_tr: <feeding>	Cok ama cok tesekkurler. Acliktan oluyordum.	</feeding>

955.source_en: <feeding>	I'll stop barking if you feed me more... maybe...	</feeding>
955.translation_tr: <feeding>	Biraz daha beslersen havlamayi birakirim... belki...	</feeding>

956.source_en: <feeding>	*whine* Why did you wait so long to feed me?	</feeding>
956.translation_tr: <feeding>	*inler* Beni beslemek icin neden bu kadar bekledin?	</feeding>

958.source_en: <hunting>	Kibbles and bits and bits and bits...kibbles and bits and bits and bits...	</hunting>
958.translation_tr: <hunting>	Mama ve parcalar, parcalar, parcalar... mama ve parcalar...	</hunting>

960.source_en: <danger>	You're bleeding badly! If we cut it off, can I eat it?	</danger>
960.translation_tr: <danger>	Cok kaniyorsun! Kesersek ben yiyebilir miyim?	</danger>

961.source_en: <danger>	If you die. Can I chew on your shoe?...or leg...hmm...	</danger>
961.translation_tr: <danger>	Olursen ayakkabini kemirebilir miyim?... ya da bacagini... hmm...	</danger>

962.source_en: <danger>	That's it. just a little more...then I feed.	</danger>
962.translation_tr: <danger>	Iste bu. Biraz daha... sonra yemek.	</danger>

964.source_en: <dead>	I can't let your meat go to waste, momma taught me better then to waste good food and you didn't feed me yet.	</dead>
964.translation_tr: <dead>	Etinin ziyan olmasina izin veremem, annem iyi yemegi ziyan etmemeyi ogretti ve beni daha beslemedin.	</dead>

965.source_en: <dead>	Hey, you can play dead too, but I'm the one that wants the treat!	</dead>
965.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, sen de olu taklidi yapabiliyorsun ama odulu isteyen benim!	</dead>

966.source_en: <dead>	Sorry... but you didn't feed me and I'm REALLY hungry... so, I gotta eat you!	</dead>
966.translation_tr: <dead>	Uzgunum... ama beni beslemedin ve COK acim... o yuzden seni yemeliyim!	</dead>

968.source_en: <stand>	What's that thing wiggling behind me ! It looks tasty!	</stand>
968.translation_tr: <stand>	Arkamda sallanan o sey ne! Lezzetli gorunuyor!	</stand>

969.source_en: <stand>	So... how about we get me something to eat?	</stand>
969.translation_tr: <stand>	Peki... bana yiyecek bir sey bulsak nasil olur?	</stand>

970.translation_tr: <stand>	Neyin harika oldugunu biliyor musun? Yemek.	</stand>

972.source_en: <stand>	You should feed me soon, otherwise you might find a present in your shoe.	</stand>
972.translation_tr: <stand>	Yakinda beni beslemelisin, yoksa ayakkabinda bir hediye bulabilirsin.	</stand>

973.source_en: <connect>	Knock knock... who's there?... feed... feed who? FEED ME!	</connect>
973.translation_tr: <connect>	Tak tak... kim o?... besle... kimi besle? BENI BESLE!	</connect>

975.source_en: <connect>	Hey, I left you a little present in your shoe for not feeding me to show you my appreciation.	</connect>
975.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, beni beslemedigin icin minnettarligimi gostermek uzere ayakkabina kucuk bir hediye biraktim.	</connect>

977.source_en: <levelup>	ARF! let's celebrate with a MEAL for crying out loud.	</levelup>
977.translation_tr: <levelup>	HAV! Hadi artik bir YEMEKLE kutlayalim.	</levelup>

978.source_en: <levelup>	Good for you...when do I get my treat?	</levelup>
978.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin adina guzel... benim odulum ne zaman?	</levelup>

979.source_en: <levelup>	*bark* feed me... I mean, *bark* good job!	</levelup>

980.source_en: <levelup>	Well, lookie who gained a level, does this mean I get my treat now? *pant*	</levelup>
980.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bak kim level atlamis, bu simdi odulumu alacagim demek mi? *solur*	</levelup>

983.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks , wouldn't complain there was a bit more...	</feeding>
983.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler, biraz daha olsa itiraz etmezdim...	</feeding>

984.source_en: <feeding>	You're so kind to feed me an hour late...	</feeding>
984.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni sadece bir saat gec besledigin icin cok naziksin...	</feeding>

985.source_en: <feeding>	If you had waited any longer I would have chewed your shoes... but since you didn't, we're alright... for now.	</feeding>
985.translation_tr: <feeding>	Biraz daha bekleseydin ayakkabilarini kemirirdim... ama beklemedin, simdilik iyiyiz.	</feeding>

987.source_en: <hunting>	If I help out do I get a treat? Some meat? Yes yes?? *pant*	</hunting>
987.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yardim edersem odul alir miyim? Biraz et? Evet evet?? *solur*	</hunting>

988.source_en: <hunting>	When are you going to kill something I can eat?	</hunting>
988.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ne zaman yiyebilecegim bir sey oldureceksin?	</hunting>

990.source_en: <hunting>	I smell evil lurking around... or is that just you? Did you forget to shower again? *wrinkle nose*	</hunting>
990.translation_tr: <hunting>	Etrafta kotuluk kokusu var... yoksa sen misin? Yine dus almayi mi unuttun? *burnunu kiristirir*	</hunting>

991.source_en: <danger>	Oh, you look like you're hurt, please don't die... at least throw me a bone if you're going to.	</danger>
991.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah, yaralanmis gibisin, lutfen olme... oleceksen en azindan bana bir kemik at.	</danger>

992.source_en: <danger>	Do you mind if I chew on your leg when you die?	</danger>
992.translation_tr: <danger>	Olursen bacagini kemirsem sorun olur mu?	</danger>

993.source_en: <danger>	If you die, I'm going to use you as a tree...	</danger>

995.source_en: <dead>	Stop playing dead ... I hope this is just an illusion caused by hunger .. ?	</dead>
995.translation_tr: <dead>	Olu taklidi yapmayi birak... umarim bu sadece acliktan gordugum bir hayaldir..?	</dead>

996.source_en: <dead>	Wow... you are good at playing dead.	</dead>

997.source_en: <dead>	Well this is great. You're dead and I'm going to starve.	</dead>
997.translation_tr: <dead>	Harika. Sen oldun, ben de acliktan olecegim.	</dead>

999.source_en: <stand>	*Grrrrr ...*" it wasn't me... it was my stomach.	</stand>

1000.source_en: <stand>	I smell chicken... where is it?	</stand>

1001.source_en: <stand>	Barking is the only thing I can do to keep my mind off my hunger...*whine*	</stand>
1001.translation_tr: <stand>	Acligimi dusunmemek icin yapabildigim tek sey havlamak... *inler*	</stand>

1003.source_en: <connect>	What's on the menu today , master ?	</connect>

1004.source_en: <connect>	Hiya!! Let's have some monster feed today! Pleeeeease! *pants* Pleeeease!	</connect>
1004.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam!! Bugun biraz canavar eti yiyelim! Lutfeeeen! *solur* Lutfeeen!	</connect>

1005.source_en: <connect>	Good day master! Let's go bark at things!	</connect>
1005.translation_tr: <connect>	Iyi gunler efendim! Hadi bir seylere havlayalim!	</connect>

1008.source_en: <levelup>	Woof! Woof! This calls for a feast!	</levelup>
1008.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hav! Hav! Bu bir ziyafet gerektirir!	</levelup>

1009.source_en: <levelup>	Sweet! Let's celebrate with some grubbin'!	</levelup>

1010.source_en: <levelup>	Whoopee, now we can get some food!	</levelup>

1016.source_en: <feeding>	That was grrreat master, wonderfully tastey.	</feeding>

1018.source_en: <hunting>	Send that baddie to the dog house!	</hunting>

1019.source_en: <hunting>	I've been fed so well I can take on anything! WoofWoof!	</hunting>
1019.translation_tr: <hunting>	O kadar iyi beslendim ki her seyle kapisabilirim! HavHav!	</hunting>

1021.source_en: <danger>	Should we Retreat for now? I don't want you to die.	</danger>
1021.translation_tr: <danger>	Simdilik geri cekilelim mi? Olmeni istemiyorum.	</danger>

1022.source_en: <danger>	Aiyah!! Aiyah!! Wahh! My master's hurt! Can someone heal my master please...?	</danger>
1022.translation_tr: <danger>	Aiyah!! Aiyah!! Vahh! Efendim yaralandi! Biri lutfen efendimi iyilestirebilir mi...?	</danger>

1023.source_en: <danger>	Oh!! Be careful! I can't let my food source die! What can I do to help?	</danger>
1023.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah!! Dikkat et! Yemek kaynagimin olmesine izin veremem! Nasil yardim edebilirim?	</danger>

1024.source_en: <danger>	Oh no, you're in the red! Please heal yourself!!	</danger>
1024.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah hayir, kirmizidasin! Lutfen kendini iyilestir!!	</danger>

1026.source_en: <dead>	Do you know what's been on that floor? That's gross.	</dead>
1026.translation_tr: <dead>	O zeminde neler oldugunu biliyor musun? Igrenc.	</dead>

1027.source_en: <dead>	Do you see a light at the other end?	</dead>
1027.translation_tr: <dead>	Diger tarafta bir isik goruyor musun?	</dead>

1028.source_en: <dead>	AwWwWwwooOooOOOooo!! I'm so sad my master's dead.	</dead>

1030.source_en: <stand>	This is fun... hanging out together like this ..	</stand>

1031.source_en: <stand>	Throw a dead branch and I'll got fetch it.	</stand>
1031.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir Dead Branch at, gidip getireyim.	</stand>

1032.source_en: <stand>	I must say, you're a good listener.	</stand>

1034.source_en: <stand>	Ah, lets go dig a hole!	</stand>

1035.source_en: <stand>	Do hunter falcons ever stop flying? Why is the grass green? Why is the sky blue? Am I annoying?	</stand>
1035.translation_tr: <stand>	Hunter falconlari hic ucmayi birakir mi? Ot neden yesil? Gok neden mavi? Sinir bozucu muyum?	</stand>

1038.source_en: <connect>	Greetings master! What's on the agenda? Frisbee? Barking at things?	</connect>
1038.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam efendim! Programda ne var? Frisbee mi? Bir seylere havlamak mi?	</connect>

1041.source_en: <levelup>	The correct term here is "w00t", not "Woof" right?	</levelup>
1041.translation_tr: <levelup>	Burada dogru terim "w00t", "Hav" degil, degil mi?	</levelup>

1044.source_en: <levelup>	I saw an angel! Did you make a wish?	</levelup>
1044.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir melek gordum! Dilek tuttun mu?	</levelup>

1047.source_en: <feeding>	I'm so full, thank you that was nice.	</feeding>

1048.source_en: <feeding>	Hey...I think that was the biggest meal I've ever had.	</feeding>
1048.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey... sanirim hayatimda yedigim en buyuk yemekti.	</feeding>

1049.source_en: <feeding>	Wow...I can't even think of eating you anymore...I mean, just... anymore...	</feeding>
1049.translation_tr: <feeding>	Vay... artik seni yemeyi dusunemiyorum bile... yani... artik...	</feeding>

1051.source_en: <hunting>	Let's go hunting some big monsters!	</hunting>

1052.source_en: <hunting>	Focus, focus, you must have focus!	</hunting>

1053.source_en: <hunting>	Hunting with you is fun...but lets play fetch!	</hunting>
1053.translation_tr: <hunting>	Seninle avlanmak eglenceli... ama hadi getir oyunu oynayalim!	</hunting>

1054.source_en: <hunting>	Can I go dig a hole?	</hunting>

1055.source_en: <danger>	If only I wasn't so full! I'd be faster!!	</danger>
1055.translation_tr: <danger>	Keske bu kadar tok olmasaydim! Daha hizli olurdum!!	</danger>

1056.source_en: <danger>	Good thing I brought a potion... AH! Where did it go?	</danger>
1056.translation_tr: <danger>	Iksir getirmem iyi oldu... AH! Nereye gitti?	</danger>

1057.source_en: <danger>	Lookout! You're about to make an orphan of me!	</danger>

1058.source_en: <danger>	Please don't leave me, I don't know where I'll go.	</danger>
1058.translation_tr: <danger>	Lutfen beni birakma, nereye gidecegimi bilmiyorum.	</danger>

1060.source_en: <dead>	It's okay, I'll just use that yggadrisil leaf and... ah...uh... I forgot... I don't have pockets!	</dead>
1060.translation_tr: <dead>	Sorun yok, su Yggdrasil Leaf'i kullanirim ve... ah... ee... unuttum... cebim yok!	</dead>

1061.source_en: <dead>	I will keep barking until you wake up. SO WAKE UP ALREADY!!!	</dead>
1061.translation_tr: <dead>	Uyanana kadar havlamaya devam edecegim. ARTIK UYAN!!!	</dead>

1064.source_en: <stand>	Let's go visit my friends, the Muka Muka.	</stand>
1064.translation_tr: <stand>	Hadi arkadaslarim Muka Muka'lari ziyaret edelim.	</stand>

1066.source_en: <stand>	I love the sunlight, so warm, so relaxing...	</stand>
1066.translation_tr: <stand>	Gunes isigini seviyorum, cok sicak ve rahatlatan...	</stand>

1068.source_en: <connect>	Hey, you're out of the dog house, let's go hunting!	</connect>
1068.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, kulubeden ciktin, hadi ava gidelim!	</connect>

1069.source_en: <connect>	Have you come to feed me? I sure hope not...	</connect>
1069.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni beslemeye mi geldin? Umarim degildir...	</connect>

1071.source_en: <levelup>	I am so Happy for you!	</levelup>

1072.source_en: <levelup>	Who da man? Who da man!? You are!	</levelup>
1072.translation_tr: <levelup>	Kim en iyisi? Kim en iyisi!? Sensin!	</levelup>

1073.source_en: <levelup>	Good job! Now you can get me that golden doghouse I've wanted...	</levelup>
1073.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi is! Simdi istedigim o altin kulubeyi bana alabilirsin...	</levelup>

1077.source_en: <feeding>	Why are you torturing me !! Go feed newbies instead!	</feeding>
1077.translation_tr: <feeding>	Neden bana iskence ediyorsun!! Git acemileri besle!	</feeding>

1079.source_en: <feeding>	I see...you're fattening me up... you're going to eat me...bad owner! No biscut!	</feeding>
1079.translation_tr: <feeding>	Anladim... beni sismanlatiyorsun... beni yiyeceksin... kotu sahip! Biskuvi yok!	</feeding>

1081.source_en: <hunting>	Don't make me move .. please ? feel like I'm going to b'Arf	</hunting>
1081.translation_tr: <hunting>	Beni hareket ettirme.. lutfen? Havlayacak gibi oluyorum	</hunting>

1082.source_en: <hunting>	I can help you. I'll just sit on the bad guys with my enormous weight!	</hunting>
1082.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana yardim edebilirim. Kotu adamlarin ustune devasa agirligimla otururum!	</hunting>

1083.source_en: <hunting>	Gotta work off this weight...look good to the other wolves..	</hunting>
1083.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu kilolari vermem gerek... diger kurtlara iyi gorunmeliyim..	</hunting>

1085.source_en: <danger>	Just let yourself get killed ... I... cant... run... too FAT.	</danger>
1085.translation_tr: <danger>	Birak kendini oldursunlar... ben... kosamam... cok SISMAGIM.	</danger>

1086.source_en: <danger>	Like.. whoa... I don't think bleeding is a good thing.	</danger>
1086.translation_tr: <danger>	Vay be... kanamanin iyi bir sey oldugunu sanmiyorum.	</danger>

1087.source_en: <danger>	I'd bark to warn you, but I'm too stuffed...	</danger>
1087.translation_tr: <danger>	Seni uyarmak icin havlardim ama tikabasa doluyum...	</danger>

1089.source_en: <dead>	~Blwargh~... Ugh .. Oh , that's not good to see ...	</dead>

1091.source_en: <dead>	Master, what is the difference between girl puppies and male puppies?	</dead>
1091.translation_tr: <dead>	Efendim, disi yavru kopeklerle erkek yavru kopekler arasindaki fark nedir?	</dead>

1092.source_en: <dead>	Good thing you fed me so much beforehand.	</dead>
1092.translation_tr: <dead>	Iyi ki onceden beni bu kadar cok beslemissin.	</dead>

1094.source_en: <stand>	Are you going to eat me ? ... **stares**	</stand>

1095.source_en: <stand>	I feel so heavy...barking will help me lose the weight, right?	</stand>
1095.translation_tr: <stand>	Kendimi cok agir hissediyorum... havlamak kilo vermeme yardim eder, degil mi?	</stand>

1097.source_en: <stand>	Lunatics are great chew toys. They even do this funny "squeak!" noise.	</stand>
1097.translation_tr: <stand>	Lunaticler harika cigneme oyuncaklari. Bir de komik bir "cik!" sesi cikariyorlar.	</stand>

1098.source_en: <stand>	Ok we split the loot 0/100 ok?	</stand>

1099.source_en: <stand>	Do I look a little oversized to you?	</stand>

1101.source_en: <connect>	I think I had an accident while you were gone...	</connect>
1101.translation_tr: <connect>	Sen yokken sanirim bir kaza yaptim...	</connect>

1102.source_en: <connect>	I'd get up to greet you but I am feeling really fat right now...	</connect>
1102.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni karsilamak icin kalkardim ama su an gercekten cok sisman hissediyorum...	</connect>

1104.source_en: <levelup>	This means .. more powerful , more loot , more money ... more .. food ? NOOOOOO!!	</levelup>
1104.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bu demek oluyor ki.. daha guclu, daha cok ganimet, daha cok para... daha cok... yemek? HAYIIIR!!	</levelup>

1105.source_en: <levelup>	Hooray! Hooray! Hip... or was it the other way around?	</levelup>
1105.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin! Yasasin! Hip... yoksa ters miydi?	</levelup>

1112.source_en: <feeding>	'Ey man, could ye' drop me some more o' that great stuff? My stomach is singing a song o' hunger!	</feeding>
1112.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey dostum, o harika seylerden biraz daha verir misin? Midem aclik sarkisi soyluyor!	</feeding>

1114.source_en: <feeding>	I need more foood... to rock your world!	</feeding>
1114.translation_tr: <feeding>	Dunyani sallamak icin daha cok yemeeege ihtiyacim var...	</feeding>

1115.source_en: <hunting>	Oh yeah, some o' that great food, can ye' let me have it?	</hunting>
1115.translation_tr: <hunting>	Oh evet, o guzel yemekten biraz bana verir misin?	</hunting>

1117.source_en: <hunting>	Being a rocker is tough living... you only get to hop...my legs are tired and I'm hungry	</hunting>
1117.translation_tr: <hunting>	Rocker olmak zor hayat... sadece zipliyorsun... bacaklarim yoruldu ve acim	</hunting>

1118.source_en: <danger>	'Ey man, ye' look horrible! Get something to heal ye' up!	</danger>
1118.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey dostum, berbat gorunuyorsun! Kendini iyilestirecek bir sey bul!	</danger>

1119.source_en: <danger>	If ye're not paying attention to ye're life, ye'gonna die!	</danger>

1121.source_en: <dead>	Want me to play you a lullaby?	</dead>

1122.source_en: <stand>	Give me some food fer' god-poing's sake!	</stand>
1122.translation_tr: <stand>	God-Poing askina bana biraz yemek ver!	</stand>

1123.source_en: <connect>	How's it goin' man! Let's go get something to eat!	</connect>
1123.translation_tr: <connect>	Nasil gidiyor dostum! Hadi yiyecek bir seyler bulalim!	</connect>

1125.source_en: <levelup>	Ah! We get to have a party for that, ye drink the wine, I eat the food, eh?	</levelup>
1125.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah! Bunun icin parti yapariz, sen sarabi icersin, ben yemegi yerim, tamam mi?	</levelup>

1129.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks man! Ye' shoulda got me some stuff like this sooner!	</feeding>
1129.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler dostum! Bana boyle seyleri daha once almaliydin!	</feeding>

1130.source_en: <feeding>	I smell food man! Come on, brother! Feed me!	</feeding>
1130.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yemek kokusu aliyorum dostum! Hadi kardesim! Beni besle!	</feeding>

1131.source_en: <feeding>	A rocker always appreciates good food.	</feeding>
1131.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bir rocker iyi yemegin kiymetini her zaman bilir.	</feeding>

1132.source_en: <hunting>	Whoa, that looks gross... can I... maybe eat its leg?	</hunting>
1132.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay, bu igrenc gorunuyor... belki... bacagini yiyebilir miyim?	</hunting>

1133.source_en: <hunting>	I need some items to make my new fiddle, Oooh there's some.	</hunting>
1133.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yeni kemanim icin bazi esyalara ihtiyacim var, oooh iste orada.	</hunting>

1134.source_en: <danger>	Uh oh, grab our food and run!	</danger>

1136.source_en: <dead>	Aww, how can ye' sleep at a time like this. Yer'pal needs dinner!	</dead>
1136.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah, boyle bir zamanda nasil uyuyabiliyorsun? Dostunun yemeye ihtiyaci var!	</dead>

1137.source_en: <dead>	This makes me want to write a sad song... but I'm too hungry to think...	</dead>
1137.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu bana huzunlu bir sarki yazdiriyor... ama dusunemeyecek kadar acim...	</dead>

1138.source_en: <dead>	Noooo...now who's gonna listen to m'tunes...	</dead>

1139.source_en: <stand>	I hear jellopies are edible, is that true...I wonder..	</stand>
1139.translation_tr: <stand>	Jellopylerin yenilebilir oldugunu duydum, dogru mu acaba...	</stand>

1140.source_en: <stand>	If you're just going to stand there, I'm gonna make me some fried jellopies.	</stand>
1140.translation_tr: <stand>	Orada oylece duracaksan kendime kizarmis Jellopy yapacagim.	</stand>

1141.source_en: <stand>	Care to enjoy a tune with me while doing nothing?	</stand>
1141.translation_tr: <stand>	Hicbir sey yapmazken benimle bir melodi dinlemek ister misin?	</stand>

1142.source_en: <connect>	Good morning, mate! Er... could I have that apple?	</connect>
1142.translation_tr: <connect>	Gunaydin dostum! Ee... o elmayi alabilir miyim?	</connect>

1144.source_en: <levelup>	Somehow me feels like this is a situation where ye' should celebrate by offerin' some food to everyone... especially me.	</levelup>
1144.translation_tr: <levelup>	Nedense bu, herkese... ozellikle bana yemek ikram ederek kutlaman gereken bir durum gibi geliyor.	</levelup>

1145.source_en: <levelup>	Some day I'll write a song about you, but first... some food?	</levelup>
1145.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir gun senin hakkinda bir sarki yazacagim ama once... biraz yemek?	</levelup>

1148.source_en: <feeding>	Ye' have always this tasty stuff for me, mate!	</feeding>
1148.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bana hep bu lezzetli seylerden getiriyorsun dostum!	</feeding>

1150.source_en: <feeding>	...I was about to eat my leaf thing.	</feeding>

1151.source_en: <hunting>	Whoa.. I think ye' can handle those monsters better than me, eh?	</hunting>
1151.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay.. sanirim o canavarlarla benden daha iyi basa cikiyorsun, ha?	</hunting>

1152.source_en: <hunting>	AND MY MASTER HUNTS IN THE NIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIGHT! Like it? It's my new song!	</hunting>
1152.translation_tr: <hunting>	VE EFENDIM GEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEECE AVLAR! Begendin mi? Yeni sarkim!	</hunting>

1153.source_en: <hunting>	Hmm... ye're almost at my lvl!	</hunting>

1154.source_en: <danger>	Ye'better hide. You look like ye're about to kick it mate!	</danger>
1154.translation_tr: <danger>	Saklansan iyi olur. Olmek uzere gibisin dostum!	</danger>

1155.source_en: <danger>	Priest needed over here, otherwise I'm just gonna play my violin until someone notices...	</danger>
1155.translation_tr: <danger>	Buraya bir Priest lazim, yoksa biri fark edene kadar keman calacagim...	</danger>

1157.source_en: <dead>	I'm gonna play a dark tune to fit the mood....	</dead>
1157.translation_tr: <dead>	Ortama uysun diye karanlik bir melodi calacagim....	</dead>

1158.source_en: <dead>	There once was a nice ol'friend... and then death took m'friend's life... *sniffle*	</dead>
1158.translation_tr: <dead>	Bir zamanlar iyi bir dost vardi... sonra olum dostumu aldi... *burnunu ceker*	</dead>

1159.source_en: <stand>	Have ye' ever though how it would be like if ye' were me and I were ye?	</stand>
1159.translation_tr: <stand>	Sen ben, ben de sen olsaydik nasil olurdu hic dusundun mu?	</stand>

1161.source_en: <stand>	Could you buy me a new fiddle sometime?	</stand>
1161.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir ara bana yeni bir keman alabilir misin?	</stand>

1163.source_en: <connect>	I wrote a song while you were gone, I'll play it for you later.	</connect>
1163.translation_tr: <connect>	Sen yokken bir sarki yazdim, sonra sana calacagim.	</connect>

1164.source_en: <levelup>	Ha, there ye' see, mate. Ye' couldn't live without yer loyal bodyguard.	</levelup>
1164.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ha, gordun mu dostum. Sadik koruman olmadan yasayamazdin.	</levelup>

1165.source_en: <levelup>	We are, WILD SAVAGES! *air guitar solo*	</levelup>

1168.source_en: <feeding>	Whoa whoa there, me thinks that's startin' to be enough even for me, don't ye' think?	</feeding>
1168.translation_tr: <feeding>	Vay vay, sanirim bu benim icin bile yeterli olmaya basladi, sence de oyle degil mi?	</feeding>

1170.source_en: <hunting>	Why ye' going so fast mate? Ye' think I can carry my stomach this fast, eh man?	</hunting>
1170.translation_tr: <hunting>	Neden bu kadar hizlisin dostum? Bu mideyle bu kadar hizli gidebilecegimi mi saniyorsun?	</hunting>

1171.source_en: <hunting>	Dude, Without my music wouldn't you be bored?..	</hunting>
1171.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dostum, benim muzik olmadan sikilmaz miydin?..	</hunting>

1172.source_en: <hunting>	How about 50/50 on the loot, with my musical talent fee, that comes out to about 20/80.	</hunting>
1172.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ganimeti 50/50 paylasalim, muzik yetenek ucretimle birlikte 20/80 oluyor.	</hunting>

1173.source_en: <danger>	C'mon, ye' always drag me here when I'm stuffed.	</danger>
1173.translation_tr: <danger>	Hadi ama, beni hep tikabasa doluyken buraya surukluyorsun.	</danger>

1174.source_en: <danger>	Stay back, my violins harder than it looks!	</danger>
1174.translation_tr: <danger>	Geri dur, kemanim gorundugunden daha sert!	</danger>

1175.source_en: <dead>	There ye see mate, ye' should have fed me properly. 'Tis hard to protect ye' being this full.	</dead>
1175.translation_tr: <dead>	Gordun mu dostum, beni duzgun beslemeliydin. Bu kadar tokken seni korumak zor.	</dead>

1176.source_en: <dead>	Good... now I can sleep in peace. Zzz...	</dead>
1176.translation_tr: <dead>	Guzel... simdi huzur icinde uyuyabilirim. Zzz...	</dead>

1177.source_en: <dead>	I'm gonna serenade you back to life..	</dead>

1178.source_en: <stand>	Ugh... me can't hold m'own weight.	</stand>

1179.source_en: <stand>	Me feelers tells me that its going to be another great day... but I could be wrong...or right...whatever...	</stand>
1179.translation_tr: <stand>	Hislerim bugunun yine harika olacagini soyluyor... ama yaniliyor da olabilirim... ya da hakli... neyse...	</stand>

1180.source_en: <stand>	How's things in the real world?	</stand>

1181.translation_tr: <connect>	*gegirir* Selam dostum, ne var ne yok?	</connect>

1182.source_en: <levelup>	Ye' can get ye' levels on other monsters, but don't ye' try to on me. Ye'd get crushed.	</levelup>
1182.translation_tr: <levelup>	Levellerini baska canavarlardan al, bana deneme. Ezilirsin.	</levelup>

1183.source_en: <levelup>	Nice job. Maybe someday ye' can level me up.	</levelup>
1183.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi is. Belki bir gun beni de level atlattirirsin.	</levelup>

1186.source_en: <feeding>	Ye' tryin' to kill me mate? Buy me a bigger stomach and I'll eat ye' food!	</feeding>
1186.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni oldurmeye mi calisiyorsun dostum? Bana daha buyuk bir mide al, yemegini yerim!	</feeding>

1187.source_en: <feeding>	Boy, I feel so stuffed that I can't even lift up my violin.	</feeding>
1187.translation_tr: <feeding>	Dostum, o kadar tokum ki kemanimi bile kaldiramiyorum.	</feeding>

1188.source_en: <hunting>	C'mon mate, let me rest for a while, feels like I'm poppin'.	</hunting>
1188.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hadi dostum, biraz dinlenmeme izin ver, patlayacak gibiyim.	</hunting>

1189.source_en: <hunting>	Could you slow down a bit, hopping on a full tummy is bad for ya...	</hunting>
1189.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biraz yavaslar misin, tok mideyle ziplamak iyi degil...	</hunting>

1190.source_en: <danger>	Ye' want me to roll on them?	</danger>

1191.source_en: <danger>	Now where did we put the potions?	</danger>

1192.source_en: <dead>	Urgh.. Can I sit on ye' for a while? My stomach is rippin' apart mate, thanks!	</dead>
1192.translation_tr: <dead>	Off.. Biraz ustune oturabilir miyim? Midem parcalaniyor dostum, sag ol!	</dead>

1193.source_en: <dead>	I found the potion!... ah, too late...	</dead>

1194.source_en: <stand>	Ye' feel how the ground goes lower when me stands on it?	</stand>
1194.translation_tr: <stand>	Ben ustune basinca zeminin nasil coktugunu hissediyor musun?	</stand>

1196.source_en: <connect>	Don't ya' dare to make me walk now! I'm stuffed.	</connect>
1196.translation_tr: <connect>	Simdi beni yurutmeye kalkma! Tikabasa doydum.	</connect>

1197.source_en: <levelup>	At least ye' got somethin' to celebrate, I just have my flabby abs...	</levelup>
1197.translation_tr: <levelup>	En azindan senin kutlayacak bir seyin var, benim sadece gevsek gobegim var...	</levelup>

1202.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, mmm! Need more food! I have two mouths!	</feeding>
1202.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm, mmm! Daha cok yemek lazim! Iki agzim var!	</feeding>

1203.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ver, ver, ver DAHA COK YEMEK!	</feeding>

1204.source_en: <feeding>	You don't really know what mushrooms eat, do you?	</feeding>
1204.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mantarlarin ne yedigini gercekten bilmiyorsun, degil mi?	</feeding>

1205.source_en: <hunting>	I found a Mistress Card earlier, I didn't think it was worth anything, so I tossed it. Was that alright?	</hunting>
1205.translation_tr: <hunting>	Az once bir Mistress Card buldum, degerli sanmadim ve attim. Sorun yoktur degil mi?	</hunting>

1206.source_en: <hunting>	Why are you fighting them and not feeding me?	</hunting>
1206.translation_tr: <hunting>	Neden onlarla savasiyorsun da beni beslemiyorsun?	</hunting>

1207.source_en: <hunting>	What a beautiful day it is. Sunlight is good for me. I'm a mushroom you know.	</hunting>
1207.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ne guzel bir gun. Gunes isigi bana iyi gelir. Ben bir mantarim, biliyorsun.	</hunting>

1208.source_en: <hunting>	Would you mind if I found something to eat if you're not going to feed me?	</hunting>
1208.translation_tr: <hunting>	Beni beslemeyeceksen kendime yiyecek bir sey bulsam sorun olur mu?	</hunting>

1209.source_en: <danger>	Quick, somebody! Give me some food, so I can help my master!	</danger>
1209.translation_tr: <danger>	Cabuk, biri bana yemek versin ki efendime yardim edeyim!	</danger>

1211.source_en: <dead>	Oh, when we get back in town, can you pick me up some food?	</dead>
1211.translation_tr: <dead>	Sehre dondugumuzde bana biraz yemek alabilir misin?	</dead>

1212.source_en: <dead>	Does this mean I get all the food?	</dead>
1212.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu butun yemegin bana kaldigi anlamina mi geliyor?	</dead>

1213.source_en: <stand>	I've got a rumbly in my tumbly!	</stand>

1214.source_en: <stand>	Don't know about you but I could eat a bigfoot right about now....	</stand>
1214.translation_tr: <stand>	Seni bilmem ama su an bir Bigfoot yiyebilirim....	</stand>

1215.source_en: <connect>	I bet you've eaten, how about me, now? Mmmm!	</connect>
1215.translation_tr: <connect>	Eminim sen yedin, simdi sira bende mi? Mmmm!	</connect>

1216.source_en: <connect>	It's about time, it's cold and I'm hungry	</connect>

1217.source_en: <connect>	Do I know you?... Whoa Deja Vu.	</connect>
1217.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni taniyor muyum?... Vay, deja vu.	</connect>

1218.source_en: <levelup>	Good job! How about some food to celebrate, hmm?	</levelup>
1218.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi is! Kutlamak icin biraz yemek nasil olur, hmm?	</levelup>

1222.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm! I haven't eaten this well since... well, forever!	</feeding>
1222.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm! Boyle iyi yemeyeli... yani, sonsuzluk oldu!	</feeding>

1226.source_en: <hunting>	I hope it drops some food...	</hunting>

1228.source_en: <hunting>	Wow... I LOVE you man, or woman... I can never tell you people apart.	</hunting>
1228.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay... Seni SEVIYORUM dostum, erkek ya da kadin... sizi birbirinizden ayiramiyorum.	</hunting>

1231.source_en: <dead>	Wait, don't die! I haven't been fed yet!	</dead>

1232.source_en: <dead>	That was so not my fault...	</dead>

1233.source_en: <dead>	Would you like a pillow or perhaps a cold drink?	</dead>
1233.translation_tr: <dead>	Bir yastik ya da soguk bir icecek ister misin?	</dead>

1234.source_en: <stand>	Whew, all this bobbing has given me an appetite! Mmmm!	</stand>
1234.translation_tr: <stand>	Oh, bu kadar sallanmak istahimi acti! Mmmm!	</stand>

1235.source_en: <stand>	We usually carry mushroom spores, can I eat them?	</stand>
1235.translation_tr: <stand>	Genelde mantar sporu tasiriz, onlari yiyebilir miyim?	</stand>

1236.source_en: <stand>	By the way... you could feed me...	</stand>

1237.source_en: <stand>	My legs are tired... Argh I forgot... I don't have any.	</stand>
1237.translation_tr: <stand>	Bacaklarim yoruldu... Ah unuttum... bacagim yok.	</stand>

1238.source_en: <stand>	You look bored, give me some food, hey at least it's something to do!!	</stand>
1238.translation_tr: <stand>	Sikiliyor gibisin, bana biraz yemek ver, en azindan yapacak bir sey olur!!	</stand>

1239.source_en: <connect>	Mmm-mm! You're just in time for dinner!	</connect>
1239.translation_tr: <connect>	Mmm-mm! Aksam yemegine tam zamaninda geldin!	</connect>

1240.source_en: <connect>	Thanks for coming, any later and I would be starving.	</connect>
1240.translation_tr: <connect>	Geldigin icin tesekkurler, biraz daha gec kalsan acliktan olecektim.	</connect>

1241.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back to the land of shrooms.	</connect>

1242.source_en: <levelup>	I think that angel is telling you to "feed the spore."	</levelup>
1242.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bence o melek sana "Spore'u besle" diyor.	</levelup>

1243.source_en: <levelup>	Nice work! Now if only you were rich and would feed me.	</levelup>
1243.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi is! Keske zengin olsan da beni beslesen.	</levelup>

1244.source_en: <levelup>	Soon you will be as strong as... err... err... whoever that strong guy is.	</levelup>
1244.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yakinda... ee... o guclu her kimse onun kadar guclu olacaksin.	</levelup>

1245.source_en: <levelup>	You have time to level up but no time for feeding me?... well anyways Congratulations.	</levelup>
1245.translation_tr: <levelup>	Level atlamaya vaktin var ama beni beslemeye yok mu?... Neyse, tebrikler.	</levelup>

1248.source_en: <feeding>	Mmmm! What is this? New recipe?	</feeding>
1248.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmmm! Bu ne? Yeni tarif mi?	</feeding>

1250.source_en: <feeding>	MMMmmm, this makes my hands tingle.... if I had any that is....I'm so sad. *sigh*	</feeding>
1250.translation_tr: <feeding>	MMMmmm, bu ellerimi karincalandiriyor... tabii elim olsaydi... cok uzgunum. *ic ceker*	</feeding>

1251.source_en: <hunting>	Yes! Yes! Aim for the left, now aim for the right!	</hunting>
1251.translation_tr: <hunting>	Evet! Evet! Sola nisangah al, simdi saga!	</hunting>

1252.source_en: <hunting>	You're almost as good as me.	</hunting>

1254.source_en: <danger>	Come with me if you want to live.	</danger>

1255.source_en: <danger>	Hey I know... HEAL!! nope doesn't work	</danger>
1255.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey biliyorum... HEAL!! yok, ise yaramadi	</danger>

1256.source_en: <danger>	Oh no, you're getting pretty low. Shall I feed you?	</danger>
1256.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah hayir, oldukca dustun. Seni besleyeyim mi?	</danger>

1257.source_en: <danger>	You're red, that means you're about to do a super cool move right?	</danger>
1257.translation_tr: <danger>	Kirmizisin, bu super bir hareket yapacagin anlamina geliyor, degil mi?	</danger>

1258.source_en: <dead>	So, where's that super cool move you were supposed to do?	</dead>
1258.translation_tr: <dead>	Peki, yapman gereken o super hareket nerede?	</dead>

1259.source_en: <dead>	You promised we'd have fun today, remember?	</dead>
1259.translation_tr: <dead>	Bugun eglenecegimize soz vermistin, hatirladin mi?	</dead>

1261.source_en: <dead>	O that I walk through the valley of death, I will fear no evil... because I can immediately respawn... hehe~	</dead>
1261.translation_tr: <dead>	Olum vadisinden gecsem bile kotulukten korkmam... cunku hemen respawn olabilirim... hehe~	</dead>

1262.source_en: <stand>	Hey, do you want to hear a joke? No? Tough crowd.	</stand>
1262.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, bir saka duymak ister misin? Hayir mi? Zor seyirci.	</stand>

1263.source_en: <stand>	I wonder when all the other spore kids will play with me?	</stand>
1263.translation_tr: <stand>	Diger Spore cocuklarinin benimle ne zaman oynayacagini merak ediyorum.	</stand>

1265.source_en: <connect>	Please keep your hands and arms inside the carpet.	</connect>
1265.translation_tr: <connect>	Lutfen ellerinizi ve kollarinizi halinin icinde tutun.	</connect>

1266.source_en: <connect>	Welcome, to your doom. Dum dum dum... how was that, scary?	</connect>
1266.translation_tr: <connect>	Felaketine hos geldin. Dum dum dum... nasildi, korkunc muydu?	</connect>

1269.source_en: <levelup>	You're as powerful as a fistful of green herbs... well I think it's powerful.	</levelup>
1269.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir avuc Green Herb kadar guclusun... yani, bence guclu.	</levelup>

1272.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, mmm! Now this is what I call food!	</feeding>
1272.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm, mmm! Iste buna yemek derim!	</feeding>

1273.translation_tr: <feeding>	*GEEEER* Tesekkurler ama lutfen daha fazla verme~	</feeding>

1274.source_en: <feeding>	I think I'm full. I wonder if mushrooms have stomachs.	</feeding>
1274.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sanirim doydum. Mantarlarin midesi var mi acaba.	</feeding>

1275.source_en: <hunting>	I'd help you, but I'm a pacifist spore.	</hunting>
1275.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana yardim ederdim ama ben bariscil bir Spore'um.	</hunting>

1276.source_en: <hunting>	POISION SPORE ATTACK! woops can't do that...	</hunting>
1276.translation_tr: <hunting>	POISON SPORE SALDIRISI! Whoops, bunu yapamiyorum...	</hunting>

1277.source_en: <hunting>	And another one goes, and another one goes, and another one bites the dust. Yea~	</hunting>
1277.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biri daha gitti, biri daha gitti, biri daha dustu. Evet~	</hunting>

1278.source_en: <danger>	Is there a healer on the map?!	</danger>

1279.source_en: <danger>	You could cut a piece of me...and eat it... if you want to...please don't die.	</danger>
1279.translation_tr: <danger>	Istersen benden bir parca kesip yiyebilirsin... lutfen olme.	</danger>

1281.source_en: <dead>	There goes again, sleeping and being lazy... oh, wait...	</dead>
1281.translation_tr: <dead>	Yine uyuyor ve tembellik ediyor... ah, bir dakika...	</dead>

1282.source_en: <dead>	Well of course I love you, but when you do things like this, I'm forced to give you a time out.	</dead>
1282.translation_tr: <dead>	Elbette seni seviyorum ama boyle seyler yapinca sana mola vermek zorunda kaliyorum.	</dead>

1283.source_en: <dead>	Try as I might, you still seem to get yourself killed..	</dead>
1283.translation_tr: <dead>	Ne kadar ugrasmis olsam da kendini oldurtmeyi basariyorsun..	</dead>

1284.source_en: <dead>	I could have saved you if I wasn't so stuffed.	</dead>
1284.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu kadar tok olmasaydim seni kurtarabilirdim.	</dead>

1285.source_en: <stand>	Alright, let's get a move on. I don't want to be standing around all day!	</stand>
1285.translation_tr: <stand>	Tamam, hareket edelim. Butun gun burada dikilmek istemiyorum!	</stand>

1286.source_en: <stand>	I heard that mushrooms make you giant when eaten..?... I don't like the way you're looking at me now...	</stand>
1286.translation_tr: <stand>	Mantarlar yenince seni dev yaparmis diye duydum..?... Bana bakis seklini simdi hic sevmedim...	</stand>

1287.source_en: <connect>	Hey! Welcome back, how was your flight? Meet anyone interesting?	</connect>
1287.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Hos geldin, yolculuk nasildi? Ilginc biriyle tanistin mi?	</connect>

1289.source_en: <connect>	ENTER THE SANDMAN!... er... I mean, my master...	</connect>
1289.translation_tr: <connect>	ENTER THE SANDMAN!... ee... yani, efendim...	</connect>

1290.source_en: <levelup>	Have you ever wondered where those trumpets come from? Pretty weird huh?	</levelup>
1290.translation_tr: <levelup>	O trompetlerin nereden geldigini hic merak ettin mi? Cok garip, degil mi?	</levelup>

1291.source_en: <levelup>	I salute you master! Aww, I forgot I don't have arms again...	</levelup>
1291.translation_tr: <levelup>	Sizi selamliyorum efendim! Ah, yine kollarim olmadigini unuttum...	</levelup>

1292.source_en: <levelup>	Will I every evolve into a strong human like you?... with arms?....	</levelup>
1292.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir gun senin gibi guclu bir insana evrimlesecek miyim?... kollari olan?....	</levelup>

1295.source_en: <feeding>	Urg, I feel a stomach cramp!	</feeding>

1297.source_en: <feeding>	Oh cruel world, why do you stuff me?... no really, why are you feeding me??	</feeding>
1297.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ah zalim dunya, neden beni tikabasa dolduruyorsun?... Gercekten, neden beni besliyorsun??	</feeding>

1298.source_en: <feeding>	Do you really hate me that much that you want to kill me from overfeeding? That's cruel...	</feeding>
1298.translation_tr: <feeding>	Benden bu kadar nefret mi ediyorsun da fazla besleyip oldurmek istiyorsun? Bu zalimce...	</feeding>

1299.source_en: <hunting>	Woooah, woooah! Wait up! I feel wobbly!	</hunting>

1300.source_en: <hunting>	Just a sec...need... to catch... my... breath...	</hunting>

1302.source_en: <danger>	Quick, start feeding yourself like you fed me!	</danger>
1302.translation_tr: <danger>	Cabuk, beni besledigin gibi kendini de beslemeye basla!	</danger>

1303.source_en: <danger>	... maybe now you'll stop feeding me.	</danger>

1304.source_en: <dead>	Does being resurrected give you exercise? Burp!	</dead>

1305.source_en: <dead>	You were too good for this cruel world~	</dead>
1305.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu zalim dunya icin fazla iyiydin~	</dead>

1307.source_en: <dead>	Please get up? I'll get eaten if I'm left alone too long.	</dead>
1307.translation_tr: <dead>	Lutfen kalkar misin? Cok uzun sure yalniz kalirsam beni yerler.	</dead>

1308.source_en: <stand>	No, no! Keep moving! I can feel my legs failing... oh wait, forgot I don't have legs again.	</stand>
1308.translation_tr: <stand>	Hayir, hayir! Hareket etmeye devam et! Bacaklarimin tukendigini hissediyorum... ah, yine bacaklarim olmadigini unuttum.	</stand>

1309.source_en: <stand>	You think a parasite might help me lose weight?	</stand>
1309.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence bir parazit kilo vermeme yardim eder mi?	</stand>

1310.source_en: <stand>	Phew... I love doing absolutely nothing!	</stand>

1311.source_en: <stand>	I don't think I can keep it down... I need an Acolyte fast... I'm gonna *bweuragh*... sorry...	</stand>
1311.translation_tr: <stand>	Sanirim midemde tutamayacagim... Cabuk bir Acolyte lazim... *bweuragh*... uzgunum...	</stand>

1312.source_en: <connect>	Good news! That exercise plan is really working! Mmmm!	</connect>
1312.translation_tr: <connect>	Iyi haber! O egzersiz plani gercekten ise yariyor! Mmmm!	</connect>

1313.source_en: <connect>	Alright! I'm pumped, let me get'em! after I nap...	</connect>
1313.translation_tr: <connect>	Tamam! Hazirim, birak onlara dalayim! Biraz uyuduktan sonra...	</connect>

1314.source_en: <connect>	Someone please help me, my master is trying to feed me till I explode!! It's cruel I tell you! CRUEL!!	</connect>
1314.translation_tr: <connect>	Biri lutfen bana yardim etsin, efendim patlayana kadar beni beslemeye calisiyor!! Bu zalimce! ZALIMCE!!	</connect>

1315.source_en: <levelup>	Is that my stomach?... Oh, no, it's just you.	</levelup>
1315.translation_tr: <levelup>	O benim midem mi?... Ah hayir, sadece sensin.	</levelup>

1316.source_en: <levelup>	What? I missed that... just kidding, CONGRATULATIONS!	</levelup>

1317.source_en: <levelup>	You are a magnificent sight to behold, but I wonder if all this magnificence is going to your big fat head like my big fat body.	</levelup>
1317.translation_tr: <levelup>	Gorulesi muhtesem bir manzarasin ama bu muhtesemlik benim buyuk bedenim gibi senin buyuk kafana mi cikiyor acaba.	</levelup>

1322.source_en: <feeding>	That was good... but I like moss more...	</feeding>
1322.translation_tr: <feeding>	Guzeldi... ama yosunu daha cok seviyorum...	</feeding>

1323.source_en: <feeding>	I don't like mushrooms because they look exactly like me.	</feeding>
