1323.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mantarlari sevmiyorum cunku tam bana benziyorlar.	</feeding>

1324.source_en: <hunting>	Are you going to sell all of your items!? You could always give me a bit...	</hunting>
1324.translation_tr: <hunting>	Tum esyalarini satacak misin!? Birazini bana verebilirsin...	</hunting>

1325.source_en: <hunting>	I am starving why do we always hunt!	</hunting>

1327.source_en: <danger>	Ow! when you are dead can I have all your food?	</danger>
1327.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah! Olursen tum yemegin bana kalabilir mi?	</danger>

1328.source_en: <dead>	This no time to sleep! I'm STARVED!	</dead>

1329.source_en: <dead>	You forgot to feed me...now what're you going to do?	</dead>
1329.translation_tr: <dead>	Beni beslemeyi unuttun... simdi ne yapacaksin?	</dead>

1330.source_en: <stand>	You don't have any spare moss do you?	</stand>

1331.source_en: <stand>	Sooo hungry... may I please eat that novice over there?	</stand>
1331.translation_tr: <stand>	Cooook acim... su oradaki novice'i yiyebilir miyim lutfen?	</stand>

1332.translation_tr: <stand>	Sadece ayakta durmak bile beni aciktiriyor!	</stand>

1333.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back! I hope you where getting me food?	</connect>
1333.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin! Umarim bana yemek almaya gitmistin?	</connect>

1334.source_en: <connect>	Have you went on vacation? I'm starving!	</connect>

1335.source_en: <levelup>	Yay! I knew you could do it... btw food?...	</levelup>
1335.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin! Basarabilecegini biliyordum... bu arada yemek?...	</levelup>

1339.source_en: <hunting>	You know, a few of those items you just got look really tasty...	</hunting>
1339.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biliyor musun, az once aldigin bazi esyalar gercekten lezzetli gorunuyor...	</hunting>

1340.source_en: <hunting>	Staring at porings eating stuff makes me hungry.	</hunting>
1340.translation_tr: <hunting>	Poringlerin bir seyler yemesini izlemek beni aciktiriyor.	</hunting>

1341.source_en: <danger>	Oh no... if you die who will feed me?	</danger>
1341.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah hayir... olursen beni kim besleyecek?	</danger>

1342.source_en: <dead>	Stop playing dead! Lets get out there and get me some food!	</dead>
1342.translation_tr: <dead>	Olu taklidi yapmayi birak! Hadi disari cikip bana yemek bulalim!	</dead>

1344.source_en: <stand>	Who are we waiting for? Did you order some food?	</stand>

1345.source_en: <stand>	Ah, the novice.. the other, other white meat...	</stand>

1347.source_en: <connect>	You're here! Want to go out and hunt us some fried mushroom spore?	</connect>
1347.translation_tr: <connect>	Geldin! Disari cikip biraz kizarmis Mushroom Spore avlayalim mi?	</connect>

1349.source_en: <levelup>	Hooray! Lets go out and celebrate with some food!	</levelup>

1350.source_en: <levelup>	Why don't you carry more food for me to eat? Don't you care about me? I don't think you do.	</levelup>
1350.translation_tr: <levelup>	Neden benim icin daha cok yemek tasimiyorsun? Beni umursamiyor musun? Sanmiyorum.	</levelup>

1353.source_en: <feeding>	Oh boy that was my favorite! You're the best owner.	</feeding>
1353.translation_tr: <feeding>	Vay, bu favorimdi! Sen en iyi sahipsin.	</feeding>

1354.source_en: <feeding>	Tasty... except the mushrooms... THAT'S CANNIBALISM!!!	</feeding>

1355.source_en: <hunting>	This is fun, I love to hunt with you.	</hunting>

1356.source_en: <danger>	Quick! Hide under my cap, I'll protect you!	</danger>
1356.translation_tr: <danger>	Cabuk! Sapkamin altina saklan, seni koruyacagim!	</danger>

1357.source_en: <dead>	That's ok, we'll just come back down and get him back! Lets go!	</dead>
1357.translation_tr: <dead>	Sorun yok, geri donup onu aliriz! Hadi gidelim!	</dead>

1358.source_en: <dead>	*sniff* Why do you do this to me? Do you have any idea how much stress this causes me?	</dead>
1358.translation_tr: <dead>	*burnunu ceker* Bunu bana neden yapiyorsun? Bunun bana ne kadar stres verdigini biliyor musun?	</dead>

1359.source_en: <dead>	Didn't you get enough sleep last night? Stop napping...	</dead>
1359.translation_tr: <dead>	Dun gece yeterince uyumadin mi? Uyuklamayi birak...	</dead>

1360.source_en: <stand>	We should start moving, I think my poison is killing the plant life around here...	</stand>
1360.translation_tr: <stand>	Hareket etmeliyiz, sanirim zehrim buradaki bitkileri olduruyor...	</stand>

1361.source_en: <stand>	I'm not like other poison spores, they always attack no matter what.	</stand>
1361.translation_tr: <stand>	Ben diger Poison Spore'lar gibi degilim, onlar ne olursa olsun saldirir.	</stand>

1362.source_en: <connect>	You're back! I saw a scary poring while you were gone... but I ate it... *burp*	</connect>
1362.translation_tr: <connect>	Geri geldin! Sen yokken korkunc bir Poring gordum... ama onu yedim... *gegirir*	</connect>

1363.source_en: <connect>	Hey! Let us go kill... except for spores... don't be mean.	</connect>
1363.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Hadi bir seyler oldurelim... Spore'lar haric... kotu olma.	</connect>

1364.source_en: <levelup>	Way to go! I have the strongest owner ever!	</levelup>
1364.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harika! Gelmis gecmis en guclu sahibim var!	</levelup>

1367.source_en: <feeding>	If you keep feeding me my cap might not fit me in the morning...	</feeding>
1367.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni boyle beslemeye devam edersen sabah sapkam bana olmayabilir...	</feeding>

1368.source_en: <feeding>	Make sure I don't get fat, ok?	</feeding>

1369.source_en: <hunting>	Oh, I'm kind of full. Want to take a rest?	</hunting>
1369.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ah, biraz doydum. Dinlenmek ister misin?	</hunting>

1370.source_en: <danger>	Careful! Do you have any healing items on you?	</danger>
1370.translation_tr: <danger>	Dikkat! Uzerinde iyilestirme esyasi var mi?	</danger>

1371.source_en: <dead>	Oh no! Does anyone have a yggdrasil leaf? It's ok, you'll be ok.	</dead>
1371.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah hayir! Kimsede Yggdrasil Leaf var mi? Sorun yok, iyi olacaksin.	</dead>

1372.source_en: <stand>	Hey! Use my cap as a seat instead of standing around... I don't mind, really!	</stand>
1372.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey! Ayakta durmak yerine sapkami oturak olarak kullan... Gercekten sorun degil!	</stand>

1374.source_en: <levelup>	Yes! Lets go for another! And another!	</levelup>
1374.translation_tr: <levelup>	Evet! Bir tane daha! Bir tane daha!	</levelup>

1375.source_en: <levelup>	Yahoo! Let's celebrate!.. when I'm not feeling so sick...	</levelup>
1375.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yahoo! Kutlayalim!.. Kendimi bu kadar hasta hissetmedigimde...	</levelup>

1378.source_en: <feeding>	Hey! Quit feeding me or I might explode! You don't want a poison spore all over you do you!?	</feeding>
1378.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey! Beni beslemeyi birak yoksa patlayabilirim! Ustune Poison Spore sicramesini istemezsin degil mi!?	</feeding>

1379.source_en: <hunting>	If you're looking for more food for me just keep it in your pocket... don't even try to feed me!	</hunting>
1379.translation_tr: <hunting>	Benim icin daha cok yemek ariyorsan cebinde tut... Beni beslemeye bile kalkma!	</hunting>

1380.source_en: <hunting>	Good thing I don't fight... I'd probably get eaten first!	</hunting>
1380.translation_tr: <hunting>	Iyi ki savasmiyorum... Muhtemelen ilk beni yerlerdi!	</hunting>

1381.source_en: <danger>	Ha ha, now its time for you to eat... well?	</danger>
1381.translation_tr: <danger>	Ha ha, simdi senin yemek zamanin... eee?	</danger>

1382.source_en: <danger>	... Please don't die on me... it's not too late...heal yourself...	</danger>
1382.translation_tr: <danger>	... Lutfen bana olup gitme... Daha gec degil... kendini iyilestir...	</danger>

1383.source_en: <dead>	I told you to heal yourself, why don't you listen to me?	</dead>
1383.translation_tr: <dead>	Sana kendini iyilestir dedim, neden beni dinlemiyorsun?	</dead>

1384.source_en: <dead>	...Told you so. Is there a yggdrasil leaf in the area?! Someone? Please?	</dead>
1384.translation_tr: <dead>	... Demistim. Cevrede Yggdrasil Leaf var mi?! Biri? Lutfen?	</dead>

1385.source_en: <dead>	I wonder if I can resurrect you somehow with my poison...	</dead>
1385.translation_tr: <dead>	Acaba zehrimle seni bir sekilde diriltebilir miyim...	</dead>

1386.source_en: <stand>	If we're just going to be standing around I think I'm going to rest.	</stand>

1387.source_en: <connect>	I'm so glad that you're back! I was afraid I would have to talk to the Kafras for company.	</connect>
1387.translation_tr: <connect>	Geri dondugune cok sevindim! Sohbet icin Kafralarla konusmak zorunda kalacagim diye korktum.	</connect>

1388.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, you got your level... now its time to go out and get mine.	</levelup>
1388.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, levelini aldin... simdi gidip benimkini alma zamani.	</levelup>

1389.source_en: <levelup>	What? exercise? Oh please! Find me a nice moss bed.	</levelup>
1389.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ne? Egzersiz mi? Hadi ama! Bana guzel bir yosun yatak bul.	</levelup>

1394.source_en: <feeding>	This is good. How bout some more?	</feeding>
1394.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu guzel. Biraz daha nasil olur?	</feeding>

1395.source_en: <feeding>	I'm going to report you to SPCA... I mean the GMs for animal abuse!	</feeding>
1395.translation_tr: <feeding>	Seni SPCA'ya... yani hayvan istismari icin GM'lere sikayet edecegim!	</feeding>

1396.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you for the snack, but I'm ready to have a real meal now.	</feeding>
1396.translation_tr: <feeding>	Atistirmalik icin tesekkurler ama simdi gercek bir yemek yemeye hazirim.	</feeding>

1397.source_en: <feeding>	What's this? Bird feed?! I don't need no stinkin' BIRD FEED... okay, maybe a little...	</feeding>
1397.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu ne? Kus yemi mi?! O lanet KUS YEMINE ihtiyacim yok... tamam, belki biraz...	</feeding>

1398.source_en: <hunting>	Don't ride me on my back, it's degrading.	</hunting>

1399.source_en: <hunting>	Too hungry.....no strength.....wait a second is that meat? MEEEEEAAAAT!!!	</hunting>
1399.translation_tr: <hunting>	Cok acim..... gucum yok..... bir dakika, o et mi? EEEEEET!!!	</hunting>

1400.source_en: <hunting>	Could you sell some of those jellopies and buy me some food?	</hunting>
1400.translation_tr: <hunting>	Su Jellopylerden birazini satip bana yemek alabilir misin?	</hunting>

1401.source_en: <danger>	Uhh, you look like you could use some rest... mind feeding me while you rest?	</danger>
1401.translation_tr: <danger>	Ee, biraz dinlenmen gerek gibi... Dinlenirken beni besler misin?	</danger>

1402.source_en: <danger>	I heard human flesh is a very good source for protein...	</danger>
1402.translation_tr: <danger>	Insan etinin cok iyi bir protein kaynagi oldugunu duydum...	</danger>

1403.source_en: <danger>	For not feeding me, I hope you die!	</danger>

1404.source_en: <dead>	Sunbathing? You're always leaving me out of all the fun!	</dead>
1404.translation_tr: <dead>	Gunesleniyor musun? Beni hep tum eglencenin disinda birakiyorsun!	</dead>

1405.source_en: <dead>	*Sheesh* Thanks a lot, now what do I do?...I knew I shouldn't trust a human...	</dead>
1405.translation_tr: <dead>	*Off* Cok sag ol, simdi ne yapacagim?... Bir insana guvenmemem gerektigini biliyordum...	</dead>

1406.source_en: <dead>	Welcome to my soon to be world...	</dead>
1406.translation_tr: <dead>	Yakinda benim olacak dunyaya hos geldin...	</dead>

1407.source_en: <dead>	Wow, you're really flexible! I never knew you could bend your arms like that! Uh, I hope they're not broken..	</dead>
1407.translation_tr: <dead>	Vay, gercekten esneksin! Kollarini boyle bukebildigini bilmiyordum! Ee, umarim kirilmamistir..	</dead>

1408.source_en: <stand>	Everything is starting to look like bird food... is that bad?	</stand>
1408.translation_tr: <stand>	Her sey kus yemi gibi gorunmeye basladi... bu kotu mu?	</stand>

1409.source_en: <stand>	You know maybe I can lose some weight....	</stand>
1409.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor musun, belki biraz kilo verebilirim....	</stand>

1410.source_en: <stand>	*Growwl* Oh don't worry, it's not a monster, it's just my stomach.	</stand>

1411.source_en: <stand>	Do you mind scratching my beak? I feel an itch.	</stand>

1412.source_en: <connect>	Remember, no free rides, payment in food accepted.	</connect>
1412.translation_tr: <connect>	Unutma, bedava yolculuk yok, odeme yemekle kabul edilir.	</connect>

1413.source_en: <connect>	I waited a long time for you, I'm starving.	</connect>
1413.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni uzun sure bekledim, acliktan oluyorum.	</connect>

1414.source_en: <connect>	Greetings, are you feeling as hungry as I am?	</connect>
1414.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam, sen de benim kadar ac misin?	</connect>

1415.source_en: <levelup>	Alright, time to party *does the chicken dance*	</levelup>

1416.source_en: <levelup>	Way to go... can I eat it?	</levelup>

1419.source_en: <feeding>	This is so good. What's in it?	</feeding>
1419.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu cok guzel. Icinde ne var?	</feeding>

1420.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks a lot but I will never get my old weight back if you don't feed me regularly...	</feeding>
1420.translation_tr: <feeding>	Cok sag ol ama beni duzenli beslemezsen eski kiloma asla donemem...	</feeding>

1421.source_en: <feeding>	I was thinking about cooking parts of you... but I guess I'll have to wait for another chance.	</feeding>
1421.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bazi parcalarini pisirmeyi dusunuyordum... ama sanirim baska bir firsati beklemem gerekecek.	</feeding>

1422.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, that was some tasty food. It reminds me of some yggdrasil berry feed I had once....	</feeding>
1422.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm, lezzetliydi. Bir zamanlar yedigim Yggdrasil Berry yemini hatirlatti....	</feeding>

1423.source_en: <hunting>	Yeah, I have wings, why don't I use them? That's none of your business...	</hunting>
1423.translation_tr: <hunting>	Evet, kanatlarim var, neden kullanmiyorum? Seni ilgilendirmez...	</hunting>

1424.source_en: <hunting>	You know, all this hunting is starting to annoy me, I need food you know.	</hunting>
1424.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biliyor musun, butun bu avlanma beni rahatsiz etmeye basladi, yemege ihtiyacim var.	</hunting>

1425.source_en: <danger>	Don't die on me now, you have not told me where the food is yet!	</danger>
1425.translation_tr: <danger>	Simdi olme, daha yemegin nerede oldugunu soylemedin!	</danger>

1426.source_en: <danger>	Oh great I have a master who is both cheap, hungry, and almost dead....	</danger>
1426.translation_tr: <danger>	Harika, cimri, ac ve neredeyse olu bir sahibim var....	</danger>

1427.source_en: <dead>	... oh, great, die... wonderful, now what's next?	</dead>
1427.translation_tr: <dead>	... ah harika, ol... mukemmel, simdi ne var?	</dead>

1428.source_en: <dead>	Typical he forgot to feed me, see you in heaven... or... that other place.	</dead>
1428.translation_tr: <dead>	Tipik, beni beslemeyi unuttu. Cennette gorusuruz... ya da... diger yerde.	</dead>

1429.source_en: <dead>	You won't mind me cooking you, will do you?	</dead>

1430.source_en: <stand>	Hmm, why are people looking at me like that?	</stand>
1430.translation_tr: <stand>	Hmm, insanlar bana neden oyle bakiyor?	</stand>

1431.source_en: <stand>	Do you hear that ? Yes, that's my stomach, it is talking to you	</stand>
1431.translation_tr: <stand>	Bunu duyuyor musun? Evet, o benim midem, seninle konusuyor	</stand>

1432.source_en: <stand>	Can't you see what I am doing? I am trying to swallow air, I need to fill my stomach with something!	</stand>
1432.translation_tr: <stand>	Ne yaptigimi gormuyor musun? Hava yutmaya calisiyorum, midemi bir seyle doldurmam gerek!	</stand>

1433.source_en: <connect>	Good day! Weather is fine is it not?	</connect>
1433.translation_tr: <connect>	Iyi gunler! Hava guzel degil mi?	</connect>

1434.source_en: <connect>	Ahhh here comes my food bank...	</connect>

1435.source_en: <levelup>	This calls for a celebration! Can I have that food again?	</levelup>
1435.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bu kutlama ister! O yemekten yine alabilir miyim?	</levelup>

1436.source_en: <levelup>	Something's different...YOU WENT AND PARTIED WITHOUT ME?! NOOOO!	</levelup>
1436.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir sey farkli... BEN OLMADAN PARTI MI YAPTIN?! HAYIIIR!	</levelup>

1440.source_en: <feeding>	Can't you give me something other your leftovers? How cheap...	</feeding>
1440.translation_tr: <feeding>	Artiklarindan baska bir sey veremez misin? Ne kadar cimri...	</feeding>

1441.source_en: <hunting>	Wow, you do good damage at your level!	</hunting>
1441.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay, leveline gore iyi hasar veriyorsun!	</hunting>

1442.source_en: <hunting>	Lock and load, time to lock and load.	</hunting>

1443.source_en: <hunting>	Do you have the munchies? Maybe I shouldn't have ate that green plant I saw earlier, I thought it looked funny...	</hunting>
1443.translation_tr: <hunting>	Atistirmalik ister misin? Belki az once gordugum o yesil bitkiyi yememeliydim, komik gorunuyordu...	</hunting>

1444.source_en: <danger>	Oh my. You are out of shape. Eat up!	</danger>

1445.source_en: <danger>	Hey, red doesn't look too bad on you, what do you think?	</danger>
1445.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, kirmizi sana fena yakismiyor, ne dersin?	</danger>

1447.source_en: <dead>	Uhh, you may want to get off the ground. I do believe you are lying in someone's doo-dah... and don't look at me!	</dead>
1447.translation_tr: <dead>	Ee, yerden kalksan iyi olur. Sanirim birinin pisliginin ustunde yatiyorsun... bana bakma!	</dead>

1448.source_en: <dead>	Hey, I tried to warn you, but you ignored me... so don't say I didn't warn you!	</dead>
1448.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, seni uyarmaya calistim ama beni gormezden geldin... uyarmadim deme!	</dead>

1449.source_en: <dead>	Oops sorry I accidentally stepped on your dead body...	</dead>

1450.source_en: <stand>	I am a good bird. I am a good bird. I am a good bird.	</stand>
1450.translation_tr: <stand>	Ben iyi bir kusum. Ben iyi bir kusum. Ben iyi bir kusum.	</stand>

1451.source_en: <stand>	Yes yes nice weather, Let's make a picnic! Woo Hoo!	</stand>
1451.translation_tr: <stand>	Evet evet, hava guzel, piknik yapalim! Woo Hoo!	</stand>

1453.source_en: <connect>	You know what I found out... I can't fly, I'm USELESS!!	</connect>
1453.translation_tr: <connect>	Ne ogrendigimi biliyor musun... Ucamiyorum, ISE YARAMAZIM!!	</connect>

1454.source_en: <connect>	Hop on my back and let's hunt!	</connect>

1455.source_en: <connect>	You know, I know I'm supposed to carry you around, but how about we switch for an hour?	</connect>
1455.translation_tr: <connect>	Biliyorum seni tasimam gerekiyor ama bir saatligine yer degistirsek nasil olur?	</connect>

1456.source_en: <levelup>	Just a couple more for a strong built body!	</levelup>
1456.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guclu bir vucut icin sadece birkac tane daha!	</levelup>

1457.source_en: <levelup>	Let's get this party started! Do a little dance.. make a little... c'mon, start dancin!	</levelup>
1457.translation_tr: <levelup>	Partiyi baslatalim! Biraz dans et.. biraz... hadi, dans etmeye basla!	</levelup>

1460.source_en: <feeding>	Ok. Now that food is starting to fill me up a bit too well.	</feeding>
1460.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tamam. Bu yemek beni biraz fazla iyi doyurmaya basladi.	</feeding>

1461.source_en: <feeding>	Ahhhh I could feel the love choking down my throat right now....	</feeding>
1461.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ahhhh su an sevgiyi bogazimdan zorla inerken hissedebiliyorum....	</feeding>

1462.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you get another level again. That was pretty exciting!	</hunting>
1462.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim yine level atlarsin. Oldukca heyecanliydi!	</hunting>

1463.source_en: <hunting>	Damn I have to lose weight....or find a new master...	</hunting>
1463.translation_tr: <hunting>	Kahretsin, kilo vermem gerek.... ya da yeni bir sahip bulmam...	</hunting>

1464.source_en: <hunting>	Bring it, I'm ready to kick some butt	</hunting>

1465.source_en: <danger>	Drink more fluids! I think you are getting sick!	</danger>
1465.translation_tr: <danger>	Daha cok sivi ic! Sanirim hastalaniyorsun!	</danger>

1466.translation_tr: <danger>	Tehlike! Tehlike! Savas... ya da koooooos!!!	</danger>

1467.source_en: <danger>	Hey, um, not to seem like I'm telling you what to do but, aren't you supposed to be the one killing the monster?	</danger>
1467.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, sana ne yapacagini soyluyormusum gibi olmasin ama canavari oldurmesi gereken sen degil misin?	</danger>

1468.source_en: <dead>	Can someone resurrect this person? He doesn't deserve this!	</dead>
1468.translation_tr: <dead>	Biri bu kisiyi diriltebilir mi? Bunu hak etmiyor!	</dead>

1469.source_en: <dead>	Don't ever think of sleeping at a time like this...	</dead>
1469.translation_tr: <dead>	Boyle bir zamanda uyumayi aklindan bile gecirme...	</dead>

1470.source_en: <dead>	Aw, look who fell down... come on little one, time to get up. GET UP!!!	</dead>
1470.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah, kim dusmus... hadi kucuk, kalkma zamani. KALK!!!	</dead>

1471.source_en: <stand>	I always see people starting at me... do I have something on my feathers? Can you check for me?	</stand>
1471.translation_tr: <stand>	Insanlar hep bana bakiyor... Tuylerimde bir sey mi var? Kontrol eder misin?	</stand>

1472.source_en: <stand>	You know, I heard it's good to get some exercise after you eat a good sized meal, let's go jogging!	</stand>
1472.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor musun, iyi bir yemekten sonra egzersiz iyiymis, hadi kosalim!	</stand>

1473.source_en: <stand>	Can we use that treasure map I found yet? Oh, oops, that was supposed to be a secret, sorry...	</stand>
1473.translation_tr: <stand>	Buldugum hazine haritasini artik kullanabilir miyiz? Ah, o gizli olacakti, uzgunum...	</stand>

1474.source_en: <connect>	Hey you're back! Lets travel together again. Where to boss?	</connect>
1474.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey geri geldin! Yine birlikte gezelim. Nereye patron?	</connect>

1475.source_en: <connect>	I am here on behalf of all Peco Peco's to say, I like it when you scratch my beak.	</connect>
1475.translation_tr: <connect>	Tum Peco Peco'lar adina buradayim ve gagami kasimani sevdigimi soyluyorum.	</connect>

1476.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bling Bling, simdi kim en iyisi!	</levelup>

1477.source_en: <levelup>	Nice one!! Look, my Peco Peco friends, it's my MAN!!	</levelup>
1477.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzeldi!! Bakin Peco Peco dostlarim, iste BENIM ADAMIM!!	</levelup>

1478.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, move over I want to take a picture of the scenery...	</levelup>
1478.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, cekil, manzaranin fotografini cekmek istiyorum...	</levelup>

1481.source_en: <feeding>	So much food? Must get bigger stomach!	</feeding>
1481.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu kadar yemek mi? Daha buyuk mide lazim!	</feeding>

1482.source_en: <feeding>	Is this how you display your love? By starving me then stuffing me?	</feeding>
1482.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sevgini boyle mi gosteriyorsun? Once ac birakip sonra tikabasa doldurarak mi?	</feeding>

1483.source_en: <hunting>	I'm so full I can't move!	</hunting>
1483.translation_tr: <hunting>	O kadar tokum ki hareket edemiyorum!	</hunting>

1484.source_en: <hunting>	Ugh, I think I'm going to explode... careful, I might get some on you.	</hunting>
1484.translation_tr: <hunting>	Off, sanirim patlayacagim... dikkat et, ustune gelebilir.	</hunting>

1485.source_en: <hunting>	Damn, stop whining, it's just a flesh wound, you pansy...	</hunting>
1485.translation_tr: <hunting>	Kahretsin, sizlanmayi birak, sadece et yarasi, korkak...	</hunting>

1486.source_en: <danger>	What a mess! Would you mind cleaning that up afterwards?	</danger>

1487.source_en: <danger>	Wait here! I'll go get my other friends!	</danger>

1488.source_en: <danger>	Whew, you may want to let that bush air out a bit before walking over there!	</danger>
1488.translation_tr: <danger>	Oh, oraya gitmeden once su caliligin biraz havalanmasini beklesen iyi olur!	</danger>

1489.source_en: <danger>	Wow what a nice fountain you make... red water, wait is that normal?	</danger>
1489.translation_tr: <danger>	Vay, ne guzel cesme oldun... kirmizi su, bir dakika bu normal mi?	</danger>

1490.source_en: <dead>	Wow, you look awful...would you like some ice cream?	</dead>
1490.translation_tr: <dead>	Vay, berbat gorunuyorsun... dondurma ister misin?	</dead>

1491.source_en: <dead>	Damn it, I'm too late...shouldn't have ate so much....	</dead>
1491.translation_tr: <dead>	Kahretsin, cok gec kaldim... bu kadar yememeliydim....	</dead>

1492.source_en: <dead>	May god have mercy on your soul...	</dead>

1493.source_en: <dead>	It is your fault and only your fault!! If you didn't feed me so much, I would have run faster!	</dead>
1493.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu senin ve sadece senin hatan!! Beni bu kadar beslemeseydin daha hizli kosardim!	</dead>

1494.source_en: <stand>	I'm bored... c'mon get a move on...	</stand>

1495.source_en: <stand>	What stinks here...?Oops, excuse me, my bad.	</stand>
1495.translation_tr: <stand>	Burada ne kokuyor...? Whoops, affedersin, benim hatam.	</stand>

1496.source_en: <stand>	You can stand all you want but I think I will pass. I sit and you stand.	</stand>
1496.translation_tr: <stand>	Istedigin kadar ayakta dur, ben pas geciyorum. Ben otururum, sen dur.	</stand>

1498.source_en: <connect>	Hey, I can't see my feet!! Can you find them for me?	</connect>
1498.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, ayaklarimi goremiyorum!! Benim icin bulabilir misin?	</connect>

1499.source_en: <connect>	Damn it!!! You just ruined my extremely secret evil plan to take over the world! FOILED AGAIN!	</connect>
1499.translation_tr: <connect>	Kahretsin!!! Dunyayi ele gecirmek icin cok gizli kotu planimi bozdun! YINE BOZULDU!	</connect>

1500.source_en: <connect>	Hi!! Can't tell which Peco Peco I am? I'm the fat one!	</connect>
1500.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam!! Hangi Peco Peco oldugumu anlayamadin mi? Sisman olan benim!	</connect>

1501.source_en: <levelup>	Another level? Don't you want to give me some?	</levelup>
1501.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir level daha mi? Bana biraz vermek istemiyor musun?	</levelup>

1502.source_en: <levelup>	Ok, you have gained a level, let's rest.	</levelup>

1503.source_en: <levelup>	I could have helped if I wasn't so heavy...	</levelup>
1503.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bu kadar agir olmasaydim yardim edebilirdim...	</levelup>

1504.source_en: <levelup>	I guess when you level up, you have a bigger capacity for your stomach....but we don't level up!	</levelup>
1504.translation_tr: <levelup>	Sanirim level atlayinca midenin kapasitesi buyuyor.... ama biz level atlamiyoruz!	</levelup>

1509.source_en: <feeding>	My little stomach... I feel so weak... I'm not sure I can go on!	</feeding>
1509.translation_tr: <feeding>	Kucuk midem... kendimi cok gucsuz hissediyorum... devam edebilecegimden emin degilim!	</feeding>

1510.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks but I have had better from the highway.	</feeding>
1510.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler ama yolda daha iyisini yedim.	</feeding>

1511.source_en: <feeding>	Stop staring at me already! I know I look funny when I eat too fast!	</feeding>
1511.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bana bakmayi birak artik! Cok hizli yerken komik gorundugumu biliyorum!	</feeding>

1512.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks, but if I don't get more food, I'll start dropping dead Raccoon Leafs!	</feeding>
1512.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler ama daha cok yemek yemezsem olu Raccoon Leaf dusurmeye baslayacagim!	</feeding>

1514.source_en: <hunting>	Shiny thing! Lemme have it! Its mine...my...precious...	</hunting>
1514.translation_tr: <hunting>	Parlak sey! Bana ver! Benim... benim... kiymetlim...	</hunting>

1515.source_en: <hunting>	Finally we're hunting something to eat...right?	</hunting>
1515.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sonunda yiyecek bir sey avliyoruz... degil mi?	</hunting>

1516.source_en: <hunting>	I'd eat some of that loot but, my mom told me its bad to eat off the ground.	</hunting>
1516.translation_tr: <hunting>	O ganimetlerden biraz yerdim ama annem yerden yemenin kotu oldugunu soyledi.	</hunting>

1517.source_en: <danger>	*grumble*, hey you need to feed me before you die.	</danger>

1518.source_en: <danger>	You're almost dead, feed me and I might help.	</danger>
1518.translation_tr: <danger>	Neredeyse oldun, beni besle de belki yardim ederim.	</danger>

1519.source_en: <danger>	My tummy feels as empty as your health bar...	</danger>
1519.translation_tr: <danger>	Karnim senin HP cubugun kadar bos...	</danger>

1520.source_en: <dead>	I could've been more alert had you given me something to eat.	</dead>
1520.translation_tr: <dead>	Bana yemek verseydin daha dikkatli olabilirdim.	</dead>

1522.source_en: <dead>	Just go and die when I'm starving! Yeesh!	</dead>
1522.translation_tr: <dead>	Ben acliktan olurken git sen de ol! Off!	</dead>

1524.source_en: <stand>	I can't stand being hungry... sometimes I wonder why I stick around.	</stand>
1524.translation_tr: <stand>	Ac kalmaya dayanamiyorum... bazen neden burada kaldigimi merak ediyorum.	</stand>

1525.source_en: <stand>	This is boring! Where are the shiny things!	</stand>

1526.source_en: <stand>	I feel like I could eat dirt I'm so... hungry...	</stand>
1526.translation_tr: <stand>	O kadar... acim ki toprak bile yiyebilirim...	</stand>

1527.source_en: <stand>	Um, hello? Can I get something to eat now? Even my tail is getting thinner.	</stand>
1527.translation_tr: <stand>	Ee, alo? Simdi yiyecek bir sey alabilir miyim? Kuyrugum bile inceliyor.	</stand>

1528.source_en: <stand>	I'm done exercising where's the food?	</stand>

1529.source_en: <stand>	Stop wasting oxygen and get me some food!	</stand>
1529.translation_tr: <stand>	Oksijeni bosa harcamayi birak ve bana yemek bul!	</stand>

1531.source_en: <connect>	Hey! Lets go to that alley for shiny things!	</connect>
1531.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Parlak seyler icin su ara sokaga gidelim!	</connect>

1532.source_en: <connect>	Well look who's here. Going to give me something to eat at last..?	</connect>
1532.translation_tr: <connect>	Bak kim gelmis. Sonunda bana yiyecek bir sey verecek misin..?	</connect>

1534.source_en: <levelup>	You filled yourself with experience, now fill me with food!	</levelup>
1534.translation_tr: <levelup>	Kendini EXP ile doldurdun, simdi beni yemekle doldur!	</levelup>

1536.source_en: <levelup>	Congrats, let's go out to eat... you're buying.	</levelup>
1536.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tebrikler, disari yemek yemeye gidelim... sen ismarliyorsun.	</levelup>

1541.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks! Better than what I find in a trashcan!	</feeding>
1541.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler! Cop kutusunda bulduklarimdan daha iyi!	</feeding>

1542.source_en: <feeding>	I feel a bit better now, thanks.	</feeding>
1542.translation_tr: <feeding>	Simdi biraz daha iyi hissediyorum, tesekkurler.	</feeding>

1543.source_en: <feeding>	Put another shrimp on the BBQ!	</feeding>

1544.source_en: <feeding>	Oh yea! MY favorite... where's the rest? Did you skip out on the good stuff?	</feeding>
1544.translation_tr: <feeding>	Oh evet! Favorim... gerisi nerede? Iyi seyleri atladin mi?	</feeding>

1546.source_en: <hunting>	Those items aren't shiny! Find more shiny things!	</hunting>
1546.translation_tr: <hunting>	O esyalar parlak degil! Daha parlak seyler bul!	</hunting>

1547.source_en: <hunting>	Uh.. *tug*tug* I'm hungry, feed me please?	</hunting>
1547.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ee.. *ceker* *ceker* Acim, beni besler misin lutfen?	</hunting>

1548.source_en: <hunting>	Wow, all that shiny loot, can I have some? Maybe I can buy my own food...	</hunting>
1548.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay, tum o parlak ganimet, biraz alabilir miyim? Belki kendi yemegimi alirim...	</hunting>

1549.source_en: <danger>	Alert! Alert! Danger, Danger Will Robinson, Danger!	</danger>
1549.translation_tr: <danger>	Alarm! Alarm! Tehlike, Tehlike Will Robinson, Tehlike!	</danger>

1550.source_en: <danger>	Watch out! That almost killed the food provider... I mean master!	</danger>
1550.translation_tr: <danger>	Dikkat! Az kalsin yemek saglayicisini... yani efendimi olduruyordu!	</danger>

1551.source_en: <danger>	Fwahahaha! I'll try to scare it away, you should run and maybe get me some food while you're at it.	</danger>
1551.translation_tr: <danger>	Fwahahaha! Onu korkutmaya calisacagim, sen de kac ve hazir gitmisken bana yemek al.	</danger>

1552.source_en: <danger>	Hey, if he does tear you apart, ask him if I can have whatever food is in your pockets.	</danger>
1552.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, seni parcalarsa ceplerindeki yemegi bana verip veremeyecegini sor.	</danger>

1553.source_en: <danger>	NOT IN THE FACE!!! NOT IN THE FACE!!	</danger>

1554.source_en: <dead>	Gah, why did you have to go and die so fast like that?	</dead>
1554.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah, neden gidip bu kadar hizli oldun?	</dead>

1557.source_en: <dead>	Okay.. you've slept enough ya lazy bum.	</dead>

1558.source_en: <stand>	Don't mind me, I'm sniffing the air for possible nearby food I can steal.	</stand>
1558.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana aldirma, yakinda calabilecegim yiyecek var mi diye havayi kokluyorum.	</stand>

1559.source_en: <stand>	Can I climb on your shoulders?	</stand>

1560.source_en: <stand>	*kicks feet in dirt* Hungry... and bored... which is worse? Neither...	</stand>
1560.translation_tr: <stand>	*ayaklariyla topragi tekmeler* Acim... ve sikildim... hangisi daha kotu? Hicbiri...	</stand>

1561.source_en: <connect>	You're just in time! Let's eat.	</connect>

1562.source_en: <connect>	Hello! Can I ride your shoulders today?	</connect>

1563.translation_tr: <connect>	Benim icin ozel bir seyin var mi?	</connect>

1565.source_en: <levelup>	Yes! Let's get better to get better shiny things!	</levelup>
1565.translation_tr: <levelup>	Evet! Daha iyi parlak seyler bulmak icin daha da iyi olalim!	</levelup>

1571.source_en: <feeding>	Yay! Apples! Time to wash them!	</feeding>

1572.source_en: <feeding>	Give me a few minutes. I need to clean myself up for my big date after that meal.	</feeding>
1572.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bana birkac dakika ver. O yemekten sonra buyuk bulusmam icin temizlenmem gerek.	</feeding>

1574.source_en: <hunting>	I feel so good, I feel like I can take on a Bapho... junior... maybe, don't hold me to that..	</hunting>
1574.translation_tr: <hunting>	Kendimi cok iyi hissediyorum, bir Bapho'yla basa cikabilirim gibi... junior... belki, buna guvenme..	</hunting>

1576.source_en: <hunting>	Quick, use the special move I taught you!	</hunting>
1576.translation_tr: <hunting>	Cabuk, sana ogrettigim ozel hareketi kullan!	</hunting>

1577.source_en: <hunting>	Secret smokie power!... oh wait, I'm still working on that one.	</hunting>
1577.translation_tr: <hunting>	Gizli Smokie gucu!... ah bir dakika, onun ustunde hala calisiyorum.	</hunting>

1578.source_en: <danger>	Go! Go! Go! Get out of the danger zone!	</danger>
1578.translation_tr: <danger>	Git! Git! Git! Tehlikeli bolgeden cik!	</danger>

1580.translation_tr: <danger>	O heal dugmesine daha hizli bas!	</danger>

1583.source_en: <dead>	Please get up, I'll die too!	</dead>

1584.source_en: <dead>	*pounces on stomach*... wake up... ...p.. l... e... a... s... e...?	</dead>
1584.translation_tr: <dead>	*karnina atlar*... uyan... ...l.. u... t... f... e... n...?	</dead>

1585.source_en: <dead>	Stop pretending to be a carpet!	</dead>

1586.source_en: <dead>	Can you hear me? Please response to me!	</dead>
1586.translation_tr: <dead>	Beni duyabiliyor musun? Lutfen cevap ver!	</dead>

1587.source_en: <stand>	Let me at me... aren't I the cutest thing you've ever seen?	</stand>
1587.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana bak... gordugun en tatli sey ben degil miyim?	</stand>

1588.source_en: <stand>	Think we could get me a new bandana?	</stand>
1588.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana yeni bir bandana alabilir miyiz?	</stand>

1589.source_en: <stand>	La la la... *runs around in circles*	</stand>

1590.source_en: <stand>	Last time I stood this much, was at the taxidermist's	</stand>
1590.translation_tr: <stand>	En son bu kadar dik durdugumda tahnitcideydim	</stand>

1592.source_en: <stand>	Can't you think of something interesting to talk about, you're getting boring.	</stand>
1592.translation_tr: <stand>	Konusacak ilginc bir sey bulamiyor musun, sikici olmaya basladin.	</stand>

1593.source_en: <stand>	OH MY GOD...Where is my leaf?!?! What did you do with it...YOU STOLE IT! THIEF! THIEF!	</stand>
1593.translation_tr: <stand>	AMAN TANRIM... Yapragim nerede?!?! Ona ne yaptin... SEN CALDIN! HIRSIZ! HIRSIZ!	</stand>

1594.source_en: <connect>	Nice to see you again. Let's rock.	</connect>
1594.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni tekrar gormek guzel. Hadi sallayalim.	</connect>

1595.source_en: <connect>	Yay! You're back! There was someone who wanted to talk to you, what was his name... hmm...	</connect>
1595.translation_tr: <connect>	Yasasin! Geri geldin! Seninle konusmak isteyen biri vardi, adi neydi... hmm...	</connect>

1597.source_en: <levelup>	Yay for us, yay for you, yayayay.	</levelup>

1598.source_en: <levelup>	You are the 1337! Let's go show off for the others!	</levelup>

1603.source_en: <feeding>	Ah! Good lizard on a stick!	</feeding>

1604.source_en: <feeding>	Ooooh.. I'm all happy full now! *basks in a sun ray*	</feeding>
1604.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ooooh.. Simdi mutlu ve tokum! *gunes isininda keyif yapar*	</feeding>

1605.source_en: <hunting>	I feel like I'm carrying an iron ball in my stomach.	</hunting>
1605.translation_tr: <hunting>	Midemde demir top tasiyormusum gibi hissediyorum.	</hunting>

1606.source_en: <hunting>	Let's go over there! I see something shiny!	</hunting>
1606.translation_tr: <hunting>	Oraya gidelim! Parlak bir sey goruyorum!	</hunting>

1607.source_en: <hunting>	*cheers and dances* Rah rah, sis boom bah!	</hunting>
1607.translation_tr: <hunting>	*tezahurat eder ve dans eder* Rah rah, sis boom bah!	</hunting>

1608.source_en: <danger>	You better watch yourself, you look like you're hurt.	</danger>
1608.translation_tr: <danger>	Kendine dikkat etsen iyi olur, yaralanmis gibisin.	</danger>

1609.source_en: <danger>	Let me kick it! I'll get it for you!	</danger>

1610.source_en: <danger>	Can I help you somehow? Just tell me, anything I'll do it, or try...	</danger>
1610.translation_tr: <danger>	Sana bir sekilde yardim edebilir miyim? Soyle yeter, her seyi yaparim, ya da denerim...	</danger>

1611.source_en: <danger>	Damn, if only I hadn't eaten that vitata card....	</danger>
1611.translation_tr: <danger>	Kahretsin, keske o Vitata Card'i yemeseydim....	</danger>

1614.source_en: <dead>	*paws at you gently* Don't leave me...please don't leave me...	</dead>
1614.translation_tr: <dead>	*nazikce patiler* Beni birakma... lutfen beni birakma...	</dead>

1617.source_en: <stand>	So, what do you look for in a partner? Anything like me?	</stand>
1617.translation_tr: <stand>	Peki, bir esde ne ariyorsun? Benim gibi biri mi?	</stand>

1619.source_en: <stand>	I wonder what happens when Smokies forget how to hide..	</stand>
1619.translation_tr: <stand>	Smokieler saklanmayi unutunca ne oluyor acaba..	</stand>

1622.source_en: <connect>	Hurrah! Time to explore some new trees to live in!	</connect>
1622.translation_tr: <connect>	Hurra! Yasamak icin yeni agaclar kesfetme zamani!	</connect>

1623.source_en: <connect>	Ready to shake it, shake shake shake it like a.... what's a Polaroid?	</connect>
1623.translation_tr: <connect>	Sallamaya hazir misin, salla salla salla... Polaroid ne?	</connect>

1626.source_en: <levelup>	I'd jump for joy but I might break the floor...	</levelup>

1627.source_en: <levelup>	Time to head back to the hacienda?	</levelup>

1630.source_en: <feeding>	I'm your pet, not a garbage disposal!	</feeding>
1630.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ben senin petinim, cop ogutucusu degil!	</feeding>

1631.source_en: <feeding>	I'm stuffed... or are you thinking about becoming a taxidermist?	</feeding>
1631.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tikabasa doydum... Yoksa tahnitci olmayi mi dusunuyorsun?	</feeding>

1632.source_en: <feeding>	Are you crazy?! I am going to burst!!!	</feeding>

1633.source_en: <hunting>	Wait up, you're moving too fast ... ugh.	</hunting>

1634.source_en: <hunting>	Can't move... too heavy... I feel bloated...*erp*	</hunting>

1636.source_en: <danger>	Arghhhh! Your life is in danger!	</danger>

1638.source_en: <danger>	I'd help, but oval shaped is in, and I don't want to ruin my form, can't disappoint my ladies.	</danger>
1638.translation_tr: <danger>	Yardim ederdim ama oval sekil moda ve formumu bozmak istemiyorum, hanimlari hayal kirikligina ugratamam.	</danger>

1639.source_en: <dead>	Ugh, if I weren't so full, I could've done... something.. ah who am I kidding, I'm lazy right now.	</dead>
1639.translation_tr: <dead>	Off, bu kadar tok olmasaydim... bir sey yapabilirdim... kimi kandiriyorum, su an tembelim.	</dead>

1640.source_en: <dead>	I tried to give you my yams, but you didn't want them...	</dead>
1640.translation_tr: <dead>	Sana yam vermeye calistim ama istemedin...	</dead>

1642.source_en: <dead>	Hey, do you got any of that weight loss stuff?	</dead>
1642.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, su kilo verme seylerinden var mi?	</dead>

1643.source_en: <dead>	I need to teach you how to hide faster...	</dead>
1643.translation_tr: <dead>	Sana daha hizli saklanmayi ogretmem gerek...	</dead>

1646.source_en: <stand>	So full.. so tired---*falls over* Zzz... Zzz...	</stand>
1646.translation_tr: <stand>	Cok tok.. cok yorgun---*devrilir* Zzz... Zzz...	</stand>

1648.source_en: <connect>	Yay! The master has returned. I missed you and that yoyo tried to sell me to a Bigfoot!	</connect>
1648.translation_tr: <connect>	Yasasin! Efendim geri dondu. Seni ozledim ve o Yoyo beni bir Bigfoot'a satmaya calisti!	</connect>

1649.source_en: <connect>	Yaaay! You've come back! *jumps in arms*	</connect>

1650.source_en: <connect>	Feed me again, and I will punch you in the head!	</connect>
1650.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni yine beslersen kafana yumruk atarim!	</connect>

1651.source_en: <connect>	Hey!! Do you know about any good weight loss programs?	</connect>
1651.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey!! Iyi bir kilo verme programi biliyor musun?	</connect>

1652.source_en: <levelup>	Congrats! Now if only I can work out myself to be as strong as you.	</levelup>
1652.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tebrikler! Keske ben de senin kadar guclu olmak icin calisabilsem.	</levelup>

1653.source_en: <levelup>	I wish I could be as great as you!	</levelup>

1654.source_en: <levelup>	Where are those trumpets coming from??	</levelup>

1659.source_en: <feeding>	I'm so hungry, don't you have any of those banana's left over?	</feeding>
1659.translation_tr: <feeding>	Cok acim, o muzlardan hic kalmadi mi?	</feeding>

1660.source_en: <feeding>	I'd fling something at you, but I haven't eaten anything for a while.	</feeding>
1660.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sana bir sey firlatirdim ama bir suredir hicbir sey yemedim.	</feeding>

1661.source_en: <feeding>	You take way too long to feed me, you want an angry yoyo on your hands?	</feeding>
1661.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni beslemen cok uzun suruyor, kizgin bir Yoyo mu istiyorsun?	</feeding>

1662.source_en: <feeding>	You call that a banana? I need to edumacate you... yeah you hear me... don't make fun of me.	</feeding>
1662.translation_tr: <feeding>	Buna muz mu diyorsun? Seni egitmem gerek... evet beni duydun... benimle dalga gecme.	</feeding>

1663.source_en: <feeding>	I think I hear Bapho near by!... oh wait, false alarm, that was just my stomach.	</feeding>
1663.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yakinda Bapho duyuyorum!... Ah bekle, yanlis alarm, sadece midemmis.	</feeding>

1665.source_en: <hunting>	Let's feed the hungry yoyo, shall we?	</hunting>

1667.source_en: <danger>	If you had fed me earlier, I might be helping you right now.	</danger>
1667.translation_tr: <danger>	Beni daha once besleseydin su an sana yardim ediyor olabilirdim.	</danger>

1669.source_en: <danger>	Pretty soon, we'll be running this place, just you watch...	</danger>
1669.translation_tr: <danger>	Yakinda burayi biz yonetecegiz, sen bekle...	</danger>

1670.source_en: <dead>	The age of yoyos begins! Where's that banana you had...	</dead>
1670.translation_tr: <dead>	Yoyolarin cagi basliyor! O muzun nerede...	</dead>

1672.source_en: <dead>	There was this green leaf I ate earlier, was that supposed to be for you?	</dead>
1672.translation_tr: <dead>	Az once yedigim yesil bir yaprak vardi, o senin icin miydi?	</dead>

1674.source_en: <stand>	Don't make me angry, you don't want to know what I can do when I'm angry... feed me.	</stand>
1674.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni kizdirma, kizdigimda neler yapabilecegimi bilmek istemezsin... beni besle.	</stand>

1677.source_en: <connect>	I wish there were a banana tree around here.	</connect>
1677.translation_tr: <connect>	Keske buralarda bir muz agaci olsaydi.	</connect>

1678.source_en: <connect>	Wassap... how bout a banana for your buddy?	</connect>
1678.translation_tr: <connect>	Naber... dostuna bir muz nasil olur?	</connect>

1679.source_en: <levelup>	Hey! Let's celebrate my year with a banana!	</levelup>
1679.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey! Benim yilimi bir muzla kutlayalim!	</levelup>

1680.source_en: <levelup>	Good for you...now FEED me or risk a pissed yoyo.	</levelup>
1680.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin adina iyi... simdi BENI BESLE yoksa kizgin bir Yoyo'yla ugrarsin.	</levelup>

1681.source_en: <levelup>	You ate my banana didn't you, c'mon fess up!!	</levelup>
1681.translation_tr: <levelup>	Muzumu sen yedin degil mi, hadi itiraf et!!	</levelup>

1682.source_en: <levelup>	I'd be more impressed if you remembered to feed me on time...	</levelup>
1682.translation_tr: <levelup>	Beni zamaninda beslemeyi hatirlasan daha cok etkilenirdim...	</levelup>

1687.source_en: <feeding>	... pffsh... this is it? I thought there was more...	</feeding>
1687.translation_tr: <feeding>	... pffsh... bu kadar mi? Daha fazla sanmistim...	</feeding>

1688.source_en: <feeding>	Hey, I heard about this place that has really ripe bananas... should look into buying from there.	</feeding>
1688.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey, cok olgun muzlari olan bir yer duydum... oradan almayi dusunmeliyiz.	</feeding>

1689.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, do you think we'll find anything edible here?	</hunting>
1689.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, sence burada yenilebilir bir sey bulur muyuz?	</hunting>

1690.source_en: <hunting>	Heey, this is fuuun, we're all going to DIE aren't we?	</hunting>
1690.translation_tr: <hunting>	Heey, bu eglenceliii, hepimiz OLECEGIZ degil mi?	</hunting>

1691.source_en: <hunting>	Do you think they eat yoyo meat...?	</hunting>

1692.source_en: <danger>	You're lookin' like you need help... well, look like I need a banana, so we're even.	</danger>
1692.translation_tr: <danger>	Yardima ihtiyacin var gibi... Benim de muza ihtiyacim var, esitiz.	</danger>

1693.source_en: <danger>	Ah, relax, it's only 1%... what're you so worried about?	</danger>
1693.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah rahatla, sadece %1... neden bu kadar endiselisin?	</danger>

1694.source_en: <dead>	HA... look at you, lying there... that's pathetic... and I'm hungry... ... ah crud.	</dead>
1694.translation_tr: <dead>	HA... bak sana, orada yatiyorsun... acinasi... ve ben acim... ah kahretsin.	</dead>

1695.source_en: <dead>	It's fun to watch you die...	</dead>

1696.source_en: <stand>	Hey, look over there, is that GOD-POING? Oh wait, I'm seeing things... hey, where'd the banana's go?	</stand>
1696.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, suraya bak, o GOD-POING mi? Ah bekle, hayal goruyorum... muzlar nereye gitti?	</stand>

1697.source_en: <stand>	*Yawn* I had more fun watching you die.	</stand>

1698.source_en: <stand>	Grab me some banana chips while you're up will you?	</stand>
1698.translation_tr: <stand>	Hazir ayaktayken bana biraz muz cipsi alir misin?	</stand>

1699.source_en: <stand>	Which do you like better, the bananas... or the banana pie?... I'm a pie yoyo myself .	</stand>
1699.translation_tr: <stand>	Hangisini daha cok seviyorsun, muz mu... muzlu turta mi?... Ben turta Yoyo'suyum.	</stand>

1700.source_en: <stand>	I'll check your hair after I eat... or maybe I can just check your hair and eat at the same time, c'mere.	</stand>
1700.translation_tr: <stand>	Yedikten sonra sacina bakarim... ya da hem yer hem sacina bakarim, buraya gel.	</stand>

1701.source_en: <connect>	Hey, let's go get some of those banana's I stashed away.	</connect>
1701.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, sakladigim muzlardan biraz almaya gidelim.	</connect>

1702.source_en: <connect>	I thought you'd forgotten about me, I'm hungry you get me something so I can eat?	</connect>
1702.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni unuttun sandim, acim, bana yiyecek bir sey alir misin?	</connect>

1703.source_en: <connect>	Hey! I heard this great recipe for grilled banana's, let's go give it a test cook.	</connect>
1703.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Izgara muz icin harika bir tarif duydum, gidip deneyelim.	</connect>

1704.source_en: <levelup>	HOO-AH! See, nice goin', let's celebrate! Banana's all around! ... You're buying.	</levelup>
1704.translation_tr: <levelup>	HOO-AH! Gordun mu, guzel gidiyor, kutlayalim! Herkese muz! ... Sen ismarliyorsun.	</levelup>

1705.source_en: <levelup>	Oh....gee... you get a level, what do I get, nothing... not even a banana...	</levelup>
1705.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah... sen level aliyorsun, ben ne aliyorum, hicbir sey... bir muz bile yok...	</levelup>

1708.source_en: <feeding>	Oh my gosh, you remembered! Thank you, thank you, thank you.	</feeding>
1708.translation_tr: <feeding>	Aman tanrim, hatirladin! Tesekkurler, tesekkurler, tesekkurler.	</feeding>

1709.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, that was great, now I feel guilty about keeping some of your loot.	</feeding>
1709.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm, harikaydi, simdi ganimetlerinden birazini sakladigim icin suclu hissediyorum.	</feeding>

1710.source_en: <hunting>	Think we'll find any good bananas?	</hunting>

1711.source_en: <hunting>	I sense something strong in this one...	</hunting>

1712.source_en: <hunting>	Can you teach me how to do that? I'm feelin' a bit useless.	</hunting>
1712.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bana bunu nasil yaptigini ogretebilir misin? Biraz ise yaramaz hissediyorum.	</hunting>

1713.source_en: <hunting>	If I rode on your shoulder, would you hate me?	</hunting>
1713.translation_tr: <hunting>	Omuzuna binsem benden nefret eder misin?	</hunting>

1714.source_en: <danger>	Hey you're lookin' great... don't screw it up.	</danger>

1715.source_en: <danger>	You, um, yeah, life would be, uh, the thing you're missing...	</danger>
1715.translation_tr: <danger>	Sen, ee, evet, hayat... eksik olan sey o...	</danger>

1716.source_en: <dead>	Can anyone spare a resurrection? I'll dance to pay for it...	</dead>
1716.translation_tr: <dead>	Biri Resurrection verebilir mi? Karsiliginda dans ederim...	</dead>

1717.source_en: <dead>	Hey, c'mon get up, we're not done playin' yet.	</dead>
1717.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, hadi kalk, daha oyunumuz bitmedi.	</dead>

1718.source_en: <stand>	Hey, I found an earring... can I keep it, where does it go... on my ear?	</stand>
1718.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, bir kupe buldum... saklayabilir miyim, nereye takiliyor... kulagima mi?	</stand>

1719.source_en: <stand>	Tag, you're it... okay, now... chase me...bah, you're boring.	</stand>
1719.translation_tr: <stand>	Ebelemece, ebe sensin... tamam, simdi... beni kovala... of, sikicisin.	</stand>

1720.source_en: <stand>	I know that look... don't complain... you know I look good.	</stand>
1720.translation_tr: <stand>	O bakisi biliyorum... sikayet etme... iyi gorundugumu biliyorsun.	</stand>

1721.source_en: <connect>	Hey, I remember you. Giver of bananas! Hail!	</connect>
1721.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, seni hatirladim. Muz veren kisi! Selam!	</connect>

1722.source_en: <connect>	I have this itch... but I can't reach it, can you?	</connect>
1722.translation_tr: <connect>	Bir yerim kasiniyor... ama ulasamiyorum, sen ulasabilir misin?	</connect>

1723.source_en: <connect>	Oh wow, I thought you had forgotten about me! Um... don't look in your bag until after I... um... clean it...	</connect>
1723.translation_tr: <connect>	Vay, beni unuttun sandim! Ee... ben... temizleyene kadar cantana bakma...	</connect>

1724.source_en: <connect>	Hey, so where'd you go? A date? Ooh tell me all about it. :3	</connect>
1724.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, nereye gittin? Bulusma mi? Ooh, her seyi anlat. :3	</connect>

1725.source_en: <levelup>	Do the yoyo! *dances with his tail spinning*	</levelup>

1726.source_en: <levelup>	Sweet, was that an angel over your head?	</levelup>
1726.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harika, basinin ustundeki bir melek miydi?	</levelup>

1727.source_en: <levelup>	I've been thinking about wearing a leather print, what do you think?	</levelup>
1727.translation_tr: <levelup>	Deri desen giymeyi dusunuyorum, ne dersin?	</levelup>

1728.source_en: <levelup>	I heard a horn, does that mean we're late for something?.	</levelup>
1728.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir boru sesi duydum, bir seye mi gec kaldik?	</levelup>

1729.source_en: <levelup>	AAHH!!.. oh that scared me, what was that?	</levelup>
1729.translation_tr: <levelup>	AAHH!!.. Ah beni korkuttu, o neydi?	</levelup>

1732.source_en: <feeding>	No thanks, I'm on a diet!	</feeding>

1733.source_en: <feeding>	I'll eat it, I won't like it... okay maybe I will, but I'm still full...	</feeding>
1733.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yiyecegim, hosuma gitmeyecek... tamam belki gider ama hala tokum...	</feeding>

1734.source_en: <feeding>	I hate to admit, I've had enough bananas... for now... that doesn't mean I'm gonna' stop eating them!	</feeding>
1734.translation_tr: <feeding>	Itiraf etmekten nefret ediyorum ama yeterince muz yedim... simdilik... bu yemeyi birakacagim anlamina gelmez!	</feeding>

1735.source_en: <hunting>	Heeey...slow down, some of us are full here...	</hunting>

1736.source_en: <hunting>	I need to teach you the faster mode of travel... trees...	</hunting>
1736.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana daha hizli yolculuk yontemini ogretmeliyim... agaclar...	</hunting>

1737.source_en: <hunting>	I'm getting fat and lazy, c'mon hurry it up.	</hunting>
1737.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sisman ve tembel oluyorum, hadi biraz hizlan.	</hunting>

1738.source_en: <hunting>	You think I can get the banana-bender 2000, it's a great workout machine.	</hunting>
1738.translation_tr: <hunting>	Banana-Bender 2000 alabilir miyim, harika bir egzersiz aleti.	</hunting>

1739.source_en: <hunting>	Uh oh, I can't see my toes... am I gaining weight?	</hunting>
1739.translation_tr: <hunting>	Eyvah, ayak parmaklarimi goremiyorum... kilo mu aliyorum?	</hunting>

1740.translation_tr: <danger>	Heal yapacaksin degil mi?.... DEGIL MI??	</danger>

1741.source_en: <danger>	So, about that heal.... comin' anytime soon is it?	</danger>
1741.translation_tr: <danger>	Su heal meselesi... yakinda geliyor mu?	</danger>

1742.source_en: <danger>	Need a heal over here, c'mon... someone help the cute yoyo's master out!	</danger>
1742.translation_tr: <danger>	Buraya heal lazim, hadi... biri su tatli Yoyo'nun sahibine yardim etsin!	</danger>

1744.source_en: <dead>	I know this is supposed to be my year, but that doesn't mean I'm gonna' fight when I'm full.	</dead>
1744.translation_tr: <dead>	Bunun benim yilim olmasi gerekiyor ama bu tokken savasacagim anlamina gelmez.	</dead>

1745.source_en: <dead>	I saw you just died. How do you come back alive so much times? I thought humans only have one life?	</dead>
1745.translation_tr: <dead>	Az once oldugunu gordum. Nasil bu kadar cok geri geliyorsun? Insanlarin tek cani var sanirdim?	</dead>

1746.source_en: <stand>	Who wants to pet me? It's good luck... honest... c'mon, rub my belly... watch the tail...	</stand>
1746.translation_tr: <stand>	Kim beni sevmek ister? Sans getirir... gercekten... hadi, karnimi ov... kuyruga dikkat...	</stand>

1747.source_en: <stand>	Do you think I'm a good pet? Honestly... don't ya just love me?	</stand>
1747.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence iyi bir pet miyim? Duzgun cevap ver... beni sevmiyor musun?	</stand>

1748.source_en: <stand>	I know I'm a yoyo but... the priestesses... woo....and the female assassins... the huntresses... ack, I love them all!	</stand>
1748.translation_tr: <stand>	Yoyo oldugumu biliyorum ama... Priestessler... woo... kadin Assassinler... Huntressler... ah, hepsini seviyorum!	</stand>

1750.source_en: <connect>	Good to have you back, it was getting too quiet!	</connect>
1750.translation_tr: <connect>	Geri gelmen iyi oldu, ortalik fazla sessizlesmisti!	</connect>

1751.source_en: <connect>	What took you so long. I have a hot date with that assassin girl.	</connect>
1751.translation_tr: <connect>	Neden bu kadar gec kaldin. O Assassin kizla sicak bir bulusmam var.	</connect>

1754.source_en: <levelup>	LOL, you just need 15 more levels to catch up to that guy there.	</levelup>
1754.translation_tr: <levelup>	LOL, su adama yetismek icin sadece 15 level daha lazim.	</levelup>

1757.source_en: <feeding>	No! no more! well, maybe just a little...	</feeding>
1757.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hayir! Daha fazla yok! Belki biraz...	</feeding>

1758.source_en: <feeding>	You just don't know when to stop do you!	</feeding>
1758.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ne zaman duracagini hic bilmiyorsun, degil mi!	</feeding>

1759.source_en: <feeding>	Eurgh.. Have you even seen a monkey puke?	</feeding>
1759.translation_tr: <feeding>	Eurgh.. Hic maymun kusarken gordun mu?	</feeding>

1760.source_en: <feeding>	Ugh, I'm going to be the worlds first Sumo wrestler Yoyo!	</feeding>
1760.translation_tr: <feeding>	Off, dunyanin ilk Sumo gurescisi Yoyo'su olacagim!	</feeding>

1761.source_en: <feeding>	Dude, I love bananas, but do I look like a Bigfoot to you?	</feeding>
1761.translation_tr: <feeding>	Dostum, muzu seviyorum ama sana Bigfoot gibi mi gorunuyorum?	</feeding>

1762.source_en: <hunting>	er.. ? I'm feeling a little... stuffed here.	</hunting>

1763.source_en: <hunting>	Gahhhh, 1 banana 2 banana, 300 hundred banana. Have you lost your mind?	</hunting>
1763.translation_tr: <hunting>	Gahhhh, 1 muz 2 muz, 300 muz. Aklini mi kacirdin?	</hunting>

1766.source_en: <danger>	Throw me! Knock them out with my weight!	</danger>

1767.source_en: <danger>	Umm can you like, hang in there? I need to go... um, yeah... b'cause I'm so full.	</danger>
1767.translation_tr: <danger>	Ee, dayanabilir misin? Gitmem gerek... ee, evet... cunku cok tokum.	</danger>

1769.source_en: <dead>	I need to go poop now... oh I'll just poop on you... don't move.	</dead>
1769.translation_tr: <dead>	Simdi tuvaletimi yapmam gerek... ah, ustune yaparim... kipirdama.	</dead>

1771.source_en: <stand>	Where's the restroom. Take me to the restroom. Is there a restroom here?	</stand>
1771.translation_tr: <stand>	Tuvalet nerede. Beni tuvalete gotur. Burada tuvalet var mi?	</stand>

1773.source_en: <connect>	I can't wear my fine suede shoes!	</connect>

1774.source_en: <connect>	That poring called me fatty. *sniff*sniff * You feed me to much.	</connect>
1774.translation_tr: <connect>	O Poring bana sisman dedi. *burnunu ceker* Beni cok fazla besliyorsun.	</connect>

1775.source_en: <levelup>	I'd dance, but I'm too lazy.	</levelup>

1776.source_en: <levelup>	WOW, good job. Take me to the gym. I'm so fat!!	</levelup>
1776.translation_tr: <levelup>	VAY, iyi is. Beni spor salonuna gotur. Cok sismanim!!	</levelup>

1784.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you stranger, you look tasty yourself, stop working out so much.	</feeding>
1784.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkur ederim yabanci, sen de lezzetli gorunuyorsun, bu kadar spor yapma.	</feeding>

1785.source_en: <feeding>	I see you notice me. I thank you for your gratitude.	</feeding>
1785.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni fark ettigini goruyorum. Ilgin icin tesekkur ederim.	</feeding>

1786.source_en: <hunting>	Human would be easier to kill for food then monster.	</hunting>
1786.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yemek icin insani oldurmek canavardan daha kolay olur.	</hunting>

1787.source_en: <hunting>	Me Orc, me kill, me eat, me eat a lot!!	</hunting>
1787.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ben Orc, ben oldurur, ben yer, cok yer!!	</hunting>

1788.source_en: <hunting>	I'm going hunting, back in a while.	</hunting>

1789.source_en: <hunting>	I want more food, I need to be big and strong for Orc lady to want me!	</hunting>
1789.translation_tr: <hunting>	Daha cok yemek istiyorum, Orc kadinin beni istemesi icin buyuk ve guclu olmaliyim!	</hunting>

1791.source_en: <danger>	Orc notice that you would be easier to kill and eat right now.	</danger>
1791.translation_tr: <danger>	Orc fark etti, su an seni oldurup yemek daha kolay olur.	</danger>

1792.source_en: <danger>	Do I need to help you, stranger?	</danger>
1792.translation_tr: <danger>	Sana yardim etmem gerekiyor mu yabanci?	</danger>

1793.source_en: <danger>	Hmm... if you die... can I chew on you a little then? Just nibble a bit? I'm hungry you know!	</danger>
1793.translation_tr: <danger>	Hmm... olursen... seni biraz cignebilir miyim? Sadece biraz? Acim biliyorsun!	</danger>

1795.source_en: <dead>	Hur hur, the prey kills itself. Time to feast.	</dead>
1795.translation_tr: <dead>	Hur hur, av kendi kendini oldurdu. Solen zamani.	</dead>

1798.source_en: <dead>	Oops... hmmm... wonder if he will notice if I take a little bite out of a leg or something?	</dead>
1798.translation_tr: <dead>	Whoops... hmmm... bacagindan biraz isirsam fark eder mi acaba?	</dead>

1799.source_en: <dead>	How could you die stranger? Orc thought you were good.	</dead>
1799.translation_tr: <dead>	Nasil oldun yabanci? Orc senin iyi oldugunu dusunuyordu.	</dead>

1800.source_en: <stand>	Orc's legs tired from standing, give Orc food to pass the time.	</stand>
1800.translation_tr: <stand>	Orc ayakta durmaktan yoruldu, vakit gecsin diye Orc'a yemek ver.	</stand>

1801.source_en: <stand>	May I ask what you are so serious about?	</stand>
1801.translation_tr: <stand>	Neye bu kadar ciddi baktigini sorabilir miyim?	</stand>

1803.source_en: <stand>	Orc want some fresh grilled meat, you look good...	</stand>
1803.translation_tr: <stand>	Orc taze izgara et istiyor, sen guzel gorunuyorsun...	</stand>

1804.source_en: <connect>	Good, looks like Orc can start stalking you again for food.	</connect>
1804.translation_tr: <connect>	Guzel, Orc yemek icin seni yine takip edebilir.	</connect>

1805.source_en: <connect>	Hello. Do I have to beg for food today?	</connect>
1805.translation_tr: <connect>	Merhaba. Bugun yemek icin yalvarmam mi gerekecek?	</connect>

1807.source_en: <connect>	Orc happy to see you again.	</connect>

1810.source_en: <levelup>	Food, Stranger, Orc need food... oh... congratulation.	</levelup>
1810.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yemek, yabanci, Orc yemek ister... ah... tebrikler.	</levelup>

1811.source_en: <levelup>	Have time to share food with Orc now?	</levelup>
1811.translation_tr: <levelup>	Simdi Orc ile yemek paylasmaya vaktin var mi?	</levelup>

1817.translation_tr: <feeding>	Orc yemek icin insana tesekkur eder.	</feeding>

1818.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, can't human share with Orc?	</hunting>
1818.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, insan Orc ile paylasamaz mi?	</hunting>

1819.source_en: <hunting>	You go ahead I'll start the fire...	</hunting>
1819.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sen onde git, ben atesi yakacagim...	</hunting>

1824.source_en: <dead>	Buh, if Orc wasn't hungry, Orc would have helped...	</dead>
1824.translation_tr: <dead>	Buh, Orc ac olmasaydi yardim ederdi...	</dead>

1827.source_en: <stand>	Orc is bored, food would be nice...	</stand>

1830.source_en: <connect>	Good day to human, when is lunch?	</connect>
1830.translation_tr: <connect>	Insana iyi gunler, ogle yemegi ne zaman?	</connect>

1833.source_en: <levelup>	Orc is glad for you, though Orc could beat human in a 1 on 1.	</levelup>
1833.translation_tr: <levelup>	Orc senin adina mutlu, gerci Orc insani bire birde yener.	</levelup>

1839.source_en: <hunting>	Orc thinks your skills are great.	</hunting>

1843.source_en: <dead>	You should have eaten some meat while battling.	</dead>

1845.source_en: <dead>	Human body smell really not good. Orc leave to home.	</dead>
1845.translation_tr: <dead>	Insan bedeni gercekten kotu kokuyor. Orc eve gider.	</dead>

1847.source_en: <stand>	Look at me, I'm big! And strong!! Not to mention green!!! Orc Lady is definitely going to like me!!	</stand>
1847.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana bak, buyugum! Ve gucluyum!! Bir de yesilim!!! Orc Lady kesin beni sevecek!!	</stand>

1848.translation_tr: <stand>	Orc bir gun Orc Hero olur mu?	</stand>

1851.source_en: <levelup>	Orc sees your strength growing, we should battle one day.	</levelup>
1851.translation_tr: <levelup>	Orc gucunun arttigini goruyor, bir gun dovusmeliyiz.	</levelup>

1855.source_en: <feeding>	Orc thanks, but Orc is good for now.	</feeding>
1855.translation_tr: <feeding>	Orc tesekkur eder ama simdilik iyi.	</feeding>

1857.source_en: <hunting>	Orc thinks the best time to battle is when Orc's stomach is full of meat!	</hunting>
1857.translation_tr: <hunting>	Orc'a gore savasmak icin en iyi zaman midesi etle doluyken!	</hunting>

1859.source_en: <danger>	Please, take the monster feed for yourself, Orc fine.	</danger>
1859.translation_tr: <danger>	Lutfen monster feed'i kendine al, Orc iyi.	</danger>

1860.source_en: <danger>	Orc see you bleeding, Orc get healers!	</danger>
1860.translation_tr: <danger>	Orc kanadigini goruyor, Orc healer getirir!	</danger>

1861.source_en: <dead>	Orc thinks you forgot about monster feed..	</dead>

1862.source_en: <stand>	Orc thinks we should go hunting instead of getting fat... lazy	</stand>
1862.translation_tr: <stand>	Orc sismanlayip tembellesmek yerine ava gitmemiz gerektigini dusunuyor.	</stand>

1863.source_en: <stand>	We got to keep moving master, just standing around no impress Orc lady at all...	</stand>
1863.translation_tr: <stand>	Hareket etmeliyiz efendim, oylece durmak Orc Lady'yi hic etkilemez...	</stand>

1864.source_en: <stand>	Human, waiting human friends?... no Orc friends?	</stand>
1864.translation_tr: <stand>	Insan, insan dostlarini mi bekliyor?... Orc dostu yok mu?	</stand>

1865.source_en: <stand>	Orc need friend... Orc lonely... maybe Orc Lady come by and be good friend?	</stand>
1865.translation_tr: <stand>	Orc dosta ihtiyac duyar... Orc yalniz... belki Orc Lady gelir ve iyi dost olur?	</stand>

1866.source_en: <connect>	Orc greets you, Orc wanted company.	</connect>
1866.translation_tr: <connect>	Orc seni selamlar, Orc arkadaslik istiyordu.	</connect>

1868.source_en: <connect>	Orc greets you, Orc found an Orc Lady while you gone!	</connect>
1868.translation_tr: <connect>	Orc seni selamlar, sen yokken Orc bir Orc Lady buldu!	</connect>

1869.source_en: <levelup>	Ha ha! Friend grows ever stronger!	</levelup>

1873.source_en: <feeding>	Do you want Orc to get fat and out of shape?	</feeding>
1873.translation_tr: <feeding>	Orc'un sismanlayip formdan dusmesini mi istiyorsun?	</feeding>

1874.source_en: <feeding>	Orc no want food any more. Orc allow human take all.	</feeding>
1874.translation_tr: <feeding>	Orc artik yemek istemez. Orc insana hepsini almaya izin verir.	</feeding>

1875.source_en: <hunting>	Orc feels to heavy from all this food.	</hunting>
1875.translation_tr: <hunting>	Orc tum bu yemekten cok agir hissediyor.	</hunting>

1877.source_en: <danger>	Uh, please, take the monster feed, Orc does not need any right now..	</danger>
1877.translation_tr: <danger>	Ee, lutfen monster feed'i al, Orc'un simdi ihtiyaci yok..	</danger>

1878.source_en: <danger>	Orc need vomit food for human friend?	</danger>
1878.translation_tr: <danger>	Orc insan dostu icin yemegi kusmali mi?	</danger>

1879.source_en: <dead>	Ugh, can someone resurrect Orc's friend? Orc to full to try.	</dead>
1879.translation_tr: <dead>	Off, biri Orc'un dostunu diriltebilir mi? Orc denemek icin cok tok.	</dead>

1881.source_en: <dead>	Orc called Orc fellows to burry human body.	</dead>
1881.translation_tr: <dead>	Orc insan bedenini gommek icin Orc dostlarini cagirdi.	</dead>

1882.source_en: <stand>	Sure, you feed Orc to much and then you make Orc stand around, get fat and lazy... damn you.	</stand>
1882.translation_tr: <stand>	Tabii, Orc'u cok besle sonra ayakta beklet, sisman ve tembel olsun... kahretsin.	</stand>

1884.source_en: <stand>	Orc Lady left me, said Orc too fat.	</stand>
1884.translation_tr: <stand>	Orc Lady beni birakti, Orc cok sisman dedi.	</stand>

1885.source_en: <connect>	Hello, Orc hasn't been so full in years.	</connect>
1885.translation_tr: <connect>	Merhaba, Orc yillardir bu kadar tok olmamisti.	</connect>

1886.source_en: <connect>	Hello, what do you say we burn some calories before Orc Lady sees me fat? Eh? Good friend? Happy master?	</connect>
1886.translation_tr: <connect>	Merhaba, Orc Lady beni sisman gormeden biraz kalori yakmaya ne dersin? Ha? Iyi dost? Mutlu efendi?	</connect>

1887.source_en: <levelup>	Orc is happy for you, Orc should try and loose some weight to get to your level once again.	</levelup>
1887.translation_tr: <levelup>	Orc senin adina mutlu, Orc tekrar senin seviyene gelmek icin biraz kilo vermeli.	</levelup>

1892.source_en: <feeding>	.... can I have more food please? Being dead, then an undead then die of starvation can't be good for you...	</feeding>
1892.translation_tr: <feeding>	.... lutfen biraz daha yemek alabilir miyim? Olmek, sonra undead olmak, sonra acliktan olmek iyi olamaz...	</feeding>

1894.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks mortal. I really needed that.	</feeding>
1894.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler olumlu. Buna gercekten ihtiyacim vardi.	</feeding>

1895.source_en: <feeding>	So you have time to kill innocent creatures, but no time giving me a meal?	</feeding>
1895.translation_tr: <feeding>	Masum yaratiklari oldurmeye vaktin var ama bana yemek vermeye yok mu?	</feeding>

1896.source_en: <hunting>	Living being... you better watch your back...	</hunting>
1896.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yasayan varlik... arkani kollasan iyi olur...	</hunting>

1898.source_en: <hunting>	You know, I am so much more stronger than you...	</hunting>
1898.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biliyor musun, senden cok daha gucluyum...	</hunting>

1899.source_en: <hunting>	All this bouncing on my legs is starting to hurt...	</hunting>
1899.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bacaklarim ustunde bu kadar ziplama canimi acitmaya basladi...	</hunting>

1900.source_en: <danger>	Being alive is so overrated... soon you'll have an end to your suffering.	</danger>
1900.translation_tr: <danger>	Hayatta olmak cok abartiliyor... yakinda acin sona erecek.	</danger>

1902.source_en: <danger>	My poor master hasn't been eating right...	</danger>

1903.source_en: <danger>	Are you trying to join me on my side?	</danger>

1905.source_en: <dead>	I will have your body... It's time to feed!	</dead>

1908.source_en: <stand>	...Give me one good reason why I shouldn't tear your apart and devour you?	</stand>
1908.translation_tr: <stand>	...Seni parcalayip yememem icin bana iyi bir sebep ver?	</stand>

1909.source_en: <stand>	Just because I am undead doesn't mean you can stop feeding me...	</stand>
1909.translation_tr: <stand>	Undead olmam beni beslemeyi birakabilecegin anlamina gelmez...	</stand>

1910.source_en: <stand>	You don't seem to use your hands... could I have feast on one of them?	</stand>
1910.translation_tr: <stand>	Ellerini pek kullanmiyor gibisin... birini yiyebilir miyim?	</stand>

1911.source_en: <stand>	Can you see through me? tell me the truth.	</stand>

1912.source_en: <stand>	Ooh.. The sun is too bright for me!	</stand>
1912.translation_tr: <stand>	Ooh.. Gunes benim icin cok parlak!	</stand>

1914.source_en: <connect>	...Nice weather we're having... let's go eat...	</connect>

1916.source_en: <connect>	Hi, feed me now or I will be forced to kill you.	</connect>
1916.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam, simdi beni besle yoksa seni oldurmek zorunda kalacagim.	</connect>

1919.source_en: <levelup>	*Squeeeals* Oh! I'm not dead! Oh.. umm... congrats?	</levelup>

1920.source_en: <levelup>	Good for you... now feed me...	</levelup>
1920.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin adina iyi... simdi beni besle...	</levelup>

1921.source_en: <levelup>	Level up? Maybe we could celebrate it by giving me one of your body parts?	</levelup>
1921.translation_tr: <levelup>	Level up mi? Belki bana bedeninden bir parca vererek kutlayabiliriz?	</levelup>

1926.source_en: <feeding>	I needed that. Now I have another year to live...be dead...	</feeding>
1926.translation_tr: <feeding>	Buna ihtiyacim vardi. Simdi bir yil daha yasayabilirim... olu kalabilirim...	</feeding>

1927.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks... you know... you don't look as tasty anymore.	</feeding>
1927.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler... biliyor musun... artik o kadar lezzetli gorunmuyorsun.	</feeding>

1928.source_en: <feeding>	Another dim sum down the hatch...	</feeding>
1928.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bir dim sum daha mideye indi...	</feeding>

1929.source_en: <hunting>	You might regret turning your back on me...	</hunting>

1930.source_en: <hunting>	You know I can fight pretty well for a dead girl...	</hunting>
1930.translation_tr: <hunting>	Olu bir kiz icin oldukca iyi savasiyorum...	</hunting>

1933.source_en: <danger>	This is a sign... the evil tells you to buy food... some for you... and more for me.	</danger>
1933.translation_tr: <danger>	Bu bir isaret... kotuluk sana yemek al diyor... biraz sana... daha cok bana.	</danger>

1934.source_en: <danger>	Sorry mortal, but my amulet can't revive players.	</danger>
1934.translation_tr: <danger>	Uzgunum olumlu, ama muskam oyunculari diriltemez.	</danger>

1935.source_en: <danger>	We are almost in the same state, being dead and all...	</danger>
1935.translation_tr: <danger>	Neredeyse ayni durumdayiz, ikimiz de olu sayiliriz...	</danger>

1937.source_en: <dead>	This is why the living should die... they die anyway.	</dead>
1937.translation_tr: <dead>	Yasayanlar bu yuzden olmeli... nasil olsa oluyorlar.	</dead>

1938.source_en: <dead>	Now we can be friends for... life..?	</dead>

1939.source_en: <dead>	So sad, I liked you enough as it was when you were alive...	</dead>
1939.translation_tr: <dead>	Cok uzucu, hayattayken seni yeterince seviyordum...	</dead>

1941.source_en: <stand>	Hmm... you seem different... like... food...	</stand>

1942.source_en: <stand>	Can we go to the Payon caves? I want to see my friends.	</stand>
1942.translation_tr: <stand>	Payon magaralarina gidebilir miyiz? Dostlarimi gormek istiyorum.	</stand>

1943.source_en: <stand>	Why stand, when you can hop ?	</stand>

1944.source_en: <stand>	If Munak is useful, you'd keep her right? *smiles and sways back and forth*	</stand>
1944.translation_tr: <stand>	Munak ise yararsa onu tutarsin, degil mi? *gulumser ve sallanir*	</stand>

1945.source_en: <stand>	I need some human blood... I mean food...	</stand>
1945.translation_tr: <stand>	Biraz insan kanina ihtiyacim var... yani yemek...	</stand>

1947.source_en: <connect>	I want blood... I mean... give me something to eat. Oh yes... hi.	</connect>
1947.translation_tr: <connect>	Kan istiyorum... yani... bana yiyecek bir sey ver. Ah evet... selam.	</connect>

1948.source_en: <connect>	Oh! I just thought of something I wanted to tell you... ... I forgot...	</connect>
1948.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah! Sana soylemek istedigim bir sey aklima geldi... unuttum...	</connect>

1950.source_en: <levelup>	Nice for you, now to feed, yes?.	</levelup>
1950.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin icin guzel, simdi besleme zamani, evet?	</levelup>

1951.source_en: <levelup>	One step closer to being strong...	</levelup>

1952.source_en: <levelup>	It's nice to see you growing so strong...	</levelup>

1956.source_en: <feeding>	I'm satisfied... but a little more wouldn't hurt.	</feeding>
1956.translation_tr: <feeding>	Doydum... ama biraz daha zarar vermez.	</feeding>

1957.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you... this is very good...	</feeding>

1959.source_en: <feeding>	This is even better then that Magnolia I ate in Payon....	</feeding>
1959.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu Payon'da yedigim Magnolia'dan bile daha iyi....	</feeding>

1960.source_en: <hunting>	You lead... I shall follow behind.	</hunting>
1960.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sen onde git... ben arkandan gelecegim.	</hunting>

1961.source_en: <hunting>	Please, protect me if something tries to attack me...	</hunting>
1961.translation_tr: <hunting>	Lutfen, bir sey bana saldirirsa beni koru...	</hunting>

1962.source_en: <hunting>	For someone who is alive, you fight really well....	</hunting>
1962.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yasayan biri icin gercekten iyi savasiyorsun....	</hunting>

1964.source_en: <danger>	Don't worry, if you die, it isn't that bad. I mean, look at me.	</danger>
1964.translation_tr: <danger>	Endiselenme, olursen o kadar kotu degil. Bana bak.	</danger>

1965.source_en: <danger>	Please watch out, you probably won't like being dead.	</danger>
1965.translation_tr: <danger>	Lutfen dikkat et, olu olmayi muhtemelen sevmezsin.	</danger>

1966.source_en: <danger>	Would you donate some blood to me?	</danger>

1968.source_en: <dead>	See? It wasn't THAT bad, was it?	</dead>
1968.translation_tr: <dead>	Gordun mu? O KADAR da kotu degildi, degil mi?	</dead>

1971.source_en: <dead>	...You die SOO much... when are you going to stay that way?...	</dead>
1971.translation_tr: <dead>	...COK fazla oluyorsun... ne zaman oyle kalacaksin?...	</dead>

1972.source_en: <stand>	Can we move? My legs are growing stiff again...	</stand>
1972.translation_tr: <stand>	Hareket edebilir miyiz? Bacaklarim yine katilasiyor...	</stand>

1973.source_en: <stand>	Bongun is a hunk...but I think my master is cuter than him... shh don't tell him.	</stand>
1973.translation_tr: <stand>	Bongun yakisikli... ama bence efendim ondan daha tatli... sst ona soyleme.	</stand>

1975.source_en: <stand>	Where do ghost buy their food? At the GHOST-ery store!.. oh I kill me... uh, wait that was funny too...	</stand>
1975.translation_tr: <stand>	Hayaletler yemeklerini nereden alir? GHOST-ery magazasindan!.. Ah beni oldurdum... bir dakika bu da komikti...	</stand>

1976.source_en: <stand>	What you say we go visit the graveyard? I miss my other sisters... they need a master like you who can feed all of us!	</stand>
1976.translation_tr: <stand>	Mezarliga gitmeye ne dersin? Diger kiz kardeslerimi ozledim... Hepimizi besleyebilecek senin gibi bir efendiye ihtiyaclari var!	</stand>

1977.source_en: <connect>	*poke* Those people are staring at me...	</connect>

1978.source_en: <connect>	Hello there, how about you pull this ancient scripture off my head?	</connect>
1978.translation_tr: <connect>	Merhaba, su eski yaziti kafamdan cekip cikarsan nasil olur?	</connect>

1979.source_en: <connect>	I was wondering when you would come to see me..	</connect>
1979.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni ne zaman gormeye gelecegini merak ediyordum..	</connect>

1982.source_en: <levelup>	We must thank the evil, they have blessed you with unholy strength!	</levelup>
1982.translation_tr: <levelup>	Kotuluge tesekkur etmeliyiz, seni kutsal olmayan gucle kutsadilar!	</levelup>

1983.source_en: <levelup>	Congratulations! I'd give you red envelopes of vast wealth... a hug would do instead right, honey?*hugs tightly and smiles*	</levelup>
1983.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tebrikler! Sana buyuk zenginlik dolu kirmizi zarflar verirdim... yerine sarilmak da olur, degil mi tatlim? *sikica sarilir ve gulumser*	</levelup>

1988.source_en: <feeding>	That's enough, being undead doesn't mean I can't overeat.	</feeding>
1988.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yeter, undead olmam fazla yiyemeyecegim anlamina gelmez.	</feeding>

1989.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm.. all this food is not good for my body...	</feeding>
1989.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm.. tum bu yemek bedenime iyi gelmiyor...	</feeding>
