1990.source_en: <feeding>	I'm feeling quite plump. I actually didn't think I could still get plump...	</feeding>
1990.translation_tr: <feeding>	Kendimi oldukca tombul hissediyorum. Hala tombullasabilecegimi dusunmezdim...	</feeding>

1992.source_en: <hunting>	So much prey... so little time.	</hunting>

1993.source_en: <hunting>	So much food... how do you expect me to keep hopping like this master?	</hunting>
1993.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu kadar yemek... bu halde nasil ziplamami bekliyorsun efendim?	</hunting>

1997.source_en: <danger>	Watch out, you're almost dead. Well... heal if you want, being dead isn't so bad.	</danger>
1997.translation_tr: <danger>	Dikkat et, neredeyse oldun. Neyse... istersen heal yap, olu olmak o kadar kotu degil.	</danger>

1998.source_en: <danger>	I would heal you, but it would be against the Munak's code.	</danger>
1998.translation_tr: <danger>	Seni iyilestirirdim ama Munak kurallarina aykiri.	</danger>

1999.source_en: <danger>	Oh dear, you're bleeding! Let me get you a handkerchief to wipe you with.	</danger>
1999.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah canim, kaniyorsun! Silmen icin bir mendil getireyim.	</danger>

2000.source_en: <dead>	Oh well... how about I teach you how to live as an undead?	</dead>
2000.translation_tr: <dead>	Neyse... sana undead olarak nasil yasanacagini ogreteyim mi?	</dead>

2001.source_en: <dead>	Whatever, tell me when your ready to cross over. I need to digest.	</dead>
2001.translation_tr: <dead>	Neyse, gecmeye hazir oldugunda soyle. Hazmetmem gerek.	</dead>

2002.source_en: <dead>	If you don't make it through, I want to be buried with you..	</dead>

2003.source_en: <dead>	Why did you have to be a hero...	</dead>

2005.source_en: <stand>	Should I make friends with a Sohee? They look pretty...	</stand>
2005.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir Sohee ile arkadas olayim mi? Guzel gorunuyorlar...	</stand>

2006.source_en: <stand>	If you are to wait, at least sit. We shall take them out when you're ready.	</stand>
2006.translation_tr: <stand>	Bekleyeceksen en azindan otur. Hazir oldugunda onlari hallederiz.	</stand>

2007.source_en: <stand>	Do you think this ancient robe makes me look fat?	</stand>
2007.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence bu eski cubbe beni sisman mi gosteriyor?	</stand>

2008.source_en: <stand>	Do you think my hips are too big?	</stand>

2009.source_en: <stand>	You know. We undead aren't all that bad, just misunderstood.	</stand>
2009.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor musun, biz undeadler o kadar kotu degiliz, sadece yanlis anlasiliyoruz.	</stand>

2010.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back Master, shall we be on our way?	</connect>
2010.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldiniz Efendim, yola cikabilir miyiz?	</connect>

2011.source_en: <connect>	He loves me, he loves me not..... OH! Didn't see you standing there *blush*	</connect>
2011.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni seviyor, sevmiyor..... AH! Orada oldugunu gormedim *kizarir*	</connect>

2012.source_en: <connect>	Did you miss me? Cause I missed you!	</connect>
2012.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni ozledin mi? Cunku ben seni ozledim!	</connect>

2014.source_en: <levelup>	*pokes the dead monster, turns around, pokes the master* Hey... you wouldn't do that to my Bongun, would you?!	</levelup>
2014.translation_tr: <levelup>	*olu canavari durter, donup efendiyi durter* Hey... Bongun'uma bunu yapmazdin, degil mi?!	</levelup>

2015.source_en: <levelup>	I can feel your strength, it has reached a new level. It is good that both strong beings have come to befriend each other.	</levelup>
2015.translation_tr: <levelup>	Gucunu hissedebiliyorum, yeni bir seviyeye ulasti. Iki guclu varligin dost olmasi guzel.	</levelup>

2016.source_en: <levelup>	Great job! You are the master of disaster!	</levelup>

2017.source_en: <levelup>	You're on a roll my friend!	</levelup>

2021.source_en: <feeding>	If I wasn't undead, I'd be dead from over eating.	</feeding>

2022.source_en: <feeding>	While your at it, why don't you cut a hole in my stomach to drain the food out?	</feeding>
2022.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hazir baslamisken mideme delik acip yemegi bosaltsana?	</feeding>

2023.source_en: <feeding>	Oh my gosh! I can't touch my toes! Not that I could before, but...	</feeding>
2023.translation_tr: <feeding>	Aman tanrim! Ayak parmaklarima dokunamiyorum! Gerci once de dokunamiyordum ama...	</feeding>

2024.source_en: <hunting>	I would feed on our prey... but I'm too full.	</hunting>

2025.source_en: <hunting>	How many times do I have to tell you! ....WAIT for me!	</hunting>
2025.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana kac kez soylemem gerek! ....BENI BEKLE!	</hunting>

2027.source_en: <danger>	Sit down and rest Master. I need to rest too... I feel bloated.	</danger>
2027.translation_tr: <danger>	Oturup dinlen Efendim. Benim de dinlenmem gerek... sisitim.	</danger>

2028.source_en: <danger>	That's going to leave a mark.	</danger>

2030.source_en: <danger>	Oh, say hi to all my friends in the afterlife!	</danger>
2030.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah, oteki dunyadaki tum dostlarima selam soyle!	</danger>

2031.source_en: <dead>	Master? Master? Get up... please? If you get up, I'll refund some of the food for you to eat. I promise.	</dead>
2031.translation_tr: <dead>	Efendim? Efendim? Kalk... lutfen? Kalkarsan yedirdigin yemegin birazini sana geri veririm. Soz.	</dead>

2032.source_en: <dead>	You got blood all over me! Yeesh! You're buying me new cloths.	</dead>
2032.translation_tr: <dead>	Her yerime kan bulastirdin! Off! Bana yeni kiyafet alacaksin.	</dead>

2034.source_en: <dead>	What am I supposed to do..?	</dead>

2035.source_en: <stand>	Good thing I'm dead... or else I wouldn't be able to withstand being so fat.	</stand>
2035.translation_tr: <stand>	Iyi ki oluyum... yoksa bu kadar sisman olmaya dayanamazdim.	</stand>

2036.source_en: <stand>	Why does everyone want to kill me for my hat?	</stand>
2036.translation_tr: <stand>	Herkes neden sapkam icin beni oldurmek istiyor?	</stand>

2037.source_en: <stand>	This hat is starting to annoy me.	</stand>

2038.source_en: <stand>	Wake up, time to start exercising!	</stand>

2039.source_en: <stand>	A... I... pretty to you? Be honest...	</stand>
2039.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence... ben... guzel miyim? Durust ol...	</stand>

2040.source_en: <connect>	I feel fat... I mean, evil shall guide us.	</connect>
2040.translation_tr: <connect>	Kendimi sisman hissediyorum... yani, kotuluk bize yol gostersin.	</connect>

2041.source_en: <connect>	Welcome.. *pant*... back.. *pant*... I'm out of shape!	</connect>
2041.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin.. *nefes nefese*... geri.. *nefes nefese*... formdan dusmusum!	</connect>

2044.source_en: <levelup>	We must continue, continue we must. You and I, we are great!	</levelup>
2044.translation_tr: <levelup>	Devam etmeliyiz, etmeliyiz. Sen ve ben harikayiz!	</levelup>

2045.source_en: <levelup>	I am so glad to see you level up..!!...	</levelup>

2051.source_en: <feeding>	Yum...growing boys like me need lots of food to grow strong.	</feeding>
2051.translation_tr: <feeding>	Nefis... benim gibi buyuyen cocuklar guclenmek icin cok yemek yemeli.	</feeding>

2052.source_en: <hunting>	I don't care, dead, alive, on the ground, I'll eat it!	</hunting>
2052.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umurumda degil, olu, canli, yerde... yerim!	</hunting>

2053.source_en: <hunting>	Let's hope it drops some meat for me!	</hunting>

2054.source_en: <danger>	It looks like you're feeling as bad as I do!	</danger>

2056.source_en: <dead>	Serves you right! You best feed me next time.	</dead>
2056.translation_tr: <dead>	Hak ettin! Bir dahaki sefere beni beslesen iyi olur.	</dead>

2057.translation_tr: <dead>	Kalk! Yemek zamani... uyku zamani degil!	</dead>

2058.source_en: <dead>	I do the sad dance now...	</dead>

2059.source_en: <stand>	We standing right here, cause I'm too hungry to move.	</stand>
2059.translation_tr: <stand>	Burada duruyoruz cunku hareket edemeyecek kadar acim.	</stand>

2061.source_en: <stand>	No, that's my real hair color!	</stand>
2061.translation_tr: <stand>	Hayir, bu benim gercek sac rengim!	</stand>

2062.source_en: <connect>	I missed you...almost as much as I missed my last meal.	</connect>
2062.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni ozledim... neredeyse son ogunumu ozledigim kadar.	</connect>

2063.source_en: <connect>	I thought you'd be right back! I was so hungry...	</connect>

2064.source_en: <connect>	Good you came back, I hope you brought some food with you~	</connect>
2064.translation_tr: <connect>	Iyi ki geri geldin, umarim yaninda yemek getirdin~	</connect>

2065.source_en: <levelup>	Finally! Can we go eat now?!	</levelup>

2066.source_en: <levelup>	I hope to be as strong as you some day~!	</levelup>
2066.translation_tr: <levelup>	Umarim bir gun senin kadar guclu olurum~!	</levelup>

2069.source_en: <feeding>	Praise the lord and pass the ketchup!	</feeding>

2071.source_en: <hunting>	How about we stop, and have ourselves a picnic?	</hunting>

2073.source_en: <hunting>	I hope we're looking for a restaurant.	</hunting>

2074.source_en: <danger>	If you gonna eat something now, how about sharing?	</danger>
2074.translation_tr: <danger>	Simdi bir sey yiyeceksen paylassan nasil olur?	</danger>

2075.source_en: <dead>	Now that we're going back to town... can we eat?	</dead>
2075.translation_tr: <dead>	Simdi sehre donuyoruz... yemek yiyebilir miyiz?	</dead>

2077.source_en: <stand>	I think the butcher's shop is that way.	</stand>

2079.source_en: <stand>	Did you hear growling? Oh, it was just my stomach.	</stand>
2079.translation_tr: <stand>	Gurultu duydun mu? Ah, sadece midemmis.	</stand>

2080.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back! There's a food vender in Prontera, so let's go!	</connect>
2080.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin! Prontera'da yemek saticisi var, hadi gidelim!	</connect>

2081.source_en: <connect>	Hiya..lets go get some Poring stew.	</connect>
2081.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam.. hadi biraz Poring guvec alalim.	</connect>

2082.source_en: <connect>	HOHOHO, there's the guy who shoulda fed me earlier!	</connect>
2082.translation_tr: <connect>	HOHOHO, iste beni daha once beslemesi gereken kisi!	</connect>

2083.source_en: <levelup>	Watching you level makes me hungry...	</levelup>

2087.source_en: <feeding>	This is better than fried Eggyra!	</feeding>

2089.source_en: <hunting>	Uh oh! Did you hear that?	</hunting>

2091.source_en: <danger>	Look out! Look out! He's comin at you again!	</danger>

2093.source_en: <stand>	So what are we up to? Cruisin' for a bruisin'?	</stand>

2094.source_en: <stand>	Lets go visit my friend Eggyra!	</stand>

2095.source_en: <stand>	We are best friends, much happy time!	</stand>
2095.translation_tr: <stand>	Biz en iyi dostuz, cok mutlu zaman!	</stand>

2102.source_en: <feeding>	Ok no more...I will get chubby.	</feeding>

2105.source_en: <hunting>	I can do some scary voodoo!	</hunting>

2106.source_en: <hunting>	Do you think Baphomet really exists? I bet I could take him!	</hunting>
2106.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sence Baphomet gercekten var mi? Eminim onu yenebilirim!	</hunting>

2108.source_en: <danger>	Hide behind me...I will save you~!	</danger>

2111.source_en: <dead>	You are going to the happy hunting grounds...	</dead>

2113.source_en: <stand>	Oh, all this time I thought you were MY pet!	</stand>
2113.translation_tr: <stand>	Ah, tum bu zaman boyunca senin BENIM petim oldugunu sanmistim!	</stand>

2114.source_en: <stand>	Say there mama, where you been all my life?	</stand>
2114.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey guzelim, tum hayatim boyunca neredeydin?	</stand>

2117.source_en: <connect>	A-ha! So that is where you have been hiding.	</connect>

2120.source_en: <levelup>	Sigh, I remember when you were such a little guy...	</levelup>

2123.source_en: <feeding>	Get that out of my face! What's wrong with you?	</feeding>
2123.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sunun yuzumden cek! Senin neyin var?	</feeding>

2124.source_en: <feeding>	You go ahead..I had too much lunch.	</feeding>
2124.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sen onde git.. ogle yemegini fazla kacirdim.	</feeding>

2125.source_en: <hunting>	Man, I need to drop a few pounds.	</hunting>

2126.source_en: <danger>	It's all you man. I'm too fat to help.	</danger>
2126.translation_tr: <danger>	Hepsi sende dostum. Yardim edemeyecek kadar sismanim.	</danger>

2127.source_en: <dead>	Yeah, I'm with you. Let's both take a nap.	</dead>
2127.translation_tr: <dead>	Evet, seninleyim. Ikimiz de biraz uyuyalim.	</dead>

2128.source_en: <dead>	Is it naptime already? I think I will join you.	</dead>
2128.translation_tr: <dead>	Uyku zamani geldi mi? Sana katilayim.	</dead>

2130.source_en: <stand>	You think I'm a child? I'm older then you are!	</stand>
2130.translation_tr: <stand>	Cocuk oldugumu mu saniyorsun? Senden daha yasliyim!	</stand>

2131.source_en: <connect>	AWWWW man! Not again! I need a break!	</connect>
2131.translation_tr: <connect>	AWWW dostum! Yine mi! Ara vermem gerek!	</connect>

2132.source_en: <connect>	I was just about to go work out...	</connect>

2133.source_en: <levelup>	Good for you, Can we go home now?	</levelup>
2133.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin adina iyi, simdi eve gidebilir miyiz?	</levelup>

2134.source_en: <levelup>	I would jump for joy...but my tummy hurts.	</levelup>

2140.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks, master haven't you got some food for me?	</feeding>
2140.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler efendim, benim icin biraz yemek yok mu?	</feeding>

2141.source_en: <feeding>	Master, you're so nice, thank you.	</feeding>

2142.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you... can I have some more please...? I'm starving...	</feeding>
2142.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler... biraz daha alabilir miyim lutfen...? Acliktan oluyorum...	</feeding>

2143.source_en: <hunting>	I'm so hungry, I could eat a... Munak...	</hunting>
2143.translation_tr: <hunting>	O kadar acim ki bir... Munak... yiyebilirim.	</hunting>

2145.source_en: <hunting>	Master... hogging all the items for yourself is not very nice, please give some to me, I'm hungry.	</hunting>
2145.translation_tr: <hunting>	Efendim... tum esyalari kendinize saklamak pek hos degil, lutfen bana da verin, acim.	</hunting>

2147.source_en: <danger>	Maybe you would be better if you rest a little.	</danger>
2147.translation_tr: <danger>	Belki biraz dinlensen daha iyi olursun.	</danger>

2148.source_en: <danger>	Master, healing seems like a good idea right now...	</danger>
2148.translation_tr: <danger>	Efendim, su an heal iyi fikir gibi...	</danger>

2151.source_en: <dead>	Great... now who will I get food from...	</dead>

2152.source_en: <dead>	Master, forgive me, you should have fed me, now I must eat you I'm so hungry.	</dead>
2152.translation_tr: <dead>	Efendim, beni affedin, beni beslemeliydiniz, simdi sizi yemek zorundayim, cok acim.	</dead>

2153.source_en: <stand>	Master, I am quite hungry, please feed me...	</stand>
2153.translation_tr: <stand>	Efendim, oldukca acim, lutfen beni besleyin...	</stand>

2155.source_en: <stand>	... if you don't have anything to do at the moment, can you feed me... pretty please?	</stand>
2155.translation_tr: <stand>	... su an yapacak bir seyin yoksa beni besler misin... lutfen?	</stand>

2156.source_en: <connect>	Hello, it is nice to see you again.	</connect>

2158.source_en: <connect>	God morning master. We have much to do today?	</connect>
2158.translation_tr: <connect>	Gunaydin efendim. Bugun yapacak cok isimiz var mi?	</connect>

2159.source_en: <connect>	Hi, now that you're finally back you can feed me...	</connect>
2159.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam, sonunda geri geldin, simdi beni besleyebilirsin...	</connect>

2162.source_en: <levelup>	Oh, you leveled up...? Sorry, I didn't notice... I'm too busy trying to control my hunger...	</levelup>
2162.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah, level atladin...? Uzgunum fark etmedim... acligimi kontrol etmekle cok mesguldum...	</levelup>

2166.source_en: <feeding>	Oh, forgive me I was hungry. Pardon my eating.	</feeding>
2166.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ah, beni affet, aciktim. Yeme tarzimi mazur gor.	</feeding>

2167.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you for feeding me with such a meal.	</feeding>
2167.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni boyle bir yemekle besledigin icin tesekkur ederim.	</feeding>

2168.source_en: <hunting>	I will stand by your side at all costs...	</hunting>

2169.source_en: <hunting>	Dear, have you thought that maybe there are other ways to make money than this?	</hunting>
2169.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sevgilim, para kazanmanin bundan baska yollari olabilecegini dusundun mu?	</hunting>

2171.source_en: <danger>	No! Please, dear, sit down and rest! Please!	</danger>
2171.translation_tr: <danger>	Hayir! Lutfen sevgilim, otur ve dinlen! Lutfen!	</danger>

2173.source_en: <dead>	Master, don't you think is a bit early to have a nap?	</dead>
2173.translation_tr: <dead>	Efendim, uyumak icin biraz erken degil mi?	</dead>

2174.source_en: <stand>	Could I bother you for a morsel of food?	</stand>
2174.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir lokma yemek icin seni rahatsiz edebilir miyim?	</stand>

2175.source_en: <stand>	Do you think they sell sushi in Alberta?	</stand>

2176.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back. It is a pleasure to see you again.	</connect>
2176.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin. Seni tekrar gormek guzel.	</connect>

2177.source_en: <connect>	Ah, master... you returned. I'm happy to see you.	</connect>
2177.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah, efendim... geri dondunuz. Sizi gordugume sevindim.	</connect>

2178.source_en: <connect>	Good morning! Have you brought some food?	</connect>

2180.source_en: <levelup>	Wow, master... you are my hero.	</levelup>

2181.source_en: <levelup>	I hope you are happy with your new found strength, I am losing some of mine from hungry.	</levelup>
2181.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yeni gucunuzle mutlusunuzdur umarim, ben acliktan biraz guc kaybediyorum.	</levelup>

2184.source_en: <feeding>	Oh, thank you, I appreciate it!	</feeding>

2186.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you master, hmm... this needs a little more salt, but still tasty.	</feeding>
2186.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler efendim, hmm... biraz daha tuz lazim ama yine de lezzetli.	</feeding>

2187.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks, it was very well prepared	</feeding>

2189.source_en: <hunting>	I have heard that selling items is a good way to make money too.	</hunting>
2189.translation_tr: <hunting>	Esya satmanin da para kazanmak icin iyi yol oldugunu duydum.	</hunting>

2190.source_en: <danger>	Master, look out for your health...	</danger>

2191.source_en: <danger>	Dear, don't leave me alone. Come on, stand up, let's go to have a walk together.	</danger>
2191.translation_tr: <danger>	Sevgilim, beni yalniz birakma. Hadi kalk, birlikte yuruyuse cikalim.	</danger>

2192.source_en: <dead>	You must stop doing this to yourself..	</dead>

2193.source_en: <dead>	Noooooo!!! You evil mob! Just wait, we will get our revenge!	</dead>
2193.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayiiir!!! Seni kotu mob! Bekle, intikamimizi alacagiz!	</dead>

2194.source_en: <dead>	Oh no! Sit and rest immediately! Help! Help! A merchant who sold potions, a priest who can heal! Please, help my master!	</dead>
2194.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah hayir! Hemen otur ve dinlen! Yardim! Yardim! Iksir satan bir merchant, heal yapabilen bir priest! Lutfen efendime yardim edin!	</dead>

2195.source_en: <dead>	... that's got to hurt... don't worry, we'll get revenge later.	</dead>
2195.translation_tr: <dead>	... bu acitmistir... endiselenme, sonra intikam aliriz.	</dead>

2196.source_en: <stand>	Why do I float, when you all touch the ground? Why am I different?	</stand>
2196.translation_tr: <stand>	Siz yere basarken ben neden havada yuzuyorum? Neden farkliyim?	</stand>

2198.source_en: <stand>	How about that walk you promised me before?	</stand>
2198.translation_tr: <stand>	Daha once soz verdigin yuruyuse ne oldu?	</stand>

2199.source_en: <stand>	Haven't you heard? My friend the Munak is going out with a Bongun... why can't I meet someone?	</stand>
2199.translation_tr: <stand>	Duymadin mi? Arkadasim Munak bir Bongun ile cikiyor... ben neden biriyle tanisamiyorum?	</stand>

2202.source_en: <levelup>	You are getting stronger each and every day~	</levelup>

2203.source_en: <levelup>	Oh my, you're so strong now!	</levelup>

2206.source_en: <feeding>	I'm actually a little full right now...	</feeding>

2207.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ee, lutfen, daha fazla yok efendim...	</feeding>

2208.source_en: <hunting>	I've always enjoyed sitting down under a nice shady spot...	</hunting>
2208.translation_tr: <hunting>	Guzel golgelik bir yerde oturmayi hep sevmisimdir...	</hunting>

2209.source_en: <hunting>	Maybe I should try being a Kafra, they make good money without killing...	</hunting>
2209.translation_tr: <hunting>	Belki Kafra olmayi denemeliyim, oldurmeden iyi para kazaniyorlar...	</hunting>

2211.source_en: <danger>	Master, I don't want see you become an undead too.	</danger>
2211.translation_tr: <danger>	Efendim, sizin de undead olmanizi istemiyorum.	</danger>

2212.source_en: <dead>	... at this rate you'll be a ghost like me.	</dead>
2212.translation_tr: <dead>	... bu gidisle benim gibi hayalet olacaksin.	</dead>

2213.source_en: <dead>	hmm master... would you like to float around with me?	</dead>
2213.translation_tr: <dead>	Hmm efendim... benimle biraz havada dolasmak ister misiniz?	</dead>

2215.source_en: <stand>	Master, which is prettier to you, Munak or Sohee? (Don't say Munak... don't say Munak...)	</stand>
2215.translation_tr: <stand>	Efendim, sence hangisi daha guzel, Munak mi Sohee mi? (Munak deme... Munak deme...)	</stand>

2216.source_en: <connect>	Master, I have been waiting for you...	</connect>

2217.source_en: <connect>	Master, master! I found you!! Oh.. we're not playing hide and seek?	</connect>
2217.translation_tr: <connect>	Efendim, efendim! Sizi buldum!! Ah.. saklambac oynamiyor muyuz?	</connect>

2218.source_en: <connect>	My wonderful master! I'm so pleased to see you again!	</connect>
2218.translation_tr: <connect>	Harika efendim! Sizi tekrar gordugume cok sevindim!	</connect>

2220.source_en: <levelup>	Oh well done, I'll have to give you a prize later.	</levelup>
2220.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah, iyi yaptin, sonra sana bir odul vermeliyim.	</levelup>

2223.source_en: <feeding>	Ooh... please stop. I am too full!	</feeding>

2224.source_en: <feeding>	You hate me, don't you? You're trying to kill me with food.	</feeding>
2224.translation_tr: <feeding>	Benden nefret ediyorsun, degil mi? Beni yemekle oldurmeye calisiyorsun.	</feeding>

2226.source_en: <hunting>	Oh, my... I feel sick my stomach... Doctor is a good paid job too.	</hunting>
2226.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ah... midem kotu... Doktorluk da iyi para kazandiriyor.	</hunting>

2227.source_en: <danger>	Master, I think you should take a rest...	</danger>

2228.source_en: <danger>	Ehm, dear... What's that red thing that is coming out your ear?	</danger>
2228.translation_tr: <danger>	Ehm sevgilim... kulagindan cikan o kirmizi sey ne?	</danger>

2229.source_en: <dead>	Oh Master, you need to listen more...	</dead>

2230.source_en: <dead>	Oh well, now we can go to my home. I have enough space for you, and we will be together eternally.	</dead>
2230.translation_tr: <dead>	Neyse, simdi evime gidebiliriz. Sana yetecek yerim var ve sonsuza dek birlikte olacagiz.	</dead>

2232.source_en: <stand>	Ooh, couldn't we go to the doctor, please? I feel very sick...	</stand>
2232.translation_tr: <stand>	Ooh, doktora gidebilir miyiz lutfen? Kendimi cok hasta hissediyorum...	</stand>

2233.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back, Master. It's such a great day out today.	</connect>
2233.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldiniz Efendim. Bugun disarisi harika.	</connect>

2234.source_en: <connect>	Great! At last the sun show its face with your return, my love.	</connect>
2234.translation_tr: <connect>	Harika! Donusunle sonunda gunes yuzunu gosterdi sevgilim.	</connect>

2235.source_en: <levelup>	Ah... another level I see. Very good.	</levelup>
2235.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah... bir level daha goruyorum. Cok iyi.	</levelup>

2236.source_en: <levelup>	... Do you think I'm getting fat?	</levelup>

2242.source_en: <feeding>	My late master, Osiris never starved me like you....	</feeding>
2242.translation_tr: <feeding>	Merhum efendim Osiris beni senin gibi hic ac birakmazdi....	</feeding>

2243.source_en: <feeding>	Is this low fat? Awww... who cares? I'm starved!	</feeding>
2243.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu az yagli mi? Awww... kimin umurunda? Acliktan oluyorum!	</feeding>

2246.source_en: <hunting>	Sso, thiss iss how I'm fed now?	</hunting>

2247.source_en: <hunting>	I'm hoping you have sssome food for me, otherwisse you're ssnake-bait!	</hunting>
2247.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim benim icin biraz yemegin vardir, yoksa yilan yemi olursun!	</hunting>

2248.source_en: <hunting>	You're sstarving me AND making me do labor? Osiris iss not happy.	</hunting>
2248.translation_tr: <hunting>	Beni ac birakip bir de calistiriyor musun? Osiris mutlu degil.	</hunting>

2250.source_en: <danger>	Whoopss, lookss like you need ssome help.	</danger>
2250.translation_tr: <danger>	Whoops, biraz yardima ihtiyacin var gibi.	</danger>

2251.source_en: <danger>	Feed me before your horrible death consssumes you.	</danger>
2251.translation_tr: <danger>	Korkunc olumun seni yutmadan once beni besle.	</danger>

2252.source_en: <danger>	You don't know what your doing, do you?	</danger>

2253.source_en: <danger>	My magic will be useless if you don't feed me.	</danger>

2254.source_en: <dead>	Oh dear, you ssshould be more conssiderate when feeding me.	</dead>
2254.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah sevgilim, beni beslerken biraz daha dusunceli olmalisin.	</dead>

2255.source_en: <dead>	Thiss iss how they all end up.	</dead>

2256.source_en: <dead>	Give Osiris my regardsss... and tell him to ssend up some food.	</dead>
2256.translation_tr: <dead>	Osiris'e selamlarimi ilet... ve biraz yemek gondermesini soyle.	</dead>

2257.source_en: <dead>	I'd better go sell my "Necklace" for food...! Sssee you in town!!	</dead>
2257.translation_tr: <dead>	Yemek icin "Necklace"imi satsam iyi olacak...! Sehirde gorusuruz!!	</dead>

2258.source_en: <stand>	Sssome of these people look... tantalizing...	</stand>
2258.translation_tr: <stand>	Bu insanlardan bazilari... cok cazip gorunuyor...	</stand>

2259.source_en: <stand>	Look at me. I'm so skinny my thighs are barely touching. Oh, wait, I don't have thighs, never mind.	</stand>
2259.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana bak. O kadar zayifim ki baldirlarim zar zor birbirine degiyor. Ah bekle, baldirim yok, bos ver.	</stand>

2260.source_en: <stand>	What are you doing? Stop standing around or I'll eat that Acolyte!	</stand>
2260.translation_tr: <stand>	Ne yapiyorsun? Oylece durmayi birak yoksa su Acolyte'i yerim!	</stand>

2261.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back. Ssshall we go get sssome food?	</connect>
2261.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin. Biraz yemek almaya gidelim mi?	</connect>

2263.source_en: <connect>	Are my servants here to serve me? Oh... it's only you...	</connect>
2263.translation_tr: <connect>	Hizmetkarlarim bana hizmet etmeye mi geldi? Ah... sadece senmissin...	</connect>

2264.source_en: <levelup>	Ssso strong... It's time for food sshopping, is it not?	</levelup>
2264.translation_tr: <levelup>	Cok guclu... Yemek alisverisi zamani, degil mi?	</levelup>

2266.source_en: <levelup>	You're not stronger than my hunnie-poo.	</levelup>

2271.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you for feeding me well.	</feeding>
2271.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni iyi besledigin icin tesekkur ederim.	</feeding>

2272.source_en: <hunting>	*chuckle* With your sstrength, I'll be up and about in no time.	</hunting>
2272.translation_tr: <hunting>	*kikirdar* Senin gucunle kisa surede ayaga kalkarim.	</hunting>

2273.source_en: <hunting>	I feel like some Grade A roasted Peco Pecos.	</hunting>
2273.translation_tr: <hunting>	Canim birinci kalite kizarmis Peco Peco cekiyor.	</hunting>

2274.source_en: <hunting>	I'm still not in any condition for exercise...	</hunting>

2275.source_en: <danger>	Pleasse, don't die... There's sso much I have to tell you!	</danger>
2275.translation_tr: <danger>	Lutfen olme... Sana soyleyecek cok seyim var!	</danger>

2277.source_en: <danger>	Woah. You look as healthy as a ghoul. Slow down a bit.	</danger>
2277.translation_tr: <danger>	Vay. Bir Ghoul kadar saglikli gorunuyorsun. Biraz yavasla.	</danger>

2278.source_en: <danger>	You don't have to worry about dying. Osiris will take good care of you.	</danger>
2278.translation_tr: <danger>	Olmekten endiselenme. Osiris sana iyi bakar.	</danger>

2280.source_en: <dead>	Honey, please take good care of this person.	</dead>
2280.translation_tr: <dead>	Tatlim, lutfen bu kisiye iyi bak.	</dead>

2282.source_en: <stand>	I'm famished... Even a Sscell is looking good...	</stand>
2282.translation_tr: <stand>	Acliktan oluyorum... Bir Cell bile guzel gorunuyor...	</stand>

2283.source_en: <stand>	I wonder if Osiris is hungry....	</stand>

2284.source_en: <connect>	Sshall we look into the menu for today?	</connect>

2285.source_en: <connect>	Hello, what'ss on the menu today? Novices...?	</connect>
2285.translation_tr: <connect>	Merhaba, bugun menude ne var? Noviceler...?	</connect>

2286.source_en: <connect>	What took you so long? Don't blame it on traffic. So, got anything to eat on ya?	</connect>
2286.translation_tr: <connect>	Neden bu kadar gec kaldin? Trafigi bahane etme. Yaninda yiyecek var mi?	</connect>

2287.source_en: <levelup>	Sso, slick... Issn't it about treat ssomeone?	</levelup>
2287.translation_tr: <levelup>	Cok havali... Birini ismar etme zamani degil mi?	</levelup>

2288.source_en: <levelup>	1 point up on the food chain...	</levelup>

2289.source_en: <levelup>	Good for you! I like my pets strong and high-leveled! What?	</levelup>
2289.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin adina iyi! Petlerimin guclu ve yuksek levelli olmasini severim! Ne?	</levelup>

2292.source_en: <feeding>	Ahh... I like the way it slithers down my throat...	</feeding>

2294.source_en: <feeding>	I can feel my magic growing stronger.	</feeding>

2295.source_en: <hunting>	Let me ssee... You are ready, aren't you?	</hunting>

2296.source_en: <hunting>	Beware! I am Isis, god of magic!	</hunting>

2297.source_en: <danger>	You're bleeding! We musst get you something to stop it!	</danger>
2297.translation_tr: <danger>	Kaniyorsun! Bunu durduracak bir sey bulmaliyiz!	</danger>

2298.source_en: <danger>	If my son Horus was here, he could help protect us.	</danger>
2298.translation_tr: <danger>	Oglum Horus burada olsaydi bizi korumaya yardim edebilirdi.	</danger>

2299.source_en: <dead>	Oh dear... Perhapss I should go entice that Priesst over there..?	</dead>
2299.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah canim... Belki su Priest'i buraya cekmeliyim..?	</dead>

2300.source_en: <dead>	Don't worry. Osiris will have you up in a jiffy.	</dead>
2300.translation_tr: <dead>	Endiselenme. Osiris seni hemen ayaga kaldirir.	</dead>

2301.source_en: <stand>	My nailss are getting long again... Do you have a sset of clipperss?	</stand>
2301.translation_tr: <stand>	Tirnaklarim yine uzuyor... Tirnak makasin var mi?	</stand>

2302.source_en: <stand>	I think all the food I eat goes to my chest.	</stand>
2302.translation_tr: <stand>	Sanirim yedigim tum yemek goguslerime gidiyor.	</stand>

2303.source_en: <stand>	o/" Walk like an Egyptian... o/"	</stand>

2304.source_en: <stand>	I polished my tail. You think Osiris will like?	</stand>
2304.translation_tr: <stand>	Kuyrugumu parlattim. Sence Osiris begenir mi?	</stand>

2306.source_en: <connect>	It's you! Oh, I did miss you sso.	</connect>

2307.source_en: <connect>	Hurrah you're back!!! *Jumps up and down* Err.. what are you looking at? o.O	</connect>
2307.translation_tr: <connect>	Yasasin geri geldin!!! *ziplar* Ee.. neye bakiyorsun? o.O	</connect>

2308.source_en: <levelup>	Ssomeone's squirming their way to the top.	</levelup>

2314.source_en: <feeding>	Oh dear, if you keep feeding me like thiss, I'll be on a diet!	</feeding>
2314.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ah canim, beni boyle beslemeye devam edersen diyete girecegim!	</feeding>

2315.source_en: <feeding>	Are you trying to ruin my girlish figure?	</feeding>

2317.source_en: <hunting>	Time for a sssacrifice to Osiris.	</hunting>

2318.source_en: <hunting>	I think my tail is in a knot...	</hunting>

2319.source_en: <danger>	I'd sstrangle you, but you're already dead...	</danger>

2320.source_en: <danger>	Tsss, you want me to bite their headsss off?	</danger>

2321.source_en: <dead>	I'd sstrangle you, but you're already dead...	</dead>

2322.source_en: <dead>	No...! I'll get revenge for you!	</dead>

2323.source_en: <dead>	Osiris, honey? Can you send my friend back?	</dead>
2323.translation_tr: <dead>	Osiris, tatlim? Dostumu geri gonderebilir misin?	</dead>

2324.source_en: <stand>	I don't like the way the men look at me ssometimes. I'll go sslap them.	</stand>
2324.translation_tr: <stand>	Erkeklerin bazen bana bakislarini sevmiyorum. Gidip tokatlayacagim.	</stand>

2325.source_en: <stand>	*GASP* Oh my GOD! Is that...a WRINKLE!?	</stand>
2325.translation_tr: <stand>	*NEFESI KESILIR* Aman TANRIM! O... bir KIRISIKLIK mi!?	</stand>

2329.source_en: <connect>	Where the heck have you been? I was getting a little worried honesstly.	</connect>

2331.source_en: <levelup>	Good to see you're getting less-wimpy! I like a strong brave pet ~.^	</levelup>
2331.translation_tr: <levelup>	Daha az korkak oldugunu gormek guzel! Guclu ve cesur pet severim ~.^	</levelup>

2332.source_en: <levelup>	Wow! You ARE strong. Maybe I should call my son Horus to challenge you.	</levelup>
2332.translation_tr: <levelup>	Vay! Gercekten guclusun. Belki oglum Horus'u sana meydan okumaya cagirmaliyim.	</levelup>

2336.source_en: <feeding>	Stop, stop! Not ALL this food went to my chest! My scales are about to burst!	</feeding>
2336.translation_tr: <feeding>	Dur, dur! Bu yemegin HEPSI goguslerime gitmedi! Pullarim patlamak uzere!	</feeding>

2337.source_en: <feeding>	Please... no more... this is torture...	</feeding>
2337.translation_tr: <feeding>	Lutfen... daha fazla verme... bu iskence...	</feeding>

2338.source_en: <feeding>	Look, if you want me to keep my girlish figure, stop shoving those at me.	</feeding>
2338.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bak, kadin vucudumu korumami istiyorsan bunlari agzima tikmayi birak.	</feeding>

2339.source_en: <hunting>	I feel like there'ss a ton of brickss inside me!	</hunting>
2339.translation_tr: <hunting>	Icimde bir ton tugla varmis gibi hissediyorum!	</hunting>

2340.source_en: <hunting>	Can I borrow a cotton shirt? Hisss... Hissss...	</hunting>
2340.translation_tr: <hunting>	Pamuklu bir gomlek odunc alabilir miyim? Hisss... Hissss...	</hunting>

2341.source_en: <danger>	Sshall I go and find ssomeone who's much better then you?	</danger>
2341.translation_tr: <danger>	Gidip senden cok daha iyi birini mi bulsam?	</danger>

2342.source_en: <dead>	Sso, you finally undersstand that it'ss you who'ss more important to me?	</dead>
2342.translation_tr: <dead>	Demek sonunda benim icin daha onemli olanin sen oldugunu anladin?	</dead>

2343.source_en: <dead>	Noo don't leave me!! Stay away from the light!!	</dead>
2343.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayir beni birakma!! Isiktan uzak dur!!	</dead>

2344.source_en: <dead>	...Don't be so hard on yourself... Isis will be with you..	</dead>
2344.translation_tr: <dead>	...Kendine bu kadar yuklenme... Isis seninle olacak..	</dead>

2346.source_en: <stand>	Do I look fat to you...?	</stand>

2347.source_en: <stand>	As much as I hate to admit it... you're a great pet to have around!...I AM the owner, right?	</stand>
2347.translation_tr: <stand>	Itiraf etmekten nefret etsem de... yaninda bulunmasi harika bir petsin!... SAHIP benim, degil mi?	</stand>

2348.source_en: <stand>	*Sob* How can Osiris see me like this?	</stand>

2350.source_en: <connect>	Yo yo homie what's up? ... What the hell am I saying...	</connect>
2350.translation_tr: <connect>	Yo yo dostum naber? ... Ben ne sacmaliyorum...	</connect>

2351.source_en: <connect>	Glad to see ya! Let's Ragnarok!	</connect>

2352.source_en: <levelup>	Sso sexy, but do you think of me the ssame?	</levelup>
2352.translation_tr: <levelup>	Cok seksi, peki benim icin de aynisini dusunuyor musun?	</levelup>

2353.source_en: <levelup>	Wee! Good job! Let's celebrate with some situps.	</levelup>
2353.translation_tr: <levelup>	Wee! Iyi is! Biraz mekikle kutlayalim.	</levelup>

2358.source_en: <feeding>	Hey come on now...I'm still hungry!	</feeding>

2359.source_en: <feeding>	OOOOOHHH yeah, what a wonderful thing. More, more!	</feeding>
2359.translation_tr: <feeding>	OOOOOHHH evet, ne harika bir sey. Daha fazla, daha fazla!	</feeding>

2360.source_en: <hunting>	I'm going to eat those valuable items of yours...	</hunting>

2362.source_en: <hunting>	Some Prontera cuisine would be nice!	</hunting>

2363.source_en: <danger>	You better feed me before you die!	</danger>
2363.translation_tr: <danger>	Olmeden once beni beslesen iyi olur!	</danger>

2364.source_en: <danger>	We should both go get some food.	</danger>
2364.translation_tr: <danger>	Ikimiz de gidip biraz yemek almaliyiz.	</danger>

2365.source_en: <danger>	Don't go dying on me! hmm never mind.	</danger>
2365.translation_tr: <danger>	Bana olup gitme! Hmm bos ver.	</danger>

2366.source_en: <dead>	I told you to feed me before you died...loser...	</dead>
2366.translation_tr: <dead>	Olmeden once beni besle demistim... ezik...	</dead>

2367.source_en: <dead>	You should be watching your back.	</dead>

2369.source_en: <stand>	Stop standing around and feed me!	</stand>
2369.translation_tr: <stand>	Oylece durmayi birak ve beni besle!	</stand>

2370.source_en: <stand>	Please give me a snack, I beg of you.	</stand>

2371.source_en: <stand>	Going already? You must eat pretty well	</stand>
2371.translation_tr: <stand>	Simdiden gidiyor musun? Iyi besleniyor olmalisin.	</stand>

2372.source_en: <stand>	Do you have any food in your pockets?	</stand>

2373.translation_tr: <stand>	HEY! beni besle ya da bir sey yap..	</stand>

2375.source_en: <connect>	It's about time you came, where is my breakfast!	</connect>

2377.source_en: <levelup>	You... now only if you fed me!	</levelup>

2379.source_en: <levelup>	Great, you're happy, now make me happy! Hint hint.	</levelup>
2379.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harika, sen mutlusun, simdi beni mutlu et! Ima ima.	</levelup>

2382.source_en: <feeding>	You, I'm still a little hungry...	</feeding>

2383.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks a lot, I was getting hungry. *munch*	</feeding>

2386.source_en: <hunting>	Mmm looks like chicken, I bet it tastes like chicken too!	</hunting>
2386.translation_tr: <hunting>	Mmm tavuga benziyor, eminim tadi da tavuk gibidir!	</hunting>

2388.source_en: <danger>	Your almost dead...can you feed me?	</danger>

2393.source_en: <stand>	Are you ready to fight again?	</stand>

2402.source_en: <hunting>	Whoa! Let me have one of those.	</hunting>

2406.source_en: <dead>	Yo man...what's your problem?! Get up!	</dead>

2408.source_en: <stand>	Let's go! I want to hunt!	</stand>

2412.source_en: <connect>	Thank goodness, I was getting lonely!	</connect>

2418.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you, but I don't think I can eat much more.	</feeding>
2418.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler ama daha fazla yiyebilecegimi sanmiyorum.	</feeding>

2419.source_en: <hunting>	I'm good, you're good! LET'S HUNT!	</hunting>
2419.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ben iyiyim, sen iyisin! HADI AVLANALIM!	</hunting>

2420.source_en: <hunting>	Lets find those rare items you want!!	</hunting>

2421.source_en: <danger>	You need a leaf or something...geez...	</danger>
2421.translation_tr: <danger>	Bir yapraga falan ihtiyacin var... off...	</danger>

2422.source_en: <danger>	You could have used my food money for red potions!	</danger>
2422.translation_tr: <danger>	Yemek parami red potion icin kullanabilirdin!	</danger>

2423.translation_tr: <dead>	Dostum... biliyor musun... cok fazla oluyorsun.	</dead>

2424.source_en: <dead>	NO! Now I have to use my fat stores!	</dead>
2424.translation_tr: <dead>	HAYIR! Simdi yag depolarimi kullanmam gerekecek!	</dead>

2425.source_en: <stand>	Man I'm getting stronger! What do you think?	</stand>

2426.source_en: <stand>	It must be nice to be able to stand	</stand>

2429.source_en: <levelup>	Oh yea! Let me get in on this!	</levelup>

2430.source_en: <levelup>	Hey! I gained a level too, in body mass!	</levelup>
2430.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey! Ben de level atladim, vucut kutlesinde!	</levelup>

2433.source_en: <feeding>	I'm gonna barf on you man!	</feeding>

2434.source_en: <feeding>	More food?! You must be rich!	</feeding>
2434.translation_tr: <feeding>	Daha cok yemek mi?! Zengin olmalisin!	</feeding>

2436.source_en: <hunting>	Ever wonder why you never found any good rare items?	</hunting>
2436.translation_tr: <hunting>	Neden hic iyi nadir esya bulamadigini merak ettin mi?	</hunting>

2437.source_en: <danger>	Oh I'll get that monster for that!	</danger>
2437.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah bunun icin o canavari halledecegim!	</danger>

2438.source_en: <danger>	OMG HEAL HIM! HE'S GONNA DIE HEAL HIM!	</danger>
2438.translation_tr: <danger>	AMAN TANRIM HEAL ET! OLECEK, HEAL ET!	</danger>

2439.source_en: <dead>	Come on now...get up so we can go hunt some more!	</dead>
2439.translation_tr: <dead>	Hadi artik... kalk da biraz daha avlanalim!	</dead>

2440.source_en: <dead>	Well, you should have ran instead of dieing~	</dead>

2443.source_en: <stand>	It must be nice to be able to stand	</stand>

2444.source_en: <connect>	Hey...let me rest a bit...I'm too full...	</connect>
2444.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey... biraz dinlenmeme izin ver... cok tokum...	</connect>

2446.source_en: <levelup>	Now can we rest? I'm gonna barf!	</levelup>

2447.source_en: <levelup>	Hey! I gained a level too, in body mass!	</levelup>
2447.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey! Ben de level atladim, vucut kutlesinde!	</levelup>

2452.source_en: <feeding>	Finally!! Please give more though. Little devils need lots of food!	</feeding>
2452.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sonunda!! Ama lutfen daha fazla ver. Kucuk seytanlar cok yemek ister!	</feeding>

2453.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you, do you have any fresh meat?	</feeding>

2454.source_en: <feeding>	Give me more food or I'll stab you with my fork!	</feeding>
2454.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bana daha cok yemek ver yoksa catalimla saplarim!	</feeding>

2456.source_en: <feeding>	That must have been the smallest shoot you could find.	</feeding>
2456.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bulabildigin en kucuk filiz bu olmali.	</feeding>

2457.source_en: <feeding>	Do you want to find out just how evil I can be?	</feeding>
2457.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ne kadar kotu olabilecegimi gormek ister misin?	</feeding>

2458.source_en: <hunting>	Can I make shish kabobs out of your loot...?	</hunting>

2459.source_en: <hunting>	Why not get that one? Are you scared of it?...wimp...	</hunting>
2459.translation_tr: <hunting>	Neden sunu almiyorsun? Ondan korkuyor musun?... korkak...	</hunting>

2460.source_en: <hunting>	I will poke you with this fork if you don't feed me.	</hunting>
2460.translation_tr: <hunting>	Beni beslemezsen bu catalla seni durterim.	</hunting>

2462.source_en: <danger>	Hee~ hee~, one more won't hurt! Just one more!	</danger>
2462.translation_tr: <danger>	Hee~ hee~, bir tane daha zarar vermez! Sadece bir tane!	</danger>

2463.source_en: <dead>	Maybe if I had food and wasn't a devil, you would be alive!	</dead>
2463.translation_tr: <dead>	Belki yemegim olsaydi ve seytan olmasaydim hayatta olurdun!	</dead>

2465.source_en: <stand>	By the way, can I get some food?!	</stand>
2465.translation_tr: <stand>	Bu arada, biraz yemek alabilir miyim?!	</stand>

2467.source_en: <stand>	What're you just STANDING there for?	</stand>

2468.source_en: <stand>	Why do bad things happen to bad people?	</stand>
2468.translation_tr: <stand>	Kotu insanlara neden kotu seyler olur?	</stand>

2470.source_en: <connect>	Hey you! Want me to stick this rod in your *cough* ...?	</connect>
2470.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey sen! Bu cubugu senin *oksurur* ... sokmami ister misin?	</connect>

2471.translation_tr: <connect>	Uyan uyan, yumurta ve bacon zamani	</connect>

2472.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, you're the best! ...can we celebrate with food?	</levelup>
2472.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, sen en iyisisin! ... yemekle kutlayabilir miyiz?	</levelup>

2473.source_en: <levelup>	Err, WAHOO...or something... eh, just feed me already.	</levelup>
2473.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ee, WAHOO... ya da neyse... hadi artik beni besle.	</levelup>

2476.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you very much!... ACK...I almost became nice...!!	</feeding>
2476.translation_tr: <feeding>	Cok tesekkurler!... ACK... az kalsin iyi biri oluyordum...!!	</feeding>

2478.source_en: <feeding>	Now I'm no longer see-through! Thanks again.	</feeding>

2480.source_en: <hunting>	Oh, I want to stab it too! Can I at least eat what it leaves behind?	</hunting>
2480.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ah, ben de saplamak istiyorum! En azindan geride biraktiklarini yiyebilir miyim?	</hunting>

2481.source_en: <hunting>	I'll go scare people and eat the food they drop.	</hunting>

2482.source_en: <danger>	Oh my dark lord... save us!	</danger>

2483.source_en: <danger>	You get hit way too much... you know that?	</danger>
2483.translation_tr: <danger>	Cok fazla darbe aliyorsun... biliyorsun degil mi?	</danger>

2484.source_en: <danger>	Suffering Satan! You should be careful... you're not as tough as you think.	</danger>
2484.translation_tr: <danger>	Satan askina! Dikkatli olmalisin... sandigin kadar dayanikli degilsin.	</danger>

2485.source_en: <danger>	And on your left, you'll see my latest victim in dire need of help...	</danger>
2485.translation_tr: <danger>	Solunda, acilen yardima ihtiyaci olan son kurbanimi goreceksin...	</danger>

2487.source_en: <dead>	Can't you feed me from the beyond? I'm hungry..	</dead>
2487.translation_tr: <dead>	Oteki taraftan beni besleyemiyor musun? Acim..	</dead>

2488.source_en: <dead>	1, 2, 3! You're out!! I now pronounce you the LOossaAaah!!!	</dead>
2488.translation_tr: <dead>	1, 2, 3! Oyun disi!! Seni simdi Eziiiik ilan ediyorum!!!	</dead>

2489.source_en: <dead>	Oof! Get off me!! Fall the OTHER way next time!	</dead>
2489.translation_tr: <dead>	Off! Ustumden kalk!! Bir dahaki sefere DIGER tarafa dus!	</dead>

2491.source_en: <stand>	You look hungry, how about we go rest and snack a little?	</stand>
2491.translation_tr: <stand>	Ac gorunuyorsun, biraz dinlenip atistiralim mi?	</stand>

2492.source_en: <stand>	Want to go release summoned monsters on Prontera?	</stand>
2492.translation_tr: <stand>	Prontera'da summon canavarlari salmaya gidelim mi?	</stand>

2493.source_en: <connect>	Now that you're here, let us go grab a bite to eat!	</connect>
2493.translation_tr: <connect>	Madem buradasin, hadi gidip bir seyler yiyelim!	</connect>

2495.source_en: <connect>	Do you think it's wrong to eat children?	</connect>

2496.source_en: <levelup>	Nice! Let's go celebrate!... dark children from below, come forth and do my bidding...!	</levelup>
2496.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzel! Hadi kutlayalim!... asaginin karanlik cocuklari, gelin ve emrimi yerine getirin...!	</levelup>

2498.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, now can we get some fresh meat?	</levelup>
2498.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, simdi biraz taze et alabilir miyiz?	</levelup>

2502.source_en: <feeding>	Not even Baphomet himself eats better then this!	</feeding>
2502.translation_tr: <feeding>	Baphomet bile bundan daha iyi yemez!	</feeding>

2503.source_en: <hunting>	Not bad.. not bad at all.	</hunting>

2504.source_en: <hunting>	Lord, when will you be done with this pitiful creature?	</hunting>
2504.translation_tr: <hunting>	Lordum, bu zavalli yaratiktan ne zaman kurtulacaksin?	</hunting>

2505.source_en: <hunting>	I'll put a curse on anyone that messes with us.	</hunting>

2507.source_en: <hunting>	Bah, this is not worth our time, kill it quickly, show it your true power!	</hunting>
2507.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bah, buna zaman harcamaya degmez, cabuk oldur, gercek gucunu goster!	</hunting>

2509.source_en: <danger>	Hey, if you're gonna drop to a knee, you better not start preying to the wrong guy...	</danger>
2509.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, diz cokeceksen yanlis kisiye dua etmeye baslama...	</danger>

2510.source_en: <danger>	Knock that off, kill it before you die again...	</danger>
2510.translation_tr: <danger>	Birak sunu, yine olmeden once onu oldur...	</danger>

2512.source_en: <danger>	Whoa there, time to bail! Get your booties in the high gear... yes, I said booties...why, what'd you hear?	</danger>
2512.translation_tr: <danger>	Vay, kacma zamani! Popolarinizi hizlandirin... evet popo dedim... sen ne duydun?	</danger>

2513.source_en: <dead>	I thought you said you could handle it!?	</dead>

2515.source_en: <dead>	Wiiinaaahh... not you.... hahaha, get up... no really, get up... ?... hello?*poke*	</dead>
2515.translation_tr: <dead>	Wiiinaaahh... sen degil.... hahaha, kalk... gercekten kalk...?... alo? *durter*	</dead>

2516.source_en: <dead>	Get up! I don't want to go back to Hell...it's more fun with you!	</dead>
2516.translation_tr: <dead>	Kalk! Cehenneme geri donmek istemiyorum... seninle daha eglenceli!	</dead>

2517.source_en: <stand>	I could use a new fork, don't you think?	</stand>
2517.translation_tr: <stand>	Yeni bir catal iyi olurdu, sence de oyle degil mi?	</stand>

2519.source_en: <stand>	Where to next? Hope it's somewhere spooky!	</stand>
2519.translation_tr: <stand>	Sirada nereye? Umarim korkunc bir yerdir!	</stand>

2520.source_en: <stand>	Y'know, I really like hangin' with you, you're alright...	</stand>
2520.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor musun, seninle takilmayi seviyorum, iyisin...	</stand>

2521.source_en: <stand>	I was friends with a Baphomet once. No, really!	</stand>
2521.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir zamanlar bir Baphomet ile arkadastim. Gercekten!	</stand>

2522.source_en: <connect>	Let's go! We got souls to steal and lives to ruin!	</connect>
2522.translation_tr: <connect>	Hadi gidelim! Calinacak ruhlar ve mahvedilecek hayatlar var!	</connect>

2523.source_en: <connect>	Hello, did you bring me some fresh meat?	</connect>
2523.translation_tr: <connect>	Merhaba, bana taze et getirdin mi?	</connect>

2525.source_en: <levelup>	You are as strong as Beelzebub himself!	</levelup>

2526.source_en: <levelup>	Sweet, let's head over to that special building and celebrate...	</levelup>
2526.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harika, su ozel binaya gidip kutlayalim...	</levelup>

2527.source_en: <levelup>	Touch-down! Home-run! GOOOOOOAAAAAALLLLLLL......wait.... what do you mean wrong game?	</levelup>
2527.translation_tr: <levelup>	Touch-down! Home-run! GOOOOOOOLLLLLL...... bir dakika... yanlis oyun ne demek?	</levelup>

2531.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks, but I'm stuffed.... Yes, I am the devil's cuddle toy!!!! Muhahahahaaaa!!!!	</feeding>
2531.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler ama tikabasa doydum.... Evet, ben seytanin sarilma oyuncagiyim!!!! Muhahahahaaaa!!!!	</feeding>

2532.source_en: <hunting>	Seems like you could use a break.	</hunting>

2533.source_en: <hunting>	Slow down, remember my stubby little legs?	</hunting>
2533.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yavasla, kisa kucuk bacaklarimi hatirliyor musun?	</hunting>

2535.source_en: <hunting>	Slowly, the fearsome Deviruchi stalks its prey... was that a crocodile I just saw?	</hunting>
2535.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yavasca, korkunc Deviruchi avini takip eder... az once bir timsah mi gordum?	</hunting>

2536.source_en: <hunting>	If you find food, keep it.... We devils don't have black holes in our bellies!!!	</hunting>
2536.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yemek bulursan kendine sakla.... Biz seytanlarin karninda kara delik yok!!!	</hunting>

2537.source_en: <danger>	Hmm, want me to go get a Yggdrasil Leaf?	</danger>
2537.translation_tr: <danger>	Hmm, gidip Yggdrasil Leaf getireyim mi?	</danger>

2538.source_en: <danger>	Careful there. Don't want to overdo it!	</danger>

2541.source_en: <dead>	Turn Undead!! ... no... wait, err... hmm...	</dead>
2541.translation_tr: <dead>	Turn Undead!! ... hayir... bekle, ee... hmm...	</dead>

2542.source_en: <dead>	Aah! I told you, you should have sold your soul for immortality!	</dead>
2542.translation_tr: <dead>	Aah! Sana demistim, olumsuzluk icin ruhunu satmaliydin!	</dead>

2543.source_en: <stand>	Maybe I can talk to my boss and get a promotion to Wraith or something?	</stand>
2543.translation_tr: <stand>	Belki patronumla konusup Wraith falan terfisi alabilirim?	</stand>

2545.source_en: <stand>	I think I'll hide in your hair...	</stand>

2546.source_en: <stand>	I think I could qualify as a food-critic.... you seem to think the same	</stand>
2546.translation_tr: <stand>	Sanirim yemek elestirmeni olabilirim... sen de oyle dusunuyor gibisin.	</stand>

2548.source_en: <connect>	Hi, there!! Think we can scare people today?	</connect>

2549.source_en: <levelup>	One step closer to true power!	</levelup>

2550.source_en: <levelup>	Excellent, everything's going according to plan...	</levelup>
2550.translation_tr: <levelup>	Mukemmel, her sey plana gore gidiyor...	</levelup>

2553.source_en: <feeding>	I might just puff up even bigger soon!	</feeding>

2555.source_en: <feeding>	I didn't think it was possible to get fat from eating shoots!	</feeding>
2555.translation_tr: <feeding>	Filiz yiyerek sismanlamanin mumkun oldugunu dusunmezdim!	</feeding>

2556.source_en: <hunting>	Ugh... this isn't going good with my stomach.	</hunting>

2560.source_en: <dead>	I kind of feel the same way as well.	</dead>
2560.translation_tr: <dead>	Ben de biraz ayni sekilde hissediyorum.	</dead>

2562.source_en: <stand>	Can I sit down? The sky keeps swirling around.	</stand>

2563.source_en: <stand>	It is hard to look evil when you are this chubby...	</stand>
2563.translation_tr: <stand>	Bu kadar tombulken kotu gorunmek zor...	</stand>

2564.source_en: <stand>	I know it's supposed to be the year of the monkey, but... c'mon when's it going to be MY turn! HUH?	</stand>
2564.translation_tr: <stand>	Maymun yili oldugunu biliyorum ama... BENIM sira ne zaman gelecek! HA?	</stand>

2565.source_en: <connect>	Hey! Let's go run around Prontera and burn those calories! Maybe a couple houses...	</connect>
2565.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Prontera'da kosup kalori yakalim! Belki birkac evi de...	</connect>

2566.source_en: <connect>	How about a quick run through Prontera... with some dead branches of course... heh...	</connect>
2566.translation_tr: <connect>	Prontera'da hizli bir kosuya ne dersin... tabii biraz Dead Branch ile... heh...	</connect>

2567.source_en: <connect>	Just in time for my inter-snack-nap-time.	</connect>
2567.translation_tr: <connect>	Atistirmalik arasi uyku saatime tam zamaninda.	</connect>

2568.source_en: <levelup>	Congrats! Now help me lose some pounds!!	</levelup>
2568.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tebrikler! Simdi biraz kilo vermeme yardim et!!	</levelup>

2569.source_en: <levelup>	You have inspired me to lose a few pounds.	</levelup>
2569.translation_tr: <levelup>	Birkac kilo vermem icin bana ilham verdin.	</levelup>

2570.source_en: <levelup>	When am I going to level up?	</levelup>

2575.source_en: <feeding>	Thank the stars, I couldn't possibly be MORE hungry. *chomp*snarf*	</feeding>
2575.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yildizlara sukur, daha fazla ac olamazdim. *ham* *hapur*	</feeding>

2576.source_en: <feeding>	Human! Give me more food or I will call my dad!	</feeding>
2576.translation_tr: <feeding>	Insan! Bana daha cok yemek ver yoksa babami cagiririm!	</feeding>

2577.source_en: <hunting>	Don't expect me to help you fight until you give me some FOOD.	</hunting>
2577.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bana YEMEK verene kadar savasta yardim bekleme.	</hunting>

2578.source_en: <hunting>	Bleh... You will never kill quicker than me.	</hunting>
2578.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bleh... Benden daha hizli asla olduremezsin.	</hunting>

2579.source_en: <danger>	Hey! Take a break! This is not a time to fight.	</danger>
2579.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey! Ara ver! Savasma zamani degil.	</danger>

2580.source_en: <danger>	Come on! Die! Now! I need your blood!	</danger>
2580.translation_tr: <danger>	Hadi! Ol! Simdi! Kanina ihtiyacim var!	</danger>

2581.source_en: <danger>	That's what happens when you block using your face. Wizen up!	</danger>
2581.translation_tr: <danger>	Yuzunle blok yaparsan boyle olur. Akillan!	</danger>

2582.source_en: <dead>	*tsk*tsk* Serves you right for not looking around.	</dead>

2583.source_en: <dead>	Another example of how stupid a human can be....	</dead>
2583.translation_tr: <dead>	Bir insanin ne kadar aptal olabilecegine bir ornek daha....	</dead>

2584.source_en: <stand>	I need food, there's an empty pit in my stomach.	</stand>
2584.translation_tr: <stand>	Yemege ihtiyacim var, midemde bos bir kuyu var.	</stand>

2585.source_en: <stand>	Are you trying to make me run...?	</stand>

2586.source_en: <stand>	Hey, do you know what wine goes with a severed Rocker head?	</stand>
2586.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, kesilmis Rocker kafasiyla hangi sarap gider biliyor musun?	</stand>

2587.source_en: <connect>	Hey! It was nice of you to come... even though you're LATE.	</connect>
2587.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Gelmen guzel... GEC kalmis olsan da.	</connect>

2588.source_en: <levelup>	*poke*poke* Let's go back to town and get food now.	</levelup>

2589.source_en: <levelup>	NO! You mustn't level up! You can't become powerful like me!	</levelup>
2589.translation_tr: <levelup>	HAYIR! Level atlamamalisin! Benim kadar guclu olamazsin!	</levelup>

2595.source_en: <hunting>	You think you can kill some of the dark beings?	</hunting>

2596.source_en: <danger>	I'd use a yellow potion right now if I were you.	</danger>
2596.translation_tr: <danger>	Senin yerinde olsam simdi Yellow Potion kullanirdim.	</danger>

2597.source_en: <dead>	What are you doing? Stand up, I tell you!	</dead>

2600.source_en: <connect>	*hops* C'mon, gimme a snack and let's head off!	</connect>
2600.translation_tr: <connect>	*ziplar* Hadi, bana atistirmalik ver ve gidelim!	</connect>

2601.source_en: <connect>	I hate you... not really, but c'mon where's the food?	</connect>
2601.translation_tr: <connect>	Senden nefret ediyorum... aslinda etmiyorum ama yemek nerede?	</connect>

2602.source_en: <levelup>	Oh yeah, oh yeah, beat their butts!	</levelup>
2602.translation_tr: <levelup>	Oh evet, oh evet, haklarindan gel!	</levelup>

2603.source_en: <levelup>	Great now you can kill a poring!	</levelup>

2607.source_en: <feeding>	This tastes like your blood~... how would I know...? ... don't ask.	</feeding>
2607.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bunun tadi senin kanin gibi~... nereden mi biliyorum...? ... sorma.	</feeding>

2608.source_en: <feeding>	That's more like it! Keep it comin'!	</feeding>

2609.source_en: <hunting>	I will help you if you give me your soul.	</hunting>

2610.source_en: <hunting>	The fear of prey smells divine!	</hunting>

2611.source_en: <hunting>	Mwhahahaha, let's go kick some monster ass!	</hunting>

2612.source_en: <danger>	I can't heal good people, you know that.	</danger>

2613.source_en: <dead>	I told you, you're not as powerful as me...	</dead>
2613.translation_tr: <dead>	Sana demistim, benim kadar guclu degilsin...	</dead>

2614.source_en: <stand>	What are you standing around for, let's go.	</stand>

2615.source_en: <stand>	Are you going to move or must I use my scythe?	</stand>
2615.translation_tr: <stand>	Hareket edecek misin yoksa tirpanimi mi kullanayim?	</stand>

2617.source_en: <connect>	Great! Your corpse is going to be fun to mess with.	</connect>

2618.source_en: <levelup>	WHAT? I didn't help you to level up! What's going on here?	</levelup>
2618.translation_tr: <levelup>	NE? Level atlamana ben yardim etmedim! Burada ne oluyor?	</levelup>

2619.source_en: <levelup>	.Good work! Let's try a harder monster now!	</levelup>
2619.translation_tr: <levelup>	.Iyi is! Simdi daha zor bir canavar deneyelim!	</levelup>

2622.source_en: <feeding>	Truly marvelous! I am quite full now, thank you!	</feeding>
2622.translation_tr: <feeding>	Gercekten harika! Simdi oldukca doydum, tesekkurler!	</feeding>

2623.source_en: <feeding>	Mmmm, tastes good, but don't overdo it.	</feeding>
2623.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmmm, tadi guzel ama fazla kacirma.	</feeding>

2624.source_en: <hunting>	I think dad will not be happy with me for being with you.	</hunting>
2624.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sanirim babam seninle olmamdan memnun olmayacak.	</hunting>

2625.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, how do you like my scythe? Shiny, huh? I polished it earlier..	</hunting>
2625.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, tirpanimi nasil buldun? Parlak, degil mi? Az once parlattim..	</hunting>

2626.source_en: <danger>	Me? Tired? Pssht, no way. Maybe YOU should rest though.	</danger>
2626.translation_tr: <danger>	Ben mi? Yorgun mu? Pssht, asla. Belki SEN dinlenmelisin.	</danger>

2627.source_en: <danger>	Let me tank them and train you!	</danger>

2629.source_en: <dead>	Poor human, I thought you could dodge better... I guess I gave you too much credit.	</dead>
2629.translation_tr: <dead>	Zavalli insan, daha iyi dodge yaparsin sanmistim... sana fazla guvenmisim.	</dead>

2633.source_en: <stand>	Why does everyone call me Junior? Call me MASTER... or die...	</stand>
2633.translation_tr: <stand>	Neden herkes bana Junior diyor? Bana EFENDI de... yoksa olursun...	</stand>

2634.source_en: <connect>	Late again. Don't you ever learn?	</connect>
2634.translation_tr: <connect>	Yine gec. Hic ders almiyor musun?	</connect>

2635.source_en: <connect>	Don't even think about complaining to me today... so help me, I will cut you down to my size!	</connect>
2635.translation_tr: <connect>	Bugun bana sikayet etmeyi aklindan bile gecirme... seni kendi boyuma kadar keserim!	</connect>

2636.source_en: <levelup>	Woot! now I can have a longer battle with you before you run like a chicken!	</levelup>
2636.translation_tr: <levelup>	Woot! Simdi tavuk gibi kacmadan once seninle daha uzun savasabilirim!	</levelup>

2637.source_en: <levelup>	This is like second nature to you, huh?	</levelup>
2637.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bu senin icin ikinci dogan gibi, ha?	</levelup>

2640.source_en: <feeding>	I'll be stuck to the ground like a Flora if you keep feeding me.	</feeding>
2640.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni beslemeye devam edersen Flora gibi yere yapisacagim.	</feeding>

2641.source_en: <hunting>	Stop! I don't want to eat more of your meat! It's dirty!	</hunting>
2641.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dur! Etinden daha fazla yemek istemiyorum! Kirli!	</hunting>

2642.translation_tr: <danger>	Bir iblis seni heal edebilir mi?	</danger>

2643.source_en: <dead>	Are you really... dead? Oh god please NO!!! I was only joking about you being weak, why didn't you tell me you were?	</dead>
2643.translation_tr: <dead>	Gercekten... oldun mu? Aman tanrim HAYIR!!! Zayif olmanla sadece saka yapiyordum, neden soylemedin?	</dead>

2644.source_en: <dead>	Aaahh, lying down, that's a good idea.	</dead>

2647.source_en: <stand>	My scythe feels rather heavy to carry right now..	</stand>
2647.translation_tr: <stand>	Tirpanim su an tasimak icin biraz agir geliyor..	</stand>

2648.source_en: <connect>	I'm not getting up yet, no way no how.	</connect>

2649.source_en: <connect>	Hey! I think I lost a little weight!	</connect>

2651.source_en: <levelup>	Well, not bad human... maybe you're not as weak as I thought.	</levelup>
2651.translation_tr: <levelup>	Fena degil insan... belki sandigim kadar zayif degilsin.	</levelup>

2656.source_en: <feeding>	Bleh... Can't you feed me on a regular basis?	</feeding>

2657.source_en: <feeding>	This isn't what I like! Munak would take care of me better... Hmph!	</feeding>
2657.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu sevdigim sey degil! Munak bana daha iyi bakardi... Hmph!	</feeding>

2659.source_en: <feeding>	I keep telling you, I want this stuff medium rare. Get it right next time, or um... you're fired!	</feeding>
2659.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sana surekli soyluyorum, bunu az-orta pismis istiyorum. Bir dahaki sefere dogru yap yoksa... kovuldun!	</feeding>

2662.source_en: <hunting>	Gimmie Food... I said gimmie food.	</hunting>
2662.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bana yemek ver... yemek ver dedim.	</hunting>

2663.source_en: <danger>	Ack! Why do you suck so much?!	</danger>

2664.source_en: <danger>	*tsk*tsk*... To think we're losing to that...	</danger>

2665.source_en: <danger>	Stop sucking, heal yourself and then feed me.	</danger>
2665.translation_tr: <danger>	Kotu oynamayi birak, kendini heal et sonra beni besle.	</danger>

2666.source_en: <dead>	... I dunno anymore... How long are we gonna be like this?... I feel faint...	</dead>
2666.translation_tr: <dead>	... Artik bilmiyorum... Ne kadar boyle olacagiz?... Bayilacak gibiyim...	</dead>

2667.source_en: <dead>	What are you gonna do now!? This is all your fault!	</dead>
2667.translation_tr: <dead>	Simdi ne yapacaksin!? Hepsi senin hatan!	</dead>

2668.source_en: <dead>	Noooo!! I can't eat you now!!	</dead>

2669.source_en: <dead>	Hey, weren't you listening to me?	</dead>

2670.source_en: <stand>	I'm hungry... only if I had something in my tummy...	</stand>
2670.translation_tr: <stand>	Acim... keske karnimda bir sey olsaydi...	</stand>

2671.source_en: <stand>	Ah.. my chest.. my chest suddenly hurts... I wonder why... anyway, feed me.	</stand>
2671.translation_tr: <stand>	Ah.. gogsum.. birden agriyor... neden acaba... neyse, beni besle.	</stand>

2674.source_en: <stand>	If you don't feed me, I'm going to eat you!	</stand>

2675.source_en: <stand>	Finally you're done. You ready to go? Geez, the things I do for servants... What's that look for?	</stand>
2675.translation_tr: <stand>	Sonunda bittin. Gitmeye hazir misin? Off, hizmetkarlar icin yaptiklarim... O bakis ne?	</stand>

2676.source_en: <stand>	I'm going to bite you!! You don't even feed me!	</stand>

2677.source_en: <connect>	I'm hungry. Hey? I said I'm hungry. Hurry and gimme food.	</connect>
2677.translation_tr: <connect>	Acim. Hey? Acim dedim. Acele et ve yemek ver.	</connect>

2678.source_en: <connect>	Where did you just come back from?!	</connect>

2679.source_en: <connect>	Make me food. I'm dying from hunger.	</connect>

2680.source_en: <connect>	There you are, exactly 2 minutes late for my meal. Just for that I want everything cut into bite size chunks.	</connect>
2680.translation_tr: <connect>	Iste geldin, yemegime tam 2 dakika gec kaldin. Bunun icin her seyi lokmalik parcalara kesmeni istiyorum.	</connect>

2681.source_en: <levelup>	You're becoming more and more useful...	</levelup>

2682.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tatmin oldun mu? Simdi yemek yiyelim.	</levelup>

2683.source_en: <levelup>	What're you doing?! You got your level! Now make me food!	</levelup>
2683.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ne yapiyorsun?! Levelini aldin! Simdi bana yemek yap!	</levelup>

2684.source_en: <perfor_1>	W...What is this?... Whenever I see this picture I get tears in my eyes...	</perfor_1>
2684.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	B...Bu da ne?... Bu resmi ne zaman gorsem gozlerim doluyor...	</perfor_1>

2691.source_en: <perfor_3>	Ho ho~ What a dull day.	</perfor_3>
2691.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Ho ho~ Ne sikici bir gun.	</perfor_3>

2692.source_en: <perfor_3>	I am so bored~ What is there to do?	</perfor_3>

2700.source_en: <feeding>	*chomp*chomp*... *tsk*... Don't misunderstand me... I'm only eating because I'm hungry, not because it's good.	</feeding>
2700.translation_tr: <feeding>	*ham* *ham*... *cik*... Yanlis anlama... Sadece ac oldugum icin yiyorum, guzel oldugu icin degil.	</feeding>

2701.source_en: <feeding>	I was getting the munchies anyway so I guess I'll eat some.	</feeding>

2702.source_en: <feeding>	Even though you can't do anything else, you sure do feed me well. Well at least with this, you can stay by my side~	</feeding>
2702.translation_tr: <feeding>	Baska hicbir sey yapamasan da beni iyi besliyorsun. En azindan bununla yanimda kalabilirsin~	</feeding>

2703.source_en: <feeding>	You picked this up off the ground, didn't you? No? Alright, but I'm watching you...	</feeding>
2703.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bunu yerden aldin, degil mi? Hayir mi? Tamam ama seni izliyorum...	</feeding>

2704.source_en: <feeding>	Wah~ I ate well. Now, I need water~.. Hm? Why aren't you bringing me water?	</feeding>
2704.translation_tr: <feeding>	Wah~ Iyi yedim. Simdi su lazim~.. Hm? Neden su getirmiyorsun?	</feeding>

2705.source_en: <feeding>	What kind of food is this? *tsk*... I'm only eating this food out of pity. *Chomp*Chomp*...	</feeding>
2705.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu ne bicim yemek? *cik*... Buna sadece aciyip yiyorum. *Ham* *Ham*...	</feeding>

2706.source_en: <hunting>	Okay, whatever you kill, we split 20-80... what...? I think giving you 20% is more then fair!	</hunting>
2706.translation_tr: <hunting>	Tamam, ne oldurursen 20-80 bolusuruz... ne...? Sana %20 vermek fazlasiyla adil!	</hunting>

2707.source_en: <hunting>	Since I'm hungry, why don't we go eat something... aren't you hungry?	</hunting>
2707.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ac olduguma gore neden gidip bir sey yemiyoruz... sen ac degil misin?	</hunting>

2708.source_en: <hunting>	Now, show me the results of your training!	</hunting>

2709.source_en: <hunting>	I'm fed up. What's the point if you're not going to kill it instantly, go make me food.	</hunting>
2709.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biktim. Onu aninda oldurmeyeceksen ne anlami var, git bana yemek yap.	</hunting>

2710.source_en: <hunting>	Lead the way sidekick... then after we beat these guys up, feed me.	</hunting>
2710.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yolu goster yardimci... bunlari dovdukten sonra beni besle.	</hunting>

2711.source_en: <hunting>	Yes! Good job!! Now let's go eat!!	</hunting>
2711.translation_tr: <hunting>	Evet! Iyi is!! Simdi yemek yiyelim!!	</hunting>

2712.source_en: <danger>	See! You have no strength from not eating!	</danger>
2712.translation_tr: <danger>	Gordun mu! Yemek yemedigin icin gucun yok!	</danger>

2713.source_en: <danger>	Aaaaack!! Can't you do anything right?!	</danger>
2713.translation_tr: <danger>	Aaaaack!! Hicbir seyi dogru yapamiyor musun?!	</danger>

2715.source_en: <danger>	You're looking weak already, what's wrong with you...	</danger>

2716.source_en: <danger>	Be Strong!! Be Strong and run away... and then lets go to eat!	</danger>
2716.translation_tr: <danger>	Guclu ol!! Guclu ol ve kac... sonra yemek yiyelim!	</danger>

2717.source_en: <danger>	You're strong enough to give me food, right?	</danger>
2717.translation_tr: <danger>	Bana yemek verecek kadar guclusun, degil mi?	</danger>

2718.source_en: <danger>	Hey you! I told you to be strong~	</danger>

2721.source_en: <dead>	Noooo..... The food you gave me was good.... Now I can't eat your food anymore?	</dead>
2721.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayiiir..... Verdigin yemek guzeldi.... Simdi artik yemegini yiyemeyecek miyim?	</dead>

2722.source_en: <dead>	How can this be... You fed me all this time... And now who's going to feed me?! No!! I hate this!!	</dead>
2722.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu nasil olur... Bunca zamandir beni besledin... Simdi beni kim besleyecek?! Hayir!! Bundan nefret ediyorum!!	</dead>

2723.source_en: <dead>	Get up!! There are things I still want to tell you!! Pl... Please...	</dead>
2723.translation_tr: <dead>	Kalk!! Sana hala soylemek istedigim seyler var!! Lu... Lutfen...	</dead>

2724.source_en: <dead>	No!! Get up!! I told you to get up! You have to make me food like yesterday!! Please...	</dead>
2724.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayir!! Kalk!! Kalk dedim! Dunki gibi bana yemek yapmalisin!! Lutfen...	</dead>

2727.source_en: <stand>	If you come and visit my home, you can experience the land of Payon. Sound nice?	</stand>
2727.translation_tr: <stand>	Evimi ziyaret edersen Payon topraklarini deneyimleyebilirsin. Guzel mi?	</stand>

2728.source_en: <stand>	To be strong and healthy, one must eat well!	</stand>
2728.translation_tr: <stand>	Guclu ve saglikli olmak icin iyi yemek gerekir!	</stand>

2730.source_en: <stand>	This is my command... feed me.	</stand>

2731.source_en: <stand>	Bring me food~ c'mon! What are you doing~ I said get me food!	</stand>
2731.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana yemek getir~ hadi! Ne yapiyorsun~ yemek getir dedim!	</stand>

2733.source_en: <connect>	You came just in time. Make me food.	</connect>
2733.translation_tr: <connect>	Tam zamaninda geldin. Bana yemek yap.	</connect>

2734.source_en: <connect>	Why did you come so late? For that, you have to make me food...	</connect>
2734.translation_tr: <connect>	Neden bu kadar gec geldin? Bunun icin bana yemek yapmalisin...	</connect>

2736.source_en: <connect>	You came at the perfect time! I was starving!	</connect>

2737.source_en: <connect>	Is your business outside of here more important than me? *tsk*... I'll forgive you if you feed me, this time.	</connect>
2737.translation_tr: <connect>	Disaridaki isin benden daha mi onemli? *cik*... Bu sefer beni beslersen affederim.	</connect>

2738.source_en: <levelup>	Foo food foo food~ foo~ food~ f~ foo foo~ food~... hey!! I'm telling you to give me food!	</levelup>
2738.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ye yemek ye yemek~ ye~ yemek~ y~ ye ye~ yemek~... hey!! Bana yemek ver diyorum!	</levelup>

2740.source_en: <levelup>	Foo foo foo food~ foo~ food~ foo foo foo~ food~... Do you understand what I'm saying?	</levelup>
2740.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ye ye ye yemek~ ye~ yemek~ ye ye ye~ yemek~... Ne dedigimi anliyor musun?	</levelup>

2741.source_en: <perfor_1>	W...what is this?... Whenever I see this picture I get tears in my eyes...	</perfor_1>
2741.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	B... bu ne?... Bu resmi her gordugumde gozlerim doluyor...	</perfor_1>

2748.source_en: <perfor_3>	Ho ho~ What a dull day, why can't we do something?	</perfor_3>
2748.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Ho ho~ Ne sikici bir gun, neden bir sey yapmiyoruz?	</perfor_3>

2749.source_en: <perfor_3>	*I am so bored~ What is there to do?	</perfor_3>

2750.source_en: <perfor_s>	... show off? What am I a dog?	</perfor_s>
2750.translation_tr: <perfor_s>	... hava atmak mi? Ben kopek miyim?	</perfor_s>

2751.source_en: <perfor_s>	Oh... A button fell off... can you fix it?	</perfor_s>
2751.translation_tr: <perfor_s>	Ah... Bir dugme dustu... tamir edebilir misin?	</perfor_s>

2757.source_en: <feeding>	Wah~ I'm done eating. Hm, what're you doing? Clean this up.	</feeding>
2757.translation_tr: <feeding>	Wah~ Yemegim bitti. Hm, ne yapiyorsun? Burayi temizle.	</feeding>

2758.source_en: <feeding>	*Chew Chew* Hmm.... this food is edible...*chomp*chomp*...	</feeding>

2759.source_en: <feeding>	It doesn't look good but I'll eat some anyway...	</feeding>
2759.translation_tr: <feeding>	Iyi gorunmuyor ama yine de biraz yiyecegim...	</feeding>

2760.source_en: <feeding>	I'm reminded of this really good orange juice I used to have at home... It was so good...	</feeding>
2760.translation_tr: <feeding>	Evde ictigim cok guzel portakal suyunu hatirlatti... Cok guzeldi...	</feeding>

2761.source_en: <hunting>	When are you going to level up?	</hunting>

2762.source_en: <hunting>	I'm bored~ Will you play with me?	</hunting>

2764.source_en: <hunting>	Play with me, Play with me, Play with me, Play with me~ *cry* I said to play with me~~	</hunting>
2764.translation_tr: <hunting>	Benimle oyna, benimle oyna, benimle oyna, benimle oyna~ *aglar* Benimle oyna dedim~~	</hunting>

2766.source_en: <hunting>	Can you stop fighting for a moment? I want to just sit down and think about Munak~	</hunting>
2766.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bir an savasmayi birakabilir misin? Oturup Munak'i dusunmek istiyorum~	</hunting>

2767.source_en: <hunting>	Aren't you tired of fighting that ugly monster? Let's go play with wonderful me, instead!	</hunting>
2767.translation_tr: <hunting>	O cirkin canavarla savasmaktan yorulmadin mi? Onun yerine harika benimle oyna!	</hunting>

2769.source_en: <hunting>	Tsk... That's the only thing you know how to do~	</hunting>

2770.source_en: <danger>	Pay attention!! No! Not like that!!!	</danger>

2771.source_en: <danger>	What are you doing!? Do it right! Protect me!!	</danger>
2771.translation_tr: <danger>	Ne yapiyorsun!? Dogru yap! Beni koru!!	</danger>

2772.source_en: <danger>	Put it in a little more effort!!	</danger>

2773.source_en: <danger>	That isn't how you fight! Put more effort into it!!	</danger>
2773.translation_tr: <danger>	Boyle savasilmaz! Daha cok caba goster!!	</danger>

2774.source_en: <danger>	Ack! That's not it! Do it more boldly!!	</danger>
2774.translation_tr: <danger>	Ack! Oyle degil! Daha cesur yap!!	</danger>

2775.source_en: <danger>	That's the only thing you know how to do and you want to what?!...	</danger>
2775.translation_tr: <danger>	Bildigin tek sey bu, bir de ne yapmak istiyorsun?!...	</danger>

2776.source_en: <danger>	Watch out for him!! Finish him!!	</danger>

2777.source_en: <dead>	Lies!! Why... Why is this...?... Hurry, get up and give me food!!!...	</dead>
2777.translation_tr: <dead>	Yalan!! Neden... Bu neden boyle...?... Cabuk kalk ve bana yemek ver!!!...	</dead>

2778.source_en: <dead>	Why.... Why is your body cold?!... Why... Why?!?!	</dead>
2778.translation_tr: <dead>	Neden.... Bedenin neden soguk?!... Neden... Neden?!?!	</dead>

2780.source_en: <dead>	Bleh... I told you to be careful...	</dead>

2781.source_en: <dead>	Nooooooo!... Who's gonna feed me now?!...	</dead>

2782.source_en: <dead>	Huh. Finally found something we have in common. 'Course, I'm dead and can still do stuff... Still with me? Hey...	</dead>
2782.translation_tr: <dead>	Ha. Sonunda ortak bir sey bulduk. Tabii ben oluyum ve hala bir seyler yapabiliyorum... Benimle misin? Hey...	</dead>

2784.source_en: <dead>	Get up! I said to get up!! Can't you hear my voice?! I said to get up!!!	</dead>
2784.translation_tr: <dead>	Kalk! Kalk dedim!! Sesimi duymuyor musun?! Kalk dedim!!!	</dead>

2785.source_en: <stand>	Did you know? All the pine trees in Payon belong to my family. Cool huh? Eh, it's nothing, really. hehe.	</stand>
2785.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor muydun? Payon'daki tum cam agaclari aileme ait. Havali, degil mi? Eh, aslinda onemli degil. hehe.	</stand>

2786.source_en: <stand>	My dream is to be as famous as Balder someday...	</stand>
2786.translation_tr: <stand>	Hayalim bir gun Balder kadar unlu olmak...	</stand>

2787.source_en: <stand>	You're taking too many breaks... You're going to end up looking like a Savage.	</stand>
2787.translation_tr: <stand>	Cok fazla mola veriyorsun... Sonunda Savage gibi goruneceksin.	</stand>

2788.source_en: <stand>	All you ever do is sit around... Can't we go do something fun... Like shopping for me?	</stand>
2788.translation_tr: <stand>	Tek yaptigin oturmak... Eglenceli bir sey yapamaz miyiz... Mesela bana alisveris?	</stand>

2789.source_en: <stand>	...If I find Munak... I'm never going to part with her ever again...	</stand>
2789.translation_tr: <stand>	...Munak'i bulursam... ondan bir daha asla ayrilmayacagim...	</stand>

2790.source_en: <stand>	What're you looking at... Hurry and get to work... I found something I want to buy.	</stand>
2790.translation_tr: <stand>	Neye bakiyorsun... Acele et ve ise koyul... Almak istedigim bir sey buldum.	</stand>

2791.source_en: <stand>	Ah~~ buy me that... You know what I'm talking about~ That~~	</stand>
2791.translation_tr: <stand>	Ah~~ bana onu al... Neyden bahsettigimi biliyorsun~ Sunu~~	</stand>

2792.source_en: <stand>	Buy it for me~ Buy it~ The thing I told you about~!	</stand>
2792.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana al~ Al onu~ Sana soyledigim seyi~!	</stand>

2793.source_en: <stand>	What?! You can't even buy me that and you expect me to play with you?	</stand>
2793.translation_tr: <stand>	Ne?! Bunu bile alamiyorsun ve benim seninle oynamami mi bekliyorsun?	</stand>

2794.source_en: <stand>	*tsk*, Never mind! Its my fault for getting my hopes up...	</stand>
2794.translation_tr: <stand>	*cik*, Bos ver! Umutlandigim icin benim hatam...	</stand>
