2795.source_en: <stand>	Why did you stop?... Lets hurry and go see stuff~	</stand>
2795.translation_tr: <stand>	Neden durdun?... Acele edip bir seyler gorelim~	</stand>

2797.source_en: <connect>	Ah, You're here? I was gathering some coupons.	</connect>
2797.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah, geldin mi? Biraz kupon topluyordum.	</connect>

2798.source_en: <connect>	I was organizing the fan letters I've been getting while you were gone.	</connect>
2798.translation_tr: <connect>	Sen yokken gelen hayran mektuplarini duzenliyordum.	</connect>

2799.source_en: <levelup>	Took you long enough... I've seen novices the same level as you...	</levelup>
2799.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yeterince uzun surdu... Seninle ayni levelde noviceler gordum...	</levelup>

2800.source_en: <levelup>	Hm... You're still far off... Don't be too happy.	</levelup>
2800.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hm... Hala cok uzaktasin... Fazla sevinme.	</levelup>

2801.source_en: <levelup>	Hmph.. You want a congratulations from me? Do you? Do you?...	</levelup>
2801.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hmph.. Benden tebrik mi istiyorsun? Istiyor musun? Ha?...	</levelup>

2802.source_en: <levelup>	Oh ho~ I'll give you my special congratulations. I congratulate your effort!... How about was that?	</levelup>
2802.translation_tr: <levelup>	Oh ho~ Sana ozel tebrigimi vereyim. Cabani tebrik ederim!... Nasil, iyi miydi?	</levelup>

2803.source_en: <levelup>	You're getting stronger... I can feel it.	</levelup>

2804.source_en: <perfor_1>	W...What is this?... Whenever I see this picture I get tears in my eyes...	</perfor_1>
2804.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	B...Bu da ne?... Bu resmi ne zaman gorsem gozlerim doluyor...	</perfor_1>

2811.source_en: <perfor_3>	Oh Ho~ What a dull day.	</perfor_3>
2811.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Oh Ho~ Ne sikici bir gun.	</perfor_3>

2812.source_en: <perfor_3>	I am so bored~ What is there to do?	</perfor_3>

2818.source_en: <feeding>	It is good to control your appetite.	</feeding>

2819.source_en: <feeding>	Hm...It would have been nice to have eaten a little bit later.	</feeding>
2819.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hm... Biraz daha sonra yeseydim daha iyi olurdu.	</feeding>

2820.source_en: <feeding>	Am I some sort of eating machine? Tsk... If this was worth eating maybe...	</feeding>
2820.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ben bir yeme makinesi miyim? Cik... Belki yemeye deger olsaydi...	</feeding>

2821.source_en: <feeding>	Ack- It tastes so bad. What is this? Give me something better to eat.	</feeding>
2821.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ack- Tadi cok kotu. Bu ne? Bana daha iyi bir sey ver.	</feeding>

2822.source_en: <feeding>	Wah~ I'm tired of pet food. Let's eat something better!	</feeding>
2822.translation_tr: <feeding>	Wah~ Pet yemeginden biktim. Daha iyi bir sey yiyelim!	</feeding>

2823.source_en: <hunting>	Be strong! You can do it!	</hunting>

2824.source_en: <hunting>	You're having fun.... Tsk, and you won't play with me...	</hunting>
2824.translation_tr: <hunting>	Eglendigin belli... Cik, benimle de oynamiyorsun...	</hunting>

2825.source_en: <hunting>	What? Why are you only hitting him? Am I not of any interest?	</hunting>
2825.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ne? Neden sadece ona vuruyorsun? Ben ilgini cekmiyor muyum?	</hunting>

2826.source_en: <hunting>	Oh ho~ You're saying you have no interest in me? Hmph- Don't think I'm gonna be sad about it.	</hunting>
2826.translation_tr: <hunting>	Oh ho~ Benimle ilgilenmedigini mi soyluyorsun? Hmph- Buna uzulecegimi sanma.	</hunting>

2828.source_en: <danger>	Hey! What're you doing... Pay attention! Attention!!!	</danger>
2828.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey! Ne yapiyorsun... Dikkat et! DIKKAT!!!	</danger>

2829.source_en: <danger>	Hmm... In any form, training is hard work. There there, lets fight!	</danger>
2829.translation_tr: <danger>	Hmm... Her turlu egitim zor istir. Hadi, savasalim!	</danger>

2830.source_en: <danger>	Open your eyes!! What're you doing?! You have to live so you can be teased by me some more!!	</danger>
2830.translation_tr: <danger>	Gozlerini ac!! Ne yapiyorsun?! Yasamalisin ki seni biraz daha kizdirabileyim!!	</danger>

2831.source_en: <danger>	You dork!!! Why are you fighting like that for?!	</danger>

2832.source_en: <danger>	It's dangerous!! Dangerous I say! Dork!! Why don't you listen to me?!~	</danger>
2832.translation_tr: <danger>	Tehlikeli!! Tehlikeli diyorum! Aptal!! Neden beni dinlemiyorsun?!~	</danger>

2834.source_en: <dead>	Get up!! Get up!! I said get up!!	</dead>

2835.source_en: <dead>	That was an awesome fight.. Try better next time.	</dead>
2835.translation_tr: <dead>	Harika bir savasti.. Bir dahaki sefere daha iyisini dene.	</dead>

2836.source_en: <dead>	Liar... It can't be like this... Not like this!!!	</dead>

2837.source_en: <dead>	Nooooooo!!! You still haven't written me into your last will and testament!	</dead>

2838.source_en: <stand>	What're you looking at? Tsk... so ugly...	</stand>

2839.source_en: <stand>	Stop standing there, Move around. Do you think you're going to lose weight like that? Hehe	</stand>
2839.translation_tr: <stand>	Orada dikilmeyi birak, hareket et. Boyle kilo verecegini mi saniyorsun? Hehe	</stand>

2841.source_en: <stand>	Sometimes I feel thankful that you're here by my side...	</stand>
2841.translation_tr: <stand>	Bazen yanimda oldugun icin minnettar hissediyorum...	</stand>

2842.source_en: <stand>	Nya~Nya~ Hehehe. Are you getting annoyed yet?~	</stand>
2842.translation_tr: <stand>	Nya~Nya~ Hehehe. Sinir olmaya basladin mi?~	</stand>

2844.source_en: <stand>	Hey ugly, what're you looking at?... Let's go.	</stand>
2844.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey cirkin, neye bakiyorsun?... Hadi gidelim.	</stand>

2845.source_en: <connect>	Huh? What did you come for?~	</connect>

2846.source_en: <connect>	Why do you bother coming? Hmph, you think I'm lonely without you?~	</connect>
2846.translation_tr: <connect>	Neden zahmet edip geldin? Hmph, sensiz yalniz kaldigimi mi saniyorsun?~	</connect>

2849.source_en: <connect>	What? You missed me that much? Ho ho~	</connect>
2849.translation_tr: <connect>	Ne? Beni o kadar mi ozledin? Ho ho~	</connect>

2850.source_en: <connect>	I knew you missed me. Well, I do have a face you can't forget~	</connect>
2850.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni ozledigini biliyordum. Unutamayacagin bir yuzum var zaten~	</connect>

2852.source_en: <levelup>	What? I'll tell you beforehand that I am much stronger than you. Don't let this one level up get to your head.	</levelup>
2852.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ne? Bastan soyleyeyim, senden cok daha gucluyum. Bu tek level kafana cikmasin.	</levelup>

2853.source_en: <levelup>	*tsk*tsk*... What... You did well... You did well! Yeah, yeah, good for you!	</levelup>
2853.translation_tr: <levelup>	*cik* *cik*... Ne... Iyi yaptin... Iyi yaptin! Evet evet, aferin sana!	</levelup>

2855.source_en: <levelup>	Hmph... Don't be so happy over this one level...	</levelup>
2855.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hmph... Bu tek level icin bu kadar sevinme...	</levelup>

2856.source_en: <perfor_1>	W...What is this?... Whenever I see this picture I get tears in my eyes...	</perfor_1>
2856.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	B...Bu da ne?... Bu resmi ne zaman gorsem gozlerim doluyor...	</perfor_1>

2863.source_en: <perfor_3>	Oh Ho~ What a dull day.	</perfor_3>
2863.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Oh Ho~ Ne sikici bir gun.	</perfor_3>

2864.source_en: <perfor_3>	I am so bored~ What is there to do?	</perfor_3>

2871.source_en: <feeding>	Ack! How much do you intend on feeding me?!	</feeding>
2871.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ack! Beni ne kadar beslemeyi dusunuyorsun?!	</feeding>

2872.source_en: <feeding>	Alright, that's enough... You're trying to get me killed again?!	</feeding>
2872.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tamam, yeter... Yine beni oldurmeye mi calisiyorsun?!	</feeding>

2873.source_en: <hunting>	That's enough. Since I'm full... Let's go nap.	</hunting>

2875.source_en: <hunting>	You're putting in a lot of effort... Do you think you'll look better from doing it? *flop*	</hunting>
2875.translation_tr: <hunting>	Cok caba harciyorsun... Bununla daha iyi gorunecegini mi saniyorsun? *pat*	</hunting>

2876.source_en: <hunting>	Stop doing that and lets go play. You're my pet~~	</hunting>
2876.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sununla ugrasmayi birak da oynayalim. Sen benim petimsin~~	</hunting>

2877.source_en: <danger>	Stop it! Its too dangerous! Do you want to die again?!	</danger>
2877.translation_tr: <danger>	Birak! Cok tehlikeli! Yine olmek mi istiyorsun?!	</danger>

2880.source_en: <danger>	This is weird!! This is familiar... I don't like this feeling!!!	</danger>
2880.translation_tr: <danger>	Bu garip!! Bu tanidik... Bu hissi sevmiyorum!!!	</danger>

2881.source_en: <danger>	No!! Stop sacrificing yourself for me! Don't leave me!	</danger>
2881.translation_tr: <danger>	Hayir!! Benim icin kendini feda etmeyi birak! Beni birakma!	</danger>

2882.source_en: <dead>	No!!... This can't this be... Are you leaving me again? Is that what is it!?	</dead>
2882.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayir!!... Bu olamaz... Yine beni mi birakiyorsun? Oyle mi!?	</dead>

2883.source_en: <dead>	Bah... You need to learn to take care of yourself. How can you leave me like this?...	</dead>
2883.translation_tr: <dead>	Bah... Kendine bakmayi ogrenmelisin. Beni nasil boyle birakirsin?...	</dead>

2884.source_en: <dead>	No!! How can this be... I wasn't able to protect you...	</dead>
2884.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayir!! Bu nasil olur... Seni koruyamadim...	</dead>

2885.source_en: <dead>	Get up!! I said get up!! Please... Please open your eyes!	</dead>
2885.translation_tr: <dead>	Kalk!! Kalk dedim!! Lutfen... Gozlerini ac!	</dead>

2886.source_en: <dead>	Ah... No!!... I can't let you go again! And to think I just found you again...	</dead>
2886.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah... Hayir!!... Seni yine birakamam! Daha yeni tekrar bulmustum...	</dead>

2887.source_en: <dead>	Ah... How can this be?... I wasn't able to tell you how I feel...	</dead>
2887.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah... Bu nasil olur?... Sana nasil hissettigimi soyleyemedim...	</dead>

2888.source_en: <stand>	Hmm~ There is a nice breeze today~	</stand>
2888.translation_tr: <stand>	Hmm~ Bugun guzel bir esinti var~	</stand>

2889.source_en: <stand>	Yeah... It was just like this... The day I made a promise with that girl...	</stand>
2889.translation_tr: <stand>	Evet... Aynen boyleydi... O kizla sozlestigim gun...	</stand>

2891.source_en: <stand>	You know... The truth is... I......	</stand>
2891.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor musun... Gercek su ki... Ben......	</stand>

2892.source_en: <stand>	You know... That is... Anyway.... Errr...	</stand>

2893.source_en: <stand>	Anyway... The truth is... I..... uh....	</stand>
2893.translation_tr: <stand>	Neyse... Gercek su ki... Ben..... ee....	</stand>

2894.source_en: <stand>	When we are doing nothing like this... I am reminded of Munak...*sigh*...	</stand>
2894.translation_tr: <stand>	Boyle hicbir sey yapmadan durunca... Munak aklima geliyor... *ic ceker*...	</stand>

2895.source_en: <stand>	I........ I.... l...i...k...e...... like the sky... hehehe.....	</stand>
2895.translation_tr: <stand>	Ben........ Ben.... s...e...v...i...y...o...r...um...... gokyuzunu seviyorum... hehehe.....	</stand>

2896.source_en: <stand>	I........ Ah, never mind. By the way, you look like you're gaining weight.	</stand>
2896.translation_tr: <stand>	Ben........ Ah, bos ver. Bu arada kilo aliyor gibisin.	</stand>

2897.source_en: <stand>	Wonderful........... Hmm? What are you thinking about?! Not you, the sky!	</stand>
2897.translation_tr: <stand>	Harika........... Hmm? Ne dusunuyorsun?! Sen degil, gokyuzu!	</stand>

2898.source_en: <stand>	*fart*... Hmm?... What... Why are you laughing? Don't you fart?	</stand>
2898.translation_tr: <stand>	*osurur*... Hmm?... Ne... Neden guluyorsun? Sen osurmuyor musun?	</stand>

2899.source_en: <stand>	*Gulp Gulp* Ah~ That felt good. Hehehe... Want to try some?	</stand>
2899.translation_tr: <stand>	*Gluk gluk* Ah~ Iyi geldi. Hehehe... Biraz ister misin?	</stand>

2901.source_en: <connect>	I was thinking about you, this is good... Hmm? I said I was thinking about the food you give me.	</connect>
2901.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni dusunuyordum, bu guzel... Hmm? Bana verdigin yemegi dusunuyordum dedim.	</connect>

2904.source_en: <connect>	Ho ho ho ho ho... You know... Today...	</connect>
2904.translation_tr: <connect>	Ho ho ho ho ho... Biliyor musun... Bugun...	</connect>

2905.source_en: <connect>	I missed you!... Hmm, don't misunderstand! Not you... Something else... Er, You don't need to know!	</connect>
2905.translation_tr: <connect>	Seni ozledim!... Hmm, yanlis anlama! Seni degil... Baska bir seyi... Ee, bilmene gerek yok!	</connect>

2906.source_en: <levelup>	!! You finally leveled!~ Wah~ Congrats! That's so good!... Ack... Hmm... That is... My... condition is good!!	</levelup>
2906.translation_tr: <levelup>	!! Sonunda level atladin!~ Wah~ Tebrikler! Cok guzel!... Ack... Hmm... Yani... Benim... durumum iyi!!	</levelup>

2907.source_en: <levelup>	I think I'm happy to see you become stronger~	</levelup>
2907.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guclendigini gordugum icin mutlu oldugumu sanirim~	</levelup>

2908.source_en: <levelup>	Hmm!! Wah!! Finally... Ack... Eh... Something is very... hmm...	</levelup>
2908.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hmm!! Wah!! Sonunda... Ack... Eh... Bir sey cok... hmm...	</levelup>

2910.source_en: <perfor_1>	W...What is this?... Whenever I see this picture I get tears in my eyes...	</perfor_1>
2910.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	B...Bu da ne?... Bu resmi ne zaman gorsem gozlerim doluyor...	</perfor_1>

2917.source_en: <perfor_3>	Oh Ho~ What a dull day.	</perfor_3>
2917.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Oh Ho~ Ne sikici bir gun.	</perfor_3>

2918.source_en: <perfor_3>	I am so bored~ What is there to do?	</perfor_3>

2926.source_en: <feeding>	Master, I am too exhausted to sweep the floor.	</feeding>
2926.translation_tr: <feeding>	Efendim, yeri supurmek icin cok yorgunum.	</feeding>

2927.source_en: <feeding>	Master, it is the time for dinner. Would you like me to cook?	</feeding>
2927.translation_tr: <feeding>	Efendim, aksam yemegi zamani. Yemek yapmami ister misiniz?	</feeding>

2930.source_en: <hunting>	Are you sure you can defeat the enemy?	</hunting>

2931.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you will take care of yourself.	</hunting>

2932.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you will take care of me rather than focusing on hunting.	</hunting>
2932.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim avlanmaya odaklanmak yerine benimle ilgilenirsiniz.	</hunting>

2933.source_en: <danger>	I suggest that you be careful.	</danger>

2934.source_en: <danger>	Doesn't seeing your HP displayed in red make you nervous?	</danger>
2934.translation_tr: <danger>	HP'nizin kirmizi gorunmesi sizi tedirgin etmiyor mu?	</danger>

2935.source_en: <danger>	I always want to believe that you are the strongest adventurer in the world.	</danger>
2935.translation_tr: <danger>	Her zaman dunyanin en guclu maceracisi oldugunuza inanmak istiyorum.	</danger>

2936.source_en: <dead>	Sorry, I have nothing to say.	</dead>

2938.source_en: <dead>	Master, it is not good to lie on cold ground.	</dead>
2938.translation_tr: <dead>	Efendim, soguk zeminde yatmak iyi degildir.	</dead>

2939.source_en: <dead>	Your vision is growing dim? Does that mean you are hungry?	</dead>
2939.translation_tr: <dead>	Gorusunuz mu karariyor? Bu ac oldugunuz anlamina mi geliyor?	</dead>

2940.source_en: <stand>	Excuse me, master! Will you please step aside from there? I cannot sweep the floor!	</stand>
2940.translation_tr: <stand>	Affedersiniz efendim! Lutfen oradan cekilir misiniz? Yeri supuremiyorum!	</stand>

2941.source_en: <stand>	Well, I can tell you are incompetent, considering the way you treat your pet.	</stand>
2941.translation_tr: <stand>	Petine davranisina bakilirsa beceriksiz oldugun belli.	</stand>

2942.source_en: <stand>	If you do not know how to take care of a pet, how can take care of your wife?	</stand>
2942.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir pete bakmayi bilmiyorsan esine nasil bakacaksin?	</stand>

2945.source_en: <stand>	I do not understand why you stand still. Alice wants to exercise!	</stand>
2945.translation_tr: <stand>	Neden hareketsiz durdugunuzu anlamiyorum. Alice egzersiz yapmak istiyor!	</stand>

2946.source_en: <connect>	I almost had dinner alone because you did not come home earlier.	</connect>
2946.translation_tr: <connect>	Daha erken eve gelmediginiz icin neredeyse yemegi tek basima yiyecektim.	</connect>

2947.source_en: <connect>	It seems... You are always later than I expect.	</connect>
2947.translation_tr: <connect>	Gorunuse gore... Hep bekledigimden gec geliyorsun.	</connect>

2948.source_en: <connect>	Do you not care about me, or do you trust me that much?	</connect>
2948.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni umursamiyor musunuz, yoksa bana bu kadar cok mu guveniyorsunuz?	</connect>

2949.source_en: <connect>	If you neglect me like this, you may have to let me go someday.	</connect>
2949.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni boyle ihmal ederseniz bir gun beni birakmak zorunda kalabilirsiniz.	</connect>

2951.source_en: <levelup>	Oh well, the circle of life continues.	</levelup>

2952.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry. Let me clean this mess really quick.	</perfor_1>
2952.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim. Bu daginikligi hemen temizleyeyim.	</perfor_1>

2953.source_en: <perfor_1>	Thank you for trusting me, even if I am careless sometimes.	</perfor_1>
2953.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Bazen dikkatsiz olsam da bana guvendiginiz icin tesekkur ederim.	</perfor_1>

2954.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry!	</perfor_1>
2954.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim!	</perfor_1>

2955.source_en: <perfor_2>	A respectable maid must be pure in body and mind.	</perfor_2>
2955.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Saygin bir hizmetci bedenen ve ruhen temiz olmalidir.	</perfor_2>

2956.source_en: <perfor_2>	Let's say I'm covered in dark dust. Would that make me Cinderella?	</perfor_2>
2956.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Diyelim ki kara toza bulandim. Bu beni Kulkedisi yapar mi?	</perfor_2>

2957.source_en: <perfor_2>	Alice must shake the dust off her body often. Otherwise, she will look dirty.	</perfor_2>
2957.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Alice vucudundaki tozu sik sik silkelemeli. Yoksa kirli gorunur.	</perfor_2>

2959.source_en: <perfor_3>	Do you think the house looks better now? Can I take a break?	</perfor_3>
2959.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Sence ev simdi daha iyi gorunuyor mu? Biraz ara verebilir miyim?	</perfor_3>

2960.source_en: <perfor_3>	I love my job, but sometimes it is very tiresome. *Sigh...*	</perfor_3>
2960.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Isimi seviyorum ama bazen cok yorucu oluyor. *Ic ceker...*	</perfor_3>

2966.source_en: <feeding>	Master, I am too exhausted to sweep the floor.	</feeding>
2966.translation_tr: <feeding>	Efendim, yeri supurmek icin cok yorgunum.	</feeding>

2967.source_en: <feeding>	Master, it is the time for dinner. Would you like me to cook?	</feeding>
2967.translation_tr: <feeding>	Efendim, aksam yemegi zamani. Yemek yapmami ister misiniz?	</feeding>

2968.source_en: <feeding>	May I have some more please?	</feeding>

2970.source_en: <feeding>	You must mind your table manners when eating.	</feeding>
2970.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yemek yerken sofra adabina dikkat etmelisin.	</feeding>

2972.source_en: <feeding>	It was good, thank you master!	</feeding>

2973.source_en: <feeding>	*Gulp gulp*...Are you thinking that Alice wastes your money by eating expensive potions?	</feeding>
2973.translation_tr: <feeding>	*Gluk gluk*... Alice pahali iksirler icerek paranizi bosa harciyor diye mi dusunuyorsunuz?	</feeding>

2974.source_en: <hunting>	Are you sure you can defeat this enemy?	</hunting>

2975.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you will take care of yourself.	</hunting>

2976.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you will take care of me rather than focusing on hunting.	</hunting>
2976.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim avlanmaya odaklanmak yerine benimle ilgilenirsiniz.	</hunting>

2977.source_en: <hunting>	Hunting, hunting, hunting! You do the same thing everyday!	</hunting>
2977.translation_tr: <hunting>	Av, av, av! Her gun ayni seyi yapiyorsun!	</hunting>

2978.source_en: <hunting>	Sometimes, you need to take a seat and rest.	</hunting>

2979.translation_tr: <hunting>	Kirmizi olan hicbir sey kabul edilemez!	</hunting>

2981.source_en: <danger>	Doesn't seeing your HP displayed in red make you nervous?	</danger>
2981.translation_tr: <danger>	HP'nizin kirmizi gorunmesi sizi tedirgin etmiyor mu?	</danger>

2982.source_en: <danger>	I always want to believe that you are the strongest adventurer in the world.	</danger>
2982.translation_tr: <danger>	Her zaman dunyanin en guclu maceracisi oldugunuza inanmak istiyorum.	</danger>

2983.source_en: <danger>	It feels like the ground is coming towards me...	</danger>

2984.source_en: <danger>	How about...going back and having dinner first?	</danger>
2984.translation_tr: <danger>	Once geri donup yemek yesek nasil olur?	</danger>

2985.source_en: <danger>	Promise me you will leave my food before you go!	</danger>
2985.translation_tr: <danger>	Gitmeden once yemegimi birakacagina soz ver!	</danger>

2986.source_en: <danger>	I think heaven is closer now, isn't it?	</danger>
2986.translation_tr: <danger>	Sanirim cennet artik daha yakin, degil mi?	</danger>

2987.source_en: <dead>	I'm sorry, I have nothing to say.	</dead>

2989.source_en: <dead>	Master, it is not good to lie on cold ground.	</dead>
2989.translation_tr: <dead>	Efendim, soguk zeminde yatmak iyi degildir.	</dead>

2990.source_en: <dead>	Your vision is growing dim? Does that mean you are hungry?	</dead>
2990.translation_tr: <dead>	Gorusunuz mu karariyor? Bu ac oldugunuz anlamina mi geliyor?	</dead>

2991.source_en: <dead>	No way! You're not waiting for someone to rescue you, are you?	</dead>
2991.translation_tr: <dead>	Olmaz! Birinin seni kurtarmasini beklemiyorsun, degil mi?	</dead>

2992.source_en: <dead>	You pervert! Get up! What exactly are you looking at?!	</dead>
2992.translation_tr: <dead>	Seni sapik! Kalk! Tam olarak neye bakiyorsun?!	</dead>

2993.source_en: <stand>	Excuse me, master! Will you please step aside from there? I cannot sweep the floor!	</stand>
2993.translation_tr: <stand>	Affedersiniz efendim! Lutfen oradan cekilir misiniz? Yeri supuremiyorum!	</stand>

2994.source_en: <stand>	Oh well, I can tell you are incompetent, considering the way you treat your pet.	</stand>
2994.translation_tr: <stand>	Neyse, petine davranisina bakilirsa beceriksiz oldugun belli.	</stand>

2995.source_en: <stand>	If you do not know how to take care of a pet, how can you take care of your wife?	</stand>
2995.translation_tr: <stand>	Bir pete bakmayi bilmiyorsan esine nasil bakacaksin?	</stand>

2998.source_en: <stand>	I do not understand why you stand still. Alice wants to exercise!	</stand>
2998.translation_tr: <stand>	Neden hareketsiz durdugunuzu anlamiyorum. Alice egzersiz yapmak istiyor!	</stand>

2999.source_en: <stand>	The early bird catches the worm!	</stand>

3000.source_en: <connect>	I almost had dinner alone because you did not come home earlier.	</connect>
3000.translation_tr: <connect>	Daha erken eve gelmediginiz icin neredeyse yemegi tek basima yiyecektim.	</connect>

3001.source_en: <connect>	It seems...you are always later than I expect.	</connect>
3001.translation_tr: <connect>	Gorunuse gore... hep bekledigimden gec geliyorsun.	</connect>

3002.source_en: <connect>	Do you not care about me, or do you trust me that much?	</connect>
3002.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni umursamiyor musunuz, yoksa bana bu kadar cok mu guveniyorsunuz?	</connect>

3003.source_en: <connect>	If you neglect me like this, you may have to let me go someday.	</connect>
3003.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni boyle ihmal ederseniz bir gun beni birakmak zorunda kalabilirsiniz.	</connect>

3004.source_en: <connect>	Where have you been? Are you cheating me with another pet? Are you? Tell me the truth!	</connect>
3004.translation_tr: <connect>	Neredeydin? Beni baska bir petle mi aldatiyorsun? Oyle mi? Dogruyu soyle!	</connect>

3005.source_en: <levelup>	Congratulations... But now I am hungry.		</levelup>

3006.source_en: <levelup>	Is there anything I can drink now? I wish I could have a cool potion. Ah, it would feel so good!	</levelup>
3006.translation_tr: <levelup>	Simdi icebilecegim bir sey var mi? Soguk bir potion olsa keske. Ah, cok iyi gelirdi!	</levelup>

3007.source_en: <levelup>	I want to drink a White Potion to celebrate your levelup!	</levelup>
3007.translation_tr: <levelup>	Level atlamani kutlamak icin White Potion icmek istiyorum!	</levelup>

3008.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry. Let me clean this mess really quick.	</perfor_1>
3008.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim. Bu daginikligi hemen temizleyeyim.	</perfor_1>

3009.source_en: <perfor_1>	Thank you for trusting me even if I am careless sometimes.	</perfor_1>
3009.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Bazen dikkatsiz olsam da bana guvendiginiz icin tesekkur ederim.	</perfor_1>

3010.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry!	</perfor_1>
3010.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim!	</perfor_1>

3011.source_en: <perfor_2>	A respectable maid must be pure in body and mind.	</perfor_2>
3011.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Saygin bir hizmetci bedenen ve ruhen temiz olmalidir.	</perfor_2>

3012.source_en: <perfor_2>	Let's say I'm covered in dark dust. Would that make me Cinderella?	</perfor_2>
3012.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Diyelim ki kara toza bulandim. Bu beni Kulkedisi yapar mi?	</perfor_2>

3013.source_en: <perfor_2>	Alice must shake the dust off her body often. Otherwise, she will look dirty.	</perfor_2>
3013.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Alice vucudundaki tozu sik sik silkelemeli. Yoksa kirli gorunur.	</perfor_2>

3015.source_en: <perfor_3>	Do you think the house looks better now? Can I take a break?	</perfor_3>
3015.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Sence ev simdi daha iyi gorunuyor mu? Biraz ara verebilir miyim?	</perfor_3>

3016.source_en: <perfor_3>	I love my job, but sometimes it is very tiresome. *Sigh...*	</perfor_3>
3016.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Isimi seviyorum ama bazen cok yorucu oluyor. *Ic ceker...*	</perfor_3>

3022.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you very much for the food.	</feeding>

3023.source_en: <feeding>	I am trying to enjoy my meal.	</feeding>

3024.source_en: <feeding>	*Gulp gulp*...Are you thinking that Alice wastes your money by eating expensive potions?	</feeding>
3024.translation_tr: <feeding>	*Gluk gluk*... Alice pahali iksirler icerek paranizi bosa harciyor diye mi dusunuyorsunuz?	</feeding>

3027.source_en: <feeding>	Frankly, Alice is not that picky for what she eats!	</feeding>
3027.translation_tr: <feeding>	Acikcasi Alice yemek konusunda o kadar secici degil!	</feeding>

3029.source_en: <hunting>	I trust you enough to let you hunt alone.	</hunting>
3029.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana tek basina avlanmana izin verecek kadar guveniyorum.	</hunting>

3031.source_en: <hunting>	I wish you would slow down your hunting sometimes.	</hunting>

3032.source_en: <hunting>	Leveling up is not everything. Of course, money is not everything either! Don't you ever try to nitpick what I am staying!	</hunting>
3032.translation_tr: <hunting>	Level atlamak her sey degil. Tabii para da her sey degil! Soylediklerimde kusur aramaya kalkma!	</hunting>

3033.source_en: <hunting>	The most powerful range weapon for a female is a broom. Alice will use her broom when her master is in danger.	</hunting>
3033.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bir kadin icin en guclu menzilli silah supurgedir. Efendisi tehlikedeyken Alice supurgesini kullanir.	</hunting>

3034.source_en: <hunting>	I have seen many guests fall unconscious after one blow from Alice's broom.	</hunting>
3034.translation_tr: <hunting>	Alice'in supurgesinden tek darbe alip bayilan cok misafir gordum.	</hunting>

3035.source_en: <hunting>	I have never doubted you are my guardian, master.	</hunting>
3035.translation_tr: <hunting>	Koruyucum oldugunuzdan hic suphe etmedim efendim.	</hunting>

3036.source_en: <hunting>	Hunting is always joyful but don't fall alseep during the hunt!	</hunting>
3036.translation_tr: <hunting>	Avlanmak her zaman eglenceli ama av sirasinda uyuyakalma!	</hunting>

3037.source_en: <danger>	I know you can win, can you? Or...can't you?	</danger>
3037.translation_tr: <danger>	Kazanabilecegini biliyorum, degil mi? Yoksa... kazanamaz misin?	</danger>

3038.source_en: <danger>	You promised to protect me...why is your HP bar showing in red?	</danger>
3038.translation_tr: <danger>	Beni koruyacagina soz verdin... HP cubugun neden kirmizi?	</danger>

3039.source_en: <danger>	Alice is sad when her master is having a hard time.	</danger>

3040.source_en: <danger>	Well, I may cheer up with this white potion! *Gulp*	</danger>
3040.translation_tr: <danger>	Neyse, bu White Potion ile moralim duzelebilir! *Gluk*	</danger>

3041.source_en: <danger>	No no no no, you can't use the Berserk skill!	</danger>
3041.translation_tr: <danger>	Hayir hayir hayir, Berserk becerisini kullanamazsin!	</danger>

3042.source_en: <danger>	I suggest you exercise more. I can be your training coach!	</danger>
3042.translation_tr: <danger>	Daha fazla egzersiz yapmani oneririm. Antrenorun olabilirim!	</danger>

3043.source_en: <danger>	If you had a stout lower body, you would not have a hard time like this. You will sweep the floor with me from now on!	</danger>
3043.translation_tr: <danger>	Alt vucudun guclu olsaydi boyle zorlanmazdin. Artik benimle yeri supureceksin!	</danger>

3045.source_en: <dead>	Wah! You pervert! Get up, get up! What are you looking at!?	</dead>
3045.translation_tr: <dead>	Wah! Seni sapik! Kalk, kalk! Neye bakiyorsun!?	</dead>

3046.source_en: <dead>	I hope my master found peace in these final moments...	</dead>
3046.translation_tr: <dead>	Umarim efendim son anlarinda huzur bulmustur...	</dead>

3047.source_en: <dead>	As I remember, my late master was truly kind and gentle. *Sigh...* Let's not talk about it anymore...	</dead>
3047.translation_tr: <dead>	Hatirladigim kadariyla merhum efendim gercekten nazik ve yumusakti. *Ic ceker* Artik bundan bahsetmeyelim...	</dead>

3048.source_en: <dead>	Excuse me, master? Will you get up? I need to clean this area.	</dead>
3048.translation_tr: <dead>	Affedersiniz efendim? Kalkar misiniz? Bu alani temizlemem gerekiyor.	</dead>

3049.source_en: <dead>	If you do not get up soon, I will put you into the recycling bin.		</dead>
3049.translation_tr: <dead>	Yakinda kalkmazsan seni geri donusum kutusuna koyacagim.		</dead>

3050.source_en: <dead>	Okay, it is the time for emptying the trash can...wah!! What are you doing in there, master?	</dead>
3050.translation_tr: <dead>	Tamam, cop kutusunu bosaltma zamani... wah!! Orada ne yapiyorsunuz efendim?	</dead>

3051.source_en: <stand>	Alice used to lead a lonesome life in an ancient castle.	</stand>
3051.translation_tr: <stand>	Alice eski bir kalede yalniz bir hayat surerdi.	</stand>

3052.source_en: <stand>	I always cleaned everywhere in the castle.	</stand>

3053.source_en: <stand>	Being alone was really sad, but now I am not sad any longer. Because I am with you.	</stand>
3053.translation_tr: <stand>	Yalniz olmak gercekten uzucuydu ama artik uzulmuyorum. Cunku seninleyim.	</stand>

3054.source_en: <stand>	When you lay the broom on the side, it will not raise dust. I learned this when I was in the army....?! Wah! What was I saying!	</stand>
3054.translation_tr: <stand>	Supurgeyi yan yatirirsan toz kaldirmaz. Bunu ordudayken ogrendim....?! Wah! Ben ne diyordum!	</stand>

3055.source_en: <stand>	The Castle I used to live in was so huge that I had a hard time cleaning it in a day.	</stand>
3055.translation_tr: <stand>	Yasadigim kale o kadar buyuktu ki bir gunde temizlemekte zorlanirdim.	</stand>

3056.source_en: <stand>	Will you promise to love me more if I clean harder?	</stand>
3056.translation_tr: <stand>	Daha cok temizlersem beni daha cok sevecegine soz verir misin?	</stand>

3057.source_en: <stand>	The Rune-Midgarts Kingdom seems so peaceful~	</stand>

3058.source_en: <stand>	You are supposed to take a 10 minute break after 50 minutes of playing!	</stand>
3058.translation_tr: <stand>	50 dakika oynadiktan sonra 10 dakika ara vermelisiniz!	</stand>

3059.source_en: <stand>	This is a hypothetical situation. If you stay still and do not do anything, then Alice will get hungry. If you do not do anything about Alice being hungry, Alice must leave her master... *Sob*	</stand>
3059.translation_tr: <stand>	Bu varsayimsal bir durum. Hicbir sey yapmadan durursan Alice acikir. Alice'in acligiyla ilgilenmezsen Alice efendisini terk etmek zorunda kalir... *hickirir*	</stand>

3060.source_en: <stand>	I can do anything you want, master! I can go grocery shopping, prepare dinner and clean the house...I can do anything you imagine!	</stand>
3060.translation_tr: <stand>	Istediginiz her seyi yapabilirim efendim! Alisverise gidebilir, yemek hazirlayabilir ve evi temizleyebilirim... Hayal ettiginiz her seyi yapabilirim!	</stand>

3061.source_en: <stand>	Actually Alice has a dream to become a maid uniform designer! Heh, don't you think it is a great idea?	</stand>
3061.translation_tr: <stand>	Aslinda Alice'in hizmetci uniformasi tasarimcisi olma hayali var! Heh, sizce de harika bir fikir degil mi?	</stand>

3062.source_en: <stand>	I have secret news from my connection. Would you like to hear?	</stand>
3062.translation_tr: <stand>	Baglantilarimdan gizli haberlerim var. Duymak ister misin?	</stand>

3063.source_en: <connect>	Jesus Christ! Stop freaking me out when I'm doing my makeup!	</connect>
3063.translation_tr: <connect>	Aman tanrim! Makyaj yaparken beni korkutmayi birak!	</connect>

3064.source_en: <connect>	Have you ever heard the saying that today is a desired tomorrow for a man who died yesterday?	</connect>
3064.translation_tr: <connect>	Dun olen biri icin bugun arzulanan yarindir sozunu hic duydun mu?	</connect>

3065.source_en: <levelup>	My heart is full as you leveled up!	</levelup>
3065.translation_tr: <levelup>	Level atladigin icin kalbim mutlulukla dolu!	</levelup>

3066.source_en: <levelup>	Yes, yes! Hold onto it! Let's level up one more time today!	</levelup>
3066.translation_tr: <levelup>	Evet, evet! Boyle devam! Bugun bir level daha atlayalim!	</levelup>

3067.source_en: <levelup>	Sometimes...I am wonder how it would be if I get married a man that was just like you.	</levelup>
3067.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bazen... senin gibi biriyle evlensem nasil olurdu diye merak ediyorum.	</levelup>

3068.source_en: <levelup>	Well done, well done! You did a good job!	</levelup>

3070.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry. Let me clean this mess really quick.	</perfor_1>
3070.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim. Bu daginikligi hemen temizleyeyim.	</perfor_1>

3071.source_en: <perfor_1>	Thank you for trusting me, even if I am careless sometimes.	</perfor_1>
3071.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Bazen dikkatsiz olsam da bana guvendiginiz icin tesekkur ederim.	</perfor_1>

3072.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry!	</perfor_1>
3072.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim!	</perfor_1>

3073.source_en: <perfor_2>	A respectable maid must be pure in body and mind.	</perfor_2>
3073.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Saygin bir hizmetci bedenen ve ruhen temiz olmalidir.	</perfor_2>

3074.source_en: <perfor_2>	Let's say I'm covered in dark dust. Would that make me Cinderella?	</perfor_2>
3074.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Diyelim ki kara toza bulandim. Bu beni Kulkedisi yapar mi?	</perfor_2>

3075.source_en: <perfor_2>	Alice must shake the dust off her body often. Otherwise she will look dirty.	</perfor_2>
3075.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Alice vucudundaki tozu sik sik silkelemeli. Yoksa kirli gorunur.	</perfor_2>

3077.source_en: <perfor_3>	Do you think the house looks better now? Can I take a break?	</perfor_3>
3077.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Sence ev simdi daha iyi gorunuyor mu? Biraz ara verebilir miyim?	</perfor_3>

3078.source_en: <perfor_3>	I love my job, but sometimes it is very tiresome. *Sigh...*	</perfor_3>
3078.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Isimi seviyorum ama bazen cok yorucu oluyor. *Ic ceker...*	</perfor_3>

3084.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you much for the food!	</feeding>

3085.source_en: <feeding>	I will get to work right away!	</feeding>

3086.source_en: <feeding>	It is good to exercise after a meal. Yes, that's good for your health.	</feeding>
3086.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yemekten sonra egzersiz iyidir. Evet, sagligin icin iyi.	</feeding>

3087.source_en: <feeding>	I am Alice the maid who always enjoys cleaning~		</feeding>
3087.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ben temizligi her zaman seven hizmetci Alice'im~		</feeding>

3088.source_en: <feeding>	What are the materials to make White Potions? Sometimes Alice gets curious.	</feeding>
3088.translation_tr: <feeding>	White Potion yapmak icin gereken malzemeler neler? Alice bazen merak ediyor.	</feeding>

3089.source_en: <hunting>	If you eliminate the enemy, I will clean the mess afterwards.	</hunting>
3089.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dusmani ortadan kaldirirsaniz, kalan daginikligi ben temizlerim.	</hunting>

3090.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you will defeat the enemy and grab the item as soon as you can. Otherwise I will sweep them all together.	</hunting>
3090.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim dusmani yenip esyayi hemen alirsin. Yoksa hepsini birlikte supururum.	</hunting>

3092.source_en: <hunting>	I really like to see you trying hard to be stronger. You know?	</hunting>
3092.translation_tr: <hunting>	Guclenmek icin cabaladigini gormeyi gercekten seviyorum, biliyor musun?	</hunting>

3093.source_en: <hunting>	I love the beads of sweat on your brow as you deliver your blows to an enemy.	</hunting>
3093.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dusmana vururken alnindaki ter damlalarini seviyorum.	</hunting>

3094.source_en: <danger>	I don't think you are in danger yet! Are you?	</danger>
3094.translation_tr: <danger>	Henuz tehlikede oldugunu sanmiyorum! Oyle misin?	</danger>

3095.source_en: <danger>	Is there anyone here who can heal my master?! Please~!	</danger>
3095.translation_tr: <danger>	Burada efendimi heal edebilecek biri var mi?! Lutfen~!	</danger>

3096.source_en: <danger>	I wonder why you always choose the hard way.	</danger>
3096.translation_tr: <danger>	Neden hep zor yolu sectigini merak ediyorum.	</danger>

3097.source_en: <danger>	*Sob sob* I didn't know you're going through so much difficulty to earn White Potions for me. *Sob sob* I'm so sorry!	</danger>
3097.translation_tr: <danger>	*hickirir* Benim icin White Potion kazanmak ugruna bu kadar zorlandigini bilmiyordum. *hickirir* Cok uzgunum!	</danger>

3098.source_en: <danger>	Master, I hope you will not worry me longer.	</danger>
3098.translation_tr: <danger>	Efendim, umarim beni daha fazla endiselendirmezsiniz.	</danger>

3099.source_en: <dead>	The ground seems to be so cold...	</dead>

3100.source_en: <dead>	Can't you see the Grim Reaper over there? Or am I the only one who sees him here?	</dead>
3100.translation_tr: <dead>	Oradaki Grim Reaper'i gormuyor musun? Yoksa sadece ben mi goruyorum?	</dead>

3101.source_en: <dead>	I heard the Grim Reaper comes to take some of your experience points when you lie down on the ground. So, get up now, quick!	</dead>
3101.translation_tr: <dead>	Yerde yatinca Grim Reaper'in EXP puanlarindan birazini almaya geldigini duydum. Cabuk kalk!	</dead>

3102.source_en: <dead>	Ah~ The ground seems so warm and comfy under the sunlight...	</dead>
3102.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah~ Gunes isiginda zemin cok sicak ve rahat gorunuyor...	</dead>

3103.source_en: <dead>	Do not hold a grudge but enter Nirvana, master. I will perform a sacrificial rite every year for you~	</dead>
3103.translation_tr: <dead>	Kin tutmadan Nirvana'ya gir efendim. Her yil senin icin anma ayini yapacagim~	</dead>

3104.source_en: <stand>	Sometimes, Alice wishes to have some friends.	</stand>

3106.source_en: <stand>	You are supposed to take a 10 minute break after 50 minutes of playing!	</stand>
3106.translation_tr: <stand>	50 dakika oynadiktan sonra 10 dakika ara vermelisiniz!	</stand>

3107.source_en: <stand>	Here is a hypothetical situation. If you stay still and do not do anything, then Alice will get hungry. If you do not do anything about Alice being hungry, Alice must leave her master...*Sob*	</stand>
3107.translation_tr: <stand>	Varsayimsal bir durum: Hicbir sey yapmadan durursan Alice acikir. Alice'in acligiyla ilgilenmezsen efendisini terk etmek zorunda kalir... *hickirir*	</stand>

3108.source_en: <stand>	I can do anything you want, master! I can go grocery shopping, prepare dinner and clean the house...I can do anything you imagine!	</stand>
3108.translation_tr: <stand>	Istediginiz her seyi yapabilirim efendim! Alisverise gidebilir, yemek hazirlayabilir ve evi temizleyebilirim... Hayal ettiginiz her seyi yapabilirim!	</stand>

3109.source_en: <stand>	Actually Alice has a dream to become a maid uniform designer! Heh, don't you think it is a great idea?	</stand>
3109.translation_tr: <stand>	Aslinda Alice'in hizmetci uniformasi tasarimcisi olma hayali var! Heh, sizce de harika bir fikir degil mi?	</stand>

3110.source_en: <stand>	I was told that my sisters are living somewhere. I hope I will be able to see them soon.	</stand>
3110.translation_tr: <stand>	Kiz kardeslerimin bir yerde yasadigi soylendi. Umarim yakinda gorebilirim.	</stand>

3111.source_en: <connect>	Hey, it's my master! It's my master! Aren't you jealous of me, guys?	</connect>
3111.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, bu benim efendim! Benim efendim! Beni kiskanmiyor musunuz?	</connect>

3112.source_en: <connect>	Tah dah! Here comes my master!	</connect>

3113.source_en: <connect>	I cleaned our house while you're gone, master!	</connect>

3114.source_en: <connect>	While you're gone, strange people needled me. So I hope you will not leave me alone for too long.	</connect>
3114.translation_tr: <connect>	Siz yokken garip insanlar beni rahatsiz etti. Umarim beni cok uzun sure yalniz birakmazsiniz.	</connect>

3115.source_en: <connect>	Do you know what time I hate the most? It is the 'weekly maintenance' time! Because you cannot come to me even if you want to...	</connect>
3115.translation_tr: <connect>	En nefret ettigim zaman ne biliyor musun? 'Haftalik bakim' zamani! Cunku istesen bile bana gelemezsin...	</connect>

3116.source_en: <connect>	Let's enjoy today, let's have fun tomorrow, let's be energetic on the day after tomorrow! Er, did that make sense?	</connect>
3116.translation_tr: <connect>	Bugun keyif alalim, yarin eglenelim, sonraki gun enerjik olalim! Ee, mantikli oldu mu?	</connect>

3117.source_en: <levelup>	Everytime you level up, an angel flaps her wings! It makes my job harder...but still....congratulations!	</levelup>
3117.translation_tr: <levelup>	Her level atladiginda bir melek kanat cirpar! Isimi zorlastiriyor... ama yine de... tebrikler!	</levelup>

3118.source_en: <levelup>	You are getting stronger and stronger every day. I am so proud of you...heh heh!	</levelup>
3118.translation_tr: <levelup>	Her gun daha da gucleniyorsun. Seninle gurur duyuyorum... heh heh!	</levelup>

3119.source_en: <levelup>	Weee! Alice is so happy for you!	</levelup>
3119.translation_tr: <levelup>	Weee! Alice senin adina cok mutlu!	</levelup>

3120.source_en: <levelup>	There is nothing you cannot do if you do your best!	</levelup>
3120.translation_tr: <levelup>	Elinden geleni yaparsan yapamayacagin sey yok!	</levelup>

3121.source_en: <levelup>	People say there are tons and tons of perverts...I know you will protect me from those people!	</levelup>
3121.translation_tr: <levelup>	Insanlar cok fazla sapik oldugunu soyluyor... Beni onlardan koruyacagini biliyorum!	</levelup>

3122.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry. Let me clean this mess really quick.	</perfor_1>
3122.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim. Bu daginikligi hemen temizleyeyim.	</perfor_1>

3123.source_en: <perfor_1>	Thank you for trusting me even if I am careless sometimes.	</perfor_1>
3123.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Bazen dikkatsiz olsam da bana guvendiginiz icin tesekkur ederim.	</perfor_1>

3124.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry!	</perfor_1>
3124.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim!	</perfor_1>

3125.source_en: <perfor_2>	A respectable maid must be pure in body and mind.	</perfor_2>
3125.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Saygin bir hizmetci bedenen ve ruhen temiz olmalidir.	</perfor_2>

3126.source_en: <perfor_2>	Let's say I'm covered in dark dust. Would that make me Cinderella?	</perfor_2>
3126.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Diyelim ki kara toza bulandim. Bu beni Kulkedisi yapar mi?	</perfor_2>

3127.source_en: <perfor_2>	Alice must shake the dust off her body often. Otherwise she will look dirty.	</perfor_2>
3127.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Alice vucudundaki tozu sik sik silkelemeli. Yoksa kirli gorunur.	</perfor_2>

3129.source_en: <perfor_3>	Do you think the house looks better now? Can I take a break?	</perfor_3>
3129.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Sence ev simdi daha iyi gorunuyor mu? Biraz ara verebilir miyim?	</perfor_3>

3130.source_en: <perfor_3>	I love my job, but sometimes it is very tiresome. *Sigh...*	</perfor_3>
3130.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Isimi seviyorum ama bazen cok yorucu oluyor. *Ic ceker...*	</perfor_3>

3136.source_en: <feeding>	No more...please, no more...Alice cannot move...	</feeding>
3136.translation_tr: <feeding>	Daha fazla yok... lutfen... Alice hareket edemiyor...	</feeding>

3137.source_en: <feeding>	If you feed me more...the laces on the Alice's apron will get tighter on her waist.	</feeding>
3137.translation_tr: <feeding>	Daha fazla beslersen... Alice'in onlugunun baglari belini daha cok sikar.	</feeding>

3138.source_en: <feeding>	I think I need a new apron...	</feeding>
3138.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sanirim yeni bir onluge ihtiyacim var...	</feeding>

3139.source_en: <feeding>	Wah! I gained 1 pound! Why can't you feed me at the right time?!	</feeding>
3139.translation_tr: <feeding>	Wah! 1 pound aldim! Neden beni dogru zamanda besleyemiyorsun?!	</feeding>

3140.source_en: <hunting>	If you eliminate the enemy, I will clean the mess afterwards.	</hunting>
3140.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dusmani ortadan kaldirirsaniz, kalan daginikligi ben temizlerim.	</hunting>

3141.source_en: <hunting>	I hope you will defeat the enemy and grab the item as soon as you can. Otherwise, I will sweep them altogether.	</hunting>
3141.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim dusmani yenip esyayi hemen alirsin. Yoksa hepsini birlikte supururum.	</hunting>

3142.source_en: <hunting>	Today's tears and sweat will result in a successful class change...have you heard of this saying?	</hunting>
3142.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bugunun gozyasi ve teri basarili bir class change getirir... Bu sozu duydun mu?	</hunting>

3143.source_en: <hunting>	I suggest you to use the ultimate skill 'thousandpalmspectacleeffectgorila'.	</hunting>

3144.source_en: <danger>	You know, the color red is used for warnings. A warning...wah! Master!!	</danger>
3144.translation_tr: <danger>	Biliyorsun, kirmizi renk uyari icin kullanilir. Bir uyari... wah! Efendim!!	</danger>

3145.source_en: <danger>	Red petal...white petal...a pretty girl Flo...wah?! You're in red, master!	</danger>
3145.translation_tr: <danger>	Kirmizi yaprak... beyaz yaprak... guzel bir kiz Flo... wah?! Kirmizisin efendim!	</danger>

3147.source_en: <danger>	Are you just careless, or are you just not thinking?	</danger>
3147.translation_tr: <danger>	Sadece dikkatsiz misin, yoksa hic dusunmuyor musun?	</danger>

3148.source_en: <danger>	You're not using the 'Berserk' skill as an excuse, are you?	</danger>

3149.source_en: <dead>	Umm...master...?! I can see your eyes are moving.	</dead>
3149.translation_tr: <dead>	Umm... efendim...?! Gozlerinin hareket ettigini goruyorum.	</dead>

3151.source_en: <dead>	Hm...? You look like a student relaxing during summer vacation!	</dead>
3151.translation_tr: <dead>	Hm...? Yaz tatilinde dinlenen bir ogrenci gibi gorunuyorsun!	</dead>

3152.source_en: <dead>	You know you cannot hunt anything other than cockroaches while you're lying on your stomach?	</dead>
3152.translation_tr: <dead>	Yuzustu yatarken hamamboceginden baska bir sey avlayamazsin, biliyorsun degil mi?	</dead>

3153.source_en: <dead>	Ah~ let me guess what that stance is. Isn't it the ultimate fighting skill 'Beg for mercy?'	</dead>
3153.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah~ Bu durusun ne oldugunu tahmin edeyim. Nihai savas becerisi 'Merhamet dilen' degil mi?	</dead>

3154.source_en: <stand>	I have thought what would be good for my nickname...and I got one now. How about 733t mad Alice!?	</stand>
3154.translation_tr: <stand>	Lakabim ne olsun diye dusunuyordum... buldum. 733t deli Alice nasil!?	</stand>

3155.source_en: <stand>	Sometimes I wish I could have more friends...	</stand>
3155.translation_tr: <stand>	Bazen daha cok arkadasim olsun istiyorum...	</stand>

3156.source_en: <stand>	Do you think one of these days, the development team would update the 'Pretty Girl Troops?'	</stand>
3156.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence gelistirme ekibi bir gun 'Pretty Girl Troops'u gunceller mi?	</stand>

3157.source_en: <stand>	Excuse me, there! Will you pick up the trash you just threw near my precious master?	</stand>
3157.translation_tr: <stand>	Affedersiniz! Degerli efendimin yanina attiginiz copu toplar misiniz?	</stand>

3158.source_en: <stand>	Stop looking at me and go back to work, guys!	</stand>
3158.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana bakmayi birakin ve isinize donun!	</stand>

3159.source_en: <stand>	I love this soft apron you gave me...well sometimes, more skin than I want shows through...	</stand>
3159.translation_tr: <stand>	Verdigin bu yumusak onlugu seviyorum... gerci bazen istedigimden fazla tenim gorunuyor...	</stand>

3160.source_en: <stand>	As I am getting better and better at sweeping, the more I have to do. Do you know why?	</stand>
3160.translation_tr: <stand>	Supurmede gittikce iyilestikce yapacak daha cok isim oluyor. Neden biliyor musun?	</stand>

3161.source_en: <stand>	If I work harder, will you love me more?	</stand>
3161.translation_tr: <stand>	Daha cok calisirsam beni daha cok sever misin?	</stand>

3162.translation_tr: <stand>	Temizlik yapmaktan her zaman keyif alirim.	</stand>

3163.source_en: <stand>	Are you looking at the sky...master?	</stand>

3164.source_en: <stand>	Did you find a pretty girl...?	</stand>

3165.source_en: <stand>	Watch out, there is a pile of dust near you.	</stand>
3165.translation_tr: <stand>	Dikkat edin, yaninizda bir toz yigini var.	</stand>

3167.source_en: <connect>	I am so happy to be with you.	</connect>

3168.source_en: <connect>	I am so glad that you have come back..		</connect>

3169.source_en: <connect>	Good day, master. Thank you for coming back.	</connect>
3169.translation_tr: <connect>	Iyi gunler efendim. Geri dondugunuz icin tesekkurler.	</connect>

3170.source_en: <connect>	Wee~ it's my master! I already feel today will be a good day!	</connect>
3170.translation_tr: <connect>	Wee~ bu benim efendim! Bugunun guzel olacagini simdiden hissediyorum!	</connect>

3172.source_en: <levelup>	Ah~ You just get greater and greater. Alice is sooo impressed! *Heart pounds*		</levelup>
3172.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah~ Gittikce daha harika oluyorsunuz. Alice coook etkilendi! *kalbi carpar*		</levelup>

3173.source_en: <levelup>	Every time you level up, Alice wants to do anything she can do for her master.	</levelup>
3173.translation_tr: <levelup>	Her level atladiginizda Alice efendisi icin yapabilecegi her seyi yapmak istiyor.	</levelup>

3174.source_en: <levelup>	So, what do you want to do from now on, master?		</levelup>
3174.translation_tr: <levelup>	Peki, bundan sonra ne yapmak istiyorsunuz efendim?		</levelup>

3175.source_en: <levelup>	Okay, that's it for today. Time for fun! Let's play with Alice, please?		</levelup>
3175.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tamam, bugunluk bu kadar. Eglenme zamani! Alice ile oynayalim, lutfen?		</levelup>

3176.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry. Let me clean this mess really quick.	</perfor_1>
3176.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim. Bu daginikligi hemen temizleyeyim.	</perfor_1>

3177.source_en: <perfor_1>	Thank you for trusting me, even if I am careless sometimes.	</perfor_1>
3177.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Bazen dikkatsiz olsam da bana guvendiginiz icin tesekkur ederim.	</perfor_1>

3178.source_en: <perfor_1>	I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry! I am so sorry!	</perfor_1>
3178.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim! Cok ozur dilerim!	</perfor_1>

3179.source_en: <perfor_2>	A respectable maid must be pure in body and mind.	</perfor_2>
3179.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Saygin bir hizmetci bedenen ve ruhen temiz olmalidir.	</perfor_2>

3180.source_en: <perfor_2>	Let's say I'm covered in dark dust. Would that make me Cinderella?	</perfor_2>
3180.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Diyelim ki kara toza bulandim. Bu beni Kulkedisi yapar mi?	</perfor_2>

3181.source_en: <perfor_2>	Alice must shake the dust off her body often. Otherwise she will look dirty.	</perfor_2>
3181.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Alice vucudundaki tozu sik sik silkelemeli. Yoksa kirli gorunur.	</perfor_2>

3183.source_en: <perfor_3>	Do you think the house looks better now? Can I take a break?	</perfor_3>
3183.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Sence ev simdi daha iyi gorunuyor mu? Biraz ara verebilir miyim?	</perfor_3>

3184.source_en: <perfor_3>	I love my job but sometimes it is very tiresome. *Sigh...*	</perfor_3>
3184.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Isimi seviyorum ama bazen cok yorucu oluyor. *ic ceker*	</perfor_3>

3192.source_en: <feeding>	Hey! Feeding me's your first priority, got it?!	</feeding>
3192.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey! Beni beslemek ilk onceligin, anladin mi?!	</feeding>

3193.source_en: <feeding>	You're the worst slave I've ever had. This meal is late, worm!	</feeding>
3193.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sahip oldugum en kotu kolesin. Bu yemek gecikti, solucan!	</feeding>

3194.source_en: <feeding>	Took your sweet time, didn't you?!	</feeding>

3196.source_en: <hunting>	You better have your potions ready, you little crybaby.	</hunting>
3196.translation_tr: <hunting>	Potionlarini hazir etsen iyi olur, seni mizmiz.	</hunting>

3197.source_en: <hunting>	If that's not a Poring, you're in for a beating!	</hunting>

3198.source_en: <hunting>	Don't you think this enemy's way too strong for you! Give it up!	</hunting>
3198.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu dusman senin icin fazla guclu degil mi! Birak!	</hunting>

3199.source_en: <danger>	Hahahaha, finally! Your HP is red!	</danger>

3201.source_en: <danger>	Oh~ Doesn't the ground look so comfy?	</danger>
3201.translation_tr: <danger>	Oh~ Zemin cok rahat gorunmuyor mu?	</danger>

3202.source_en: <dead>	I'm speechless. I'm just so... happy!	</dead>

3203.source_en: <dead>	What now? Did you fight something way too powerful than you? I should have known!	</dead>
3203.translation_tr: <dead>	Simdi ne oldu? Senden cok daha guclu bir seyle mi savastin? Bilmeliydim!	</dead>

3206.source_en: <stand>	What are you doing, weakling? That's why people think you're stupid!	</stand>
3206.translation_tr: <stand>	Ne yapiyorsun, zayif? Insanlar bu yuzden seni aptal saniyor!	</stand>

3207.source_en: <stand>	MOVE! No time for window shopping!	</stand>
3207.translation_tr: <stand>	HAREKET ET! Vitrin bakma zamani degil!	</stand>

3208.source_en: <stand>	What are you doing, sitting there like you're in fantasy land?!	</stand>
3208.translation_tr: <stand>	Ne yapiyorsun, hayal alemindeymis gibi oturuyorsun?!	</stand>

3210.source_en: <stand>	Finally, you get up. You're the laziest slave I've ever had!	</stand>
3210.translation_tr: <stand>	Sonunda kalktin. Gordugum en tembel kolesin!	</stand>

3211.source_en: <stand>	Hey, if you have time to be idle, go check my status window!	</stand>
3211.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, bos duracak vaktin varsa status penceremi kontrol et!	</stand>

3212.source_en: <stand>	Don't expect money to just fall into your wallet! Find something to hunt!	</stand>
3212.translation_tr: <stand>	Paranin cuzdanina kendiliginden dusmesini bekleme! Avlanacak bir sey bul!	</stand>

3214.source_en: <connect>	So, what's your schedule today? Have you even planned it out?	</connect>
3214.translation_tr: <connect>	Peki bugunku planin ne? Hic plan yaptin mi?	</connect>

3215.source_en: <connect>	Hey...stop logging on and off but feed me!	</connect>
3215.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey... girip cikmayi birak da beni besle!	</connect>

3218.source_en: <levelup>	Man, it takes you forever to level up.	</levelup>
3218.translation_tr: <levelup>	Dostum, level atlaman sonsuza kadar suruyor.	</levelup>

3220.source_en: <perfor_1>	Hello, mirror. Here's something to reflect!	</perfor_1>
3220.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Merhaba ayna. Yansitacak bir sey geldi!	</perfor_1>

3221.source_en: <perfor_1>	Huh, I put my make-up on pretty well today.	</perfor_1>

3223.source_en: <perfor_2>	Sometimes I can't breathe under this mask!	</perfor_2>
3223.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Bazen bu maskenin altinda nefes alamiyorum!	</perfor_2>

3224.source_en: <perfor_2>	Don't act so surprised ! This isn't the first time you've seen me without the mask!	</perfor_2>
3224.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	O kadar sasirma! Beni maskesiz ilk gorusun degil!	</perfor_2>

3225.source_en: <perfor_3>	Want me to make a doughnut?	</perfor_3>

3226.source_en: <perfor_3>	I smoke when I'm stressed out, but I don't think it's helping me. Oh well...still I can't quit.	</perfor_3>
3226.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Stresliyken sigara iciyorum ama yardim etmiyor. Neyse... yine de birakamiyorum.	</perfor_3>

3227.source_en: <perfor_3>	If you're a smoker, you oughta quit. Me? Shuddap and lemme alone!	</perfor_3>
3227.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Sigara iciyorsan birakmalisin. Ben mi? Sus ve beni rahat birak!	</perfor_3>

3235.source_en: <feeding>	The ancients believed that eating one's heart would give you the owner's power. You know that?	</feeding>
3235.translation_tr: <feeding>	Eskiler birinin kalbini yemenin onun gucunu verecegine inanirdi. Biliyor muydun?	</feeding>

3236.source_en: <feeding>	I don't think I could get any power out of a Verit's heart though...	</feeding>
3236.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ama bir Verit'in kalbinden guc alabilecegimi sanmiyorum...	</feeding>

3238.source_en: <feeding>	There're lots of ways to cook a Verit's heart. Baked, steamed, stewed, Verit's heart burger...	</feeding>
3238.translation_tr: <feeding>	Verit kalbini pisirmenin cok yolu var. Firinda, buharda, guvec, Verit kalpli burger...	</feeding>

3240.source_en: <feeding>	Hey, hey! I want fresh food! Fresh food with warm blood!	</feeding>
3240.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey, hey! Taze yemek istiyorum! Sicak kanli taze yemek!	</feeding>

3241.source_en: <hunting>	How long do you plan to play in this weakling area?	</hunting>
3241.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu zayiflar bolgesinde ne kadar daha oyalanacaksin?	</hunting>

3242.source_en: <hunting>	All I've seen you hunt are Porings... How're you gonna reach the next level?	</hunting>
3242.translation_tr: <hunting>	Seni sadece Poring avlarken gordum... Sonraki levele nasil ulasacaksin?	</hunting>

3243.source_en: <hunting>	Come on, come on! Show me blood! Muhahahahah!	</hunting>
3243.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hadi, hadi! Bana kan goster! Muhahahahah!	</hunting>

3244.source_en: <hunting>	There you go! That's how you kill!	</hunting>

3245.source_en: <hunting>	Once you start attacking, don't stop! Oh God, don't stop!	</hunting>
3245.translation_tr: <hunting>	Saldirmaya basladin mi durma! Aman tanrim, durma!	</hunting>

3247.source_en: <danger>	Hey! That thing's not deadly, is it?	</danger>
3247.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey! O sey olumcul degil, degil mi?	</danger>

3248.source_en: <danger>	Oh~ Somehow I figured this'd happen!	</danger>

3249.source_en: <danger>	What were you thinking? Do you even know you're in danger?	</danger>
3249.translation_tr: <danger>	Ne dusunuyordun? Tehlikede oldugunun farkinda misin?	</danger>

3250.source_en: <danger>	You'd better use a Fly Wing or drink some potions before it's too late. Got nothing? Then it's time to die!	</danger>
3250.translation_tr: <danger>	Gec olmadan Fly Wing kullan ya da potion ic. Hicbir seyin yok mu? O zaman olme zamani!	</danger>

3252.source_en: <danger>	Do you mind if I take your heart out? Of course...after you die!	</danger>
3252.translation_tr: <danger>	Kalbini cikarmam sorun olur mu? Tabii... olduktan sonra!	</danger>

3253.source_en: <danger>	Hey...remember I'm not a Nine Tail. I only need your heart, not your liver!		</danger>
3253.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey... Nine Tail olmadigimi unutma. Karacigerin degil sadece kalbin lazim!		</danger>

3254.source_en: <dead>	Okay now, if you don't restart, I'm gonna take your heart out. Just as I promised.	</dead>
3254.translation_tr: <dead>	Tamam, restart yapmazsan soz verdigim gibi kalbini cikartacagim.	</dead>

3255.source_en: <dead>	When I see you dead...I get excited for some reason! Wee~	</dead>
3255.translation_tr: <dead>	Seni olu gorunce... nedense heyecanlaniyorum! Wee~	</dead>

3256.source_en: <dead>	You like being dead? You do it often enough, so come to my world already! Just try not to get eaten by demons.	</dead>
3256.translation_tr: <dead>	Olu olmayi seviyor musun? Cok sik yapiyorsun, artik benim dunyama gel! Sadece iblislere yem olma.	</dead>

3257.source_en: <dead>	So, how do you like eating mud?	</dead>

3258.source_en: <dead>	Soon your corpse will be rotten and infested with maggots. Hohohohohoh!	</dead>

3259.source_en: <dead>	So, now you know how it feels like to be dead, huh?	</dead>
3259.translation_tr: <dead>	Simdi olu olmanin nasil bir sey oldugunu biliyorsun, ha?	</dead>

3261.source_en: <stand>	Are you thinking of your ex or what?	</stand>

3262.source_en: <stand>	I'm gonna kick your ass with these high heels if you don't move now!	</stand>
3262.translation_tr: <stand>	Simdi hareket etmezsen bu topuklularla tekmeyi basacagim!	</stand>

3263.source_en: <stand>	Hey! Move along if you don't want to get whipped!	</stand>
3263.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey! Kirbac yemek istemiyorsan hareket et!	</stand>

3264.source_en: <stand>	Shopping for items is for nobles like me, not peons like you.	</stand>
3264.translation_tr: <stand>	Esya alisverisi benim gibi asiller icindir, senin gibi ayak takimi icin degil.	</stand>

3265.source_en: <stand>	Yeah yeah, getting the best items might save you later.	</stand>
3265.translation_tr: <stand>	Evet evet, en iyi esyalari almak sonra seni kurtarabilir.	</stand>

3269.source_en: <connect>	So where were you last night, huh?	</connect>

3270.source_en: <connect>	Are you having a bad day or what?	</connect>
3270.translation_tr: <connect>	Kotu bir gun mu geciriyorsun ne?	</connect>

3271.source_en: <connect>	Yes, it is an honor to look upon nobility. Hohohoho!	</connect>
3271.translation_tr: <connect>	Evet, asillere bakmak bir onurdur. Hohohoho!	</connect>

3272.source_en: <connect>	Since you're here, it is the time for you to clean my high heels! Hohohohoho!	</connect>
3272.translation_tr: <connect>	Madem buradasin, topuklularimi temizleme zamani! Hohohohoho!	</connect>

3273.source_en: <levelup>	Okay okay! You've had your fun, so now it's the time to feed me!	</levelup>
3273.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tamam tamam! Eglendin, simdi beni besleme zamani!	</levelup>

3274.source_en: <levelup>	Don't forget that you used to be a weakling!	</levelup>

3275.source_en: <levelup>	Geez, always stepping forward. Kinda like Minorous.	</levelup>
3275.translation_tr: <levelup>	Off, hep ileri atiliyorsun. Minorous gibi.	</levelup>

3277.source_en: <perfor_1>	I'm the most beautiful! Don't you agree?	</perfor_1>

3278.source_en: <perfor_1>	Do you think you'll meet another woman like me? Hell no, I'm the most beautiful demon ever!	</perfor_1>
3278.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Benim gibi baska bir kadinla karsilasacagini mi saniyorsun? Asla, ben gelmis gecmis en guzel iblisim!	</perfor_1>

3280.source_en: <perfor_2>	Maintaining this lustrous hair takes a lot of work!	</perfor_2>
3280.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Bu parlak saclari korumak cok emek istiyor!	</perfor_2>

3283.source_en: <perfor_3>	Yeah, sometimes smoking makes me so relieved~		</perfor_3>
3283.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Evet, bazen sigara icmek beni cok rahatlatiyor~		</perfor_3>

3284.source_en: <perfor_3>	Sometimes is okay, but not always! Especially around kids, it weakens their bones!	</perfor_3>
3284.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Bazen olur ama her zaman degil! Ozellikle cocuklarin yaninda kemiklerini zayiflatir!	</perfor_3>

3290.source_en: <feeding>	Not bad! It hits the spot!	</feeding>

3292.source_en: <feeding>	So yeah, you take good care of me. What, you want a 'Thank you?!'	</feeding>
3292.translation_tr: <feeding>	Evet, benimle iyi ilgileniyorsun. Ne, bir 'Tesekkur ederim' mi istiyorsun?!	</feeding>

3293.source_en: <feeding>	Yes, this is what I wanted!	</feeding>

3296.source_en: <hunting>	Hahahaha! Make it cry, make it bleed!	</hunting>

3299.source_en: <hunting>	Stab and smash! Make it feel pain!	</hunting>

3300.source_en: <hunting>	Find its weak spot! Make it suffer even more!	</hunting>
3300.translation_tr: <hunting>	Zayif noktasini bul! Daha cok aci cektir!	</hunting>

3301.source_en: <hunting>	If you stop, it'll attack you anyway. Strike first!	</hunting>
3301.translation_tr: <hunting>	Durursan zaten sana saldiracak. Once sen vur!	</hunting>

3302.source_en: <hunting>	Dodge that! Oh, don't say you're a VIT character!	</hunting>
3302.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dodge yap! Ah, VIT karakterisin deme!	</hunting>

3303.source_en: <hunting>	How can you survive when you're that sloppy?! Move and dodge!	</hunting>
3303.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu kadar beceriksizken nasil hayatta kalacaksin?! Hareket et ve dodge yap!	</hunting>

3304.translation_tr: <hunting>	HAREKET ET, HAREKET ET, HAREKET ET!	</hunting>

3305.source_en: <danger>	Hey, are you looking at your health bar or what?	</danger>

3306.source_en: <danger>	Do you wish to die already?	</danger>

3308.source_en: <danger>	Hey, you'll be dead if you don't drink a potion right now!	</danger>

3309.source_en: <danger>	Red means passion, but now it means danger!	</danger>
3309.translation_tr: <danger>	Kirmizi tutku demektir ama simdi tehlike demek!	</danger>

3310.source_en: <danger>	The red of roses and the red of blood, it's all the same.	</danger>
3310.translation_tr: <danger>	Gulun kirmizisi da kanin kirmizisi da ayni.	</danger>

3311.source_en: <danger>	Ah~ red always reminds me of blood dripping from a human heart...hahahaha!		</danger>
3311.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah~ kirmizi bana hep insan kalbinden damlayan kani hatirlatiyor... hahahaha!		</danger>

3312.source_en: <dead>	Yeah, it happened as usual. So don't worry.	</dead>
3312.translation_tr: <dead>	Evet, her zamanki gibi oldu. Endiselenme.	</dead>

3313.source_en: <dead>	Hey, don't blame me. It was your fault!	</dead>

3314.source_en: <dead>	Everyone dies one of these days.		</dead>

3315.source_en: <dead>	I hope you learn that being alive is a lot more fun than being dead.	</dead>
3315.translation_tr: <dead>	Umarim hayatta olmanin olu olmaktan cok daha eglenceli oldugunu ogrenirsin.	</dead>

3316.source_en: <dead>	Now that wasn't so bad. Though, I don't think you saw it coming.	</dead>
3316.translation_tr: <dead>	O kadar da kotu degildi. Gerci geldigini gordugunu sanmiyorum.	</dead>

3317.source_en: <dead>	Don't blame it on lag. It was your fault!	</dead>

3318.source_en: <dead>	No one can take that much punishment!	</dead>

3319.source_en: <dead>	I hope you learned your lesson.	</dead>

3322.source_en: <stand>	Hey! Everyone's looking at you strangely. Let's get away!	</stand>
3322.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey! Herkes sana garip bakiyor. Gidelim!	</stand>

3323.source_en: <stand>	Are you sleeping or what? WAKE UP!	</stand>

3326.source_en: <stand>	Are you getting paid for being this lazy?	</stand>
3326.translation_tr: <stand>	Bu kadar tembel olmak icin para mi aliyorsun?	</stand>

3327.source_en: <stand>	Okay, now's the time to run!	</stand>

3328.source_en: <stand>	So tell me, what's the plan?	</stand>

3330.source_en: <stand>	Are you ready for hunt? Or do you still need more time?	</stand>
3330.translation_tr: <stand>	Ava hazir misin? Yoksa biraz daha zamana mi ihtiyacin var?	</stand>

3331.source_en: <stand>	You know humans are nothing but worms to demons, right? *Piff*		</stand>
3331.translation_tr: <stand>	Insanlarin iblisler icin solucandan farki olmadigini biliyorsun, degil mi? *Piff*		</stand>

3333.source_en: <connect>	Hey, haven't you even missed me? Why didn't you come earlier?	</connect>
3333.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, beni hic ozlemedin mi? Neden daha erken gelmedin?	</connect>

3334.source_en: <levelup>	Congratulations. Now we can go explore even more dangerous areas!	</levelup>
3334.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tebrikler. Simdi daha tehlikeli bolgeleri kesfedebiliriz!	</levelup>

3335.source_en: <levelup>	Hahaha! Doesn't it feel great to be stronger than others?!	</levelup>
3335.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hahaha! Baskalarindan guclu olmak harika degil mi?!	</levelup>

3337.source_en: <levelup>	So did you think of how you're gonna use your stat and skill points?	</levelup>
3337.translation_tr: <levelup>	Stat ve skill puanlarini nasil kullanacagini dusundun mu?	</levelup>

3341.source_en: <perfor_1>	Do you think you could meet another woman like me? Hell no, I'm the most beautiful demon ever!	</perfor_1>
3341.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Benim gibi baska bir kadin bulabilecegini mi saniyorsun? Asla, gelmis gecmis en guzel iblisim!	</perfor_1>

3343.source_en: <perfor_2>	Maintaining this lustrous hair takes a lot of work!	</perfor_2>
3343.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Bu parlak saclari korumak cok emek istiyor!	</perfor_2>

3346.source_en: <perfor_3>	Yeah, sometimes smoking gives me suuuch relief~		</perfor_3>
3346.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Evet, bazen sigara icmek beni coook rahatlatiyor~		</perfor_3>

3347.source_en: <perfor_3>	Sometimes a cig is okay, but not always! Especially around kids, it weakens their bones!	</perfor_3>
3347.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Bazen sigara olur ama her zaman degil! Ozellikle cocuklarin yaninda olmaz, kemiklerini zayiflatir!	</perfor_3>

3353.source_en: <feeding>	Not bad! It hits the spot!	</feeding>

3355.source_en: <feeding>	So yeah, you take good care of me. What, you want a 'Thank you?!'	</feeding>
3355.translation_tr: <feeding>	Evet, benimle iyi ilgileniyorsun. Ne, bir 'Tesekkur ederim' mi istiyorsun?!	</feeding>

3356.source_en: <feeding>	Yes, this is what I wanted!	</feeding>

3358.source_en: <hunting>	Hahah! when I see you hunt, I think of a savage boar!		</hunting>
3358.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hahah! Seni avlanirken gorunce vahsi domuz aklima geliyor!		</hunting>

3360.translation_tr: <hunting>	Savunmayi bos ver! Saldir ve oldur!	</hunting>

3361.source_en: <hunting>	Just wipe it out and let's move on!	</hunting>

3362.source_en: <hunting>	Yes! I just know you broke something with that hit!	</hunting>
3362.translation_tr: <hunting>	Evet! O vurusla bir sey kirdigini biliyorum!	</hunting>

3364.source_en: <danger>	Hey, are you checking your health bar?! Get outta here!	</danger>
3364.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, HP cubugunu kontrol ediyor musun?! Buradan cik!	</danger>

3365.source_en: <danger>	Hey, your potions are hot keyed, right?	</danger>

3366.source_en: <danger>	You're not thinking of taking herbs before potions for this situation, are you?	</danger>
3366.translation_tr: <danger>	Bu durumda potion yerine herb kullanmayi dusunmuyorsun, degil mi?	</danger>

3367.source_en: <danger>	Hey... You've got a lot of potions, right? Right?!	</danger>
3367.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey... Cok potionun var, degil mi? Degil mi?!	</danger>

3368.source_en: <dead>	I guess you like lying down on the ground, huh?	</dead>

3369.source_en: <dead>	What are you doing on the ground?!	</dead>

3371.source_en: <dead>	Yeah, so you're upset. But you've gotta continue!	</dead>

3372.source_en: <dead>	I don't like people who don't make up for their mistakes. Get up and think up something!	</dead>
3372.translation_tr: <dead>	Hatalarini telafi etmeyen insanlari sevmem. Kalk ve bir sey dusun!	</dead>

3373.source_en: <stand>	Why are you looking at the clouds when the beautiful thing's right here?	</stand>
3373.translation_tr: <stand>	Guzel sey tam buradayken neden bulutlara bakiyorsun?	</stand>

3374.source_en: <stand>	Sometimes I get frustrated when I see you sitting still like a moron.	</stand>
3374.translation_tr: <stand>	Bazen seni aptal gibi hareketsiz otururken gorunce sinirleniyorum.	</stand>

3375.source_en: <stand>	Eh, I guess everyone needs to rest now and then.	</stand>

3376.source_en: <stand>	It's better to check your equipment and items than to just afk.	</stand>
3376.translation_tr: <stand>	AFK durmak yerine ekipman ve esyalarini kontrol etmen daha iyi.	</stand>

3377.source_en: <stand>	Hey, make sure you make you use your time wisely, got it?	</stand>
3377.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, zamanini akillica kullan, tamam mi?	</stand>

3378.source_en: <stand>	Humans have their days numbered. Don't you feel like planning your life?	</stand>
3378.translation_tr: <stand>	Insanlarin gunleri sayili. Hayatini planlamak istemiyor musun?	</stand>

3383.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back. So what are we gonna hurt today?	</connect>
3383.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin. Bugun neye zarar verecegiz?	</connect>

3384.source_en: <connect>	Sometimes, I think I miss you.	</connect>

3385.source_en: <connect>	Me? Worried about you not coming back ever again? Never!	</connect>
3385.translation_tr: <connect>	Ben mi? Bir daha geri gelmemen konusunda endiseli miyim? Asla!	</connect>

3388.source_en: <levelup>	So experience makes you stronger, eh?	</levelup>

3389.source_en: <levelup>	Hahahaha! You enjoy the rewards, I'll enjoy... the punishment.	</levelup>
3389.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hahahaha! Sen odullerin tadini cikar, ben de... cezalandirmanin.	</levelup>

3390.source_en: <levelup>	Hahah! Yes! I hate that angel, but I love it when you get stronger! Yes, more hurting!	</levelup>
3390.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hahah! Evet! O melekten nefret ediyorum ama guclenmeni seviyorum! Evet, daha cok aci!	</levelup>

3393.source_en: <perfor_1>	Do you think you'll meet another woman like me? Hell no, I'm the most beautiful demon ever!	</perfor_1>
3393.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Benim gibi baska bir kadinla karsilasacagini mi saniyorsun? Asla, ben gelmis gecmis en guzel iblisim!	</perfor_1>

3395.source_en: <perfor_2>	Maintaining this lustrous hair takes a lot of work!		</perfor_2>
3395.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Bu parlak saclari korumak cok emek istiyor!		</perfor_2>

3398.source_en: <perfor_3>	Yeah, sometimes smoking gives me suuuch relief~	</perfor_3>
3398.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Evet, bazen sigara icmek beni coook rahatlatiyor~	</perfor_3>

3399.source_en: <perfor_3>	Sometimes is a cig okay, but not always! Especially around kids, it weakens their bones!	</perfor_3>
3399.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Bazen sigara olur ama her zaman degil! Ozellikle cocuklarin yaninda kemiklerini zayiflatir!	</perfor_3>

3405.source_en: <feeding>	Not bad! That hit the spot!	</feeding>

3407.source_en: <feeding>	So yeah, you take good care of me. What, you want a 'Thank you?!'	</feeding>
3407.translation_tr: <feeding>	Evet, benimle iyi ilgileniyorsun. Ne, bir 'Tesekkur ederim' mi istiyorsun?!	</feeding>

3408.source_en: <feeding>	Yes, this is what I wanted!	</feeding>

3410.source_en: <hunting>	Hahaha! Make it writhe in agony!		</hunting>

3412.source_en: <hunting>	I love it when you make 'em scream like that! More!	</hunting>
3412.translation_tr: <hunting>	Onlari boyle ciglik attirdiginda bayiliyorum! Daha fazla!	</hunting>

3413.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, this place is okay for you to hunt in, right?	</hunting>
3413.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, burasi senin avlanman icin uygun, degil mi?	</hunting>

3416.source_en: <danger>	If you didn't carry enough potions, run now!	</danger>

3417.source_en: <danger>	Hey, get the hell out of here!	</danger>

3420.source_en: <dead>	Look what you did. Now what am I supposed to do?!	</dead>
3420.translation_tr: <dead>	Bak ne yaptin. Simdi ben ne yapacagim?!	</dead>

3423.source_en: <dead>	I told you to go hunt somewhere else, didn't I?!	</dead>
3423.translation_tr: <dead>	Baska yerde avlan demistim, degil mi?!	</dead>

3424.source_en: <dead>	I didn't expect you to be that weak, fool!	</dead>
3424.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu kadar zayif olmani beklemiyordum, aptal!	</dead>

3425.source_en: <stand>	Aren't you happy? You get to hang out with me!	</stand>

3426.source_en: <stand>	Sometimes, I feel weird around you.		</stand>

3427.source_en: <stand>	Eh, sorry for treating you kinda mean before.	</stand>
3427.translation_tr: <stand>	Eh, daha once sana biraz kotu davrandigim icin uzgunum.	</stand>

3428.source_en: <stand>	I guess I'm on your side, no matter what happens.	</stand>
3428.translation_tr: <stand>	Ne olursa olsun senin tarafinda oldugumu sanirim.	</stand>

3429.source_en: <stand>	Even if I treated you bad, you better not leave me!	</stand>
3429.translation_tr: <stand>	Sana kotu davransam bile beni birakma!	</stand>

3431.source_en: <stand>	I wonder how Injustice is...He was a really good servant for me.	</stand>
3431.translation_tr: <stand>	Injustice nasil acaba... Benim icin cok iyi bir hizmetkardi.	</stand>

3432.source_en: <stand>	I am wondering how old Raydric is. He was pretty cool for a guy made of metal.	</stand>
3432.translation_tr: <stand>	Raydric kac yasinda acaba. Metalden bir adam icin oldukca havaliydi.	</stand>

3433.source_en: <stand>	If you wanna go to Glast Heim, I can tell you where you should go.	</stand>
3433.translation_tr: <stand>	Glast Heim'a gitmek istiyorsan nereye gitmen gerektigini soyleyebilirim.	</stand>

3434.source_en: <stand>	Glast Heim isn't complicated. You're just not smart enough to figure your way around!	</stand>
3434.translation_tr: <stand>	Glast Heim karmasik degil. Sadece yolunu bulacak kadar akilli degilsin!	</stand>

3435.source_en: <stand>	Petites are kind of stupid excuses for dragons, huh?	</stand>
3435.translation_tr: <stand>	Petite'ler ejderha icin kotu bir bahane gibi, ha?	</stand>

3436.source_en: <stand>	You have a long way to go.	</stand>

3439.source_en: <connect>	So, where are we gonna explore today? Have you planned out?	</connect>
3439.translation_tr: <connect>	Bugun nereyi kesfedecegiz? Plan yaptin mi?	</connect>

3442.source_en: <connect>	I think you need some time away from your computer.	</connect>

3444.source_en: <levelup>	Now you can show me off to your friends.	</levelup>

3446.source_en: <levelup>	Level up again? Huh, you're good at this, I'll give you that.	</levelup>
3446.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yine level mi? Huh, bunda iyisin, hakkini vereyim.	</levelup>

3449.source_en: <perfor_1>	Do you think you'll meet another woman like me? Hell no, I'm the most beautiful demon ever!	</perfor_1>
3449.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Benim gibi baska bir kadinla karsilasacagini mi saniyorsun? Asla, ben gelmis gecmis en guzel iblisim!	</perfor_1>

3451.source_en: <perfor_2>	It requires a lot of effort to maintain beautiful hair!	</perfor_2>
3451.translation_tr: <perfor_2>	Guzel saclari korumak cok emek ister!	</perfor_2>

3454.source_en: <perfor_3>	Yeah, sometimes smoking gives me suuuch relief~	</perfor_3>
3454.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Evet, bazen sigara icmek beni coook rahatlatiyor~	</perfor_3>
