3455.source_en: <perfor_3>	Sometimes a cig is okay, but not always! Especially around kids, it weakens their bones!	</perfor_3>
3455.translation_tr: <perfor_3>	Bazen sigara olur ama her zaman degil! Ozellikle cocuklarin yaninda olmaz, kemiklerini zayiflatir!	</perfor_3>

3463.source_en: <feeding>	Finally, some food! I was about to eat my mask!	</feeding>

3465.source_en: <feeding>	Yeah, yeah. You oughta know how hungry I am.	</feeding>
3465.translation_tr: <feeding>	Evet, evet. Ne kadar ac oldugumu bilmen gerek.	</feeding>

3467.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, who's messing with my pal? Taste my hammer, punk!	</hunting>
3467.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, dostuma kim bulasiyor? Cekicimin tadina bak, serseri!	</hunting>

3468.source_en: <hunting>	Couldn't we hunt after we eat something, huh?	</hunting>
3468.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bir seyler yedikten sonra avlanamaz miyiz, ha?	</hunting>

3470.source_en: <danger>	Look, I say we run away, and then we eat. We need our strength!	</danger>
3470.translation_tr: <danger>	Bak, bence kacalim, sonra yemek yiyelim. Guce ihtiyacimiz var!	</danger>

3474.source_en: <stand>	I know my mask covers my mouth, but I need to eat, you know!	</stand>
3474.translation_tr: <stand>	Maskemin agzimi kapattigini biliyorum ama yemek yemem gerek!	</stand>

3476.source_en: <stand>	Man, even Antonio fed me more often than this...	</stand>
3476.translation_tr: <stand>	Dostum, Antonio bile beni bundan daha sik besliyordu...	</stand>

3477.source_en: <stand>	See this mask? No one can tell what I'm thinking when I wear this thing.	</stand>
3477.translation_tr: <stand>	Bu maskeyi goruyor musun? Bunu takinca kimse ne dusundugumu anlayamaz.	</stand>

3478.source_en: <connect>	Look, you can give me a cell now, or I can complain all day...	</connect>
3478.translation_tr: <connect>	Bak, simdi bana bir Cell verebilirsin ya da butun gun sikayet ederim...	</connect>

3486.source_en: <perfor_3>	Round and round, shining as the sun!	</perfor_3>

3487.source_en: <perfor_3>	I used to dream of being a ballerino~ What do you think of my tour en l'air?	</perfor_3>

3628.source_en: <feeding>	...*Munch Munch* Hey, this is pretty good!	</feeding>

3631.source_en: <hunting>	Don't bother me when I'm eating! We can talk when I'm done!	</hunting>
3631.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yemek yerken beni rahatsiz etme! Bitirince konusuruz!	</hunting>

3632.source_en: <hunting>	I don't like how that monster looks! Do something about it!	</hunting>
3632.translation_tr: <hunting>	O canavarin gorunusunu sevmiyorum! Bir sey yap!	</hunting>

3633.source_en: <danger>	Let's get out of here, and go someplace safe where we can eat!	</danger>
3633.translation_tr: <danger>	Buradan cikup guvenli bir yere gidip yemek yiyelim!	</danger>

3634.source_en: <danger>	B-be careful! I think we should run away!	</danger>

3635.source_en: <dead>	You know what your problem is? You're way weaker than me!	</dead>
3635.translation_tr: <dead>	Sorunun ne biliyor musun? Benden cok daha zayifsin!	</dead>

3636.source_en: <dead>	Hello? Hello? Can you get up? Um... Hello?	</dead>
3636.translation_tr: <dead>	Alo? Alo? Kalkabilir misin? Ee... Alo?	</dead>

3637.source_en: <dead>	No! I don't like this! Come on, stand up!	</dead>

3639.source_en: <stand>	I don't know about you, but I'm hungry!	</stand>

3640.source_en: <stand>	*Gkruguruhk* Ah! I can hear my stomach! D-don't listen to it!	</stand>

3641.source_en: <stand>	Ugh. I don't like this weather!	</stand>

3642.source_en: <stand>	This isn't my world. I'm afraid that people will forget all about us dolls...	</stand>
3642.translation_tr: <stand>	Burasi benim dunyam degil. Insanlarin biz oyuncak bebekleri tamamen unutmasindan korkuyorum...	</stand>

3643.source_en: <connect>	Look who decided to show up... Hmpf. I wasn't going to leave or anything, but...	</connect>
3643.translation_tr: <connect>	Bak kim gelmeye karar vermis... Hmph. Gidecek falan degildim ama...	</connect>

3644.source_en: <connect>	You're here? I mean, it's not like I was waiting for you or anything...	</connect>
3644.translation_tr: <connect>	Geldin mi? Yani seni bekliyordum falan sanma...	</connect>

3645.source_en: <connect>	You're not leaving this time, are you? Hmpf! Just go away!	</connect>
3645.translation_tr: <connect>	Bu kez gitmiyorsun, degil mi? Hmph! Hadi git!	</connect>

3647.source_en: <levelup>	You're stronger now? That means you can get me something to eat now, right?	</levelup>
3647.translation_tr: <levelup>	Simdi daha guclusun? Bu da bana yemek bulabilecegin anlamina geliyor, degil mi?	</levelup>

3648.source_en: <perfor_1>	*Gasp Gasp* Heart... Made of breath... Steam...	</perfor_1>

3649.source_en: <perfor_1>	Don't you want to buy me a mitten?!	</perfor_1>
3649.translation_tr: <perfor_1>	Bana bir eldiven almak istemiyor musun?!	</perfor_1>
